title.zh: 卷六十一 志第十三: 地理四
title.raw: 卷六十一 志第十三: 地理四 Volume 61 Treatises 14: Geography 4

sentences.zh: 雲南諸路行中書省，為路三十七、府二，屬府三，屬州五十四，屬縣四十七。

translations.literal: The Branch Secretariat of the Pacification Commission for Yunnan Circuits had thirty-seven circuits, two prefectures, three subordinate prefectures, fifty-four subordinate prefectures, and forty-seven subordinate counties.
translations.idiomatic: The Yunnan Branch Secretariat of the Pacification Commission comprised thirty-seven circuits, two prefectures, three dependent prefectures, fifty-four dependent prefectures, and forty-seven dependent counties.

sentences.zh: 其餘甸寨軍民等府不在此數。

translations.literal: The remaining military-civilian prefectures of the dian and zhai settlements are not counted in this number.
translations.idiomatic: The other dian, zhai, and military-civilian prefectures are not included in these figures.

sentences.zh: 馬站七十四處，水站四處。

translations.literal: There were seventy-four horse relay stations and four water relay stations.
translations.idiomatic: It had seventy-four horse relay stations and four water relay stations.

sentences.zh: 雲南諸路道肅政廉訪司大德三年，罷雲南行御史臺，立肅政廉訪司。

translations.literal: The Surveillance Commission for the Pacification of Yunnan Circuits: in the third year of Dade, the Yunnan Branch Censorate was abolished and the Surveillance Commission was established.
translations.idiomatic: Surveillance Commission for Yunnan Circuits: in 1299 the Yunnan Branch Censorate was abolished and replaced by the Surveillance Commission.

sentences.zh: 中慶路，上。

translations.literal: Zhongqing Circuit, upper rank.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqing Circuit, superior grade.

sentences.zh: 唐姚州。

translations.literal: In the Tang it was Yaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang it was Yaozhou.

sentences.zh: 閣羅鳳叛，取姚州，其子鳳伽異增築城曰柘東，六世孫券豐祐改曰善闡，曆五代迄宋，羈縻而已。

translations.literal: Geluofeng rebelled and seized Yaozhou; his son Fengjiayi enlarged the city and called it Zhedong; the sixth-generation descendant Quanfengyou changed the name to Shanchan; from the Five Dynasties through the Song it was only a loosely controlled dependency.
translations.idiomatic: When Geluofeng rebelled he took Yaozhou; his son Fengjiayi expanded the city and named it Zhedong, and six generations later Quanfengyou renamed it Shanchan. From the Five Dynasties through the Song it remained only a loosely affiliated territory.

sentences.zh: 元世祖征大理，凡收府八，善闡其一也，郡四，部三十有七。

translations.literal: When Kublai campaigned against Dali, eight prefectures were taken in all; Shanchan was one of them, with four commanderies and thirty-seven divisions.
translations.idiomatic: When Kublai Khan conquered Dali, eight prefectures were brought under control altogether; Shanchan was one of them, with four commanderies and thirty-seven divisions.

sentences.zh: 其地東至普安路之橫山，西至緬地之江頭城。

translations.literal: Its territory extended east to Hengshan in Pu'an Circuit and west to Jiangtoucheng in the Burmese lands.
translations.idiomatic: Its territory ran east to Hengshan in Pu'an Circuit and west to Jiangtoucheng in the Burmese frontier.

sentences.zh: 凡三千九百里而遠；

translations.literal: Altogether three thousand nine hundred li in the distant direction;
translations.idiomatic: From east to west it measured some three thousand nine hundred li;

sentences.zh: 南至臨安路之鹿滄江，北至羅羅斯之大渡河，凡四千里而近。

translations.literal: south to Lucang River in Lin'an Circuit and north to the Dadu River in Luoluo, altogether four thousand li in the near direction.
translations.idiomatic: and south to the Lucang River in Lin'an Circuit and north to the Dadu River in Luoluo—some four thousand li in the nearer direction.

sentences.zh: 憲宗五年，立萬戶府十有九，分善闡為萬戶府四。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Möngke, nineteen myriarch offices were established, and Shanchan was divided into four myriarch offices.
translations.idiomatic: In 1255 nineteen myriarch offices were set up, with Shanchan divided into four of them.

sentences.zh: 至元七年，改為路。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Zhiyuan it was changed to a circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1270 it was converted into a circuit.

sentences.zh: 八年，分大理國三十七部為南北中三路，路設達魯花赤並總管。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the thirty-seven divisions of the Dali kingdom were divided into southern, northern, and central circuits; each circuit was given a darughachi and a general administrator.
translations.idiomatic: In 1271 the thirty-seven divisions of the Dali kingdom were reorganized into southern, northern, and central circuits, each headed by a darughachi and a general administrator.

sentences.zh: 十三年，立雲南行中書省，初置郡縣，遂改善闡為中慶路。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year the Yunnan Branch Secretariat was established, commanderies and counties were first set up, and Shanchan was then changed to Zhongqing Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 the Yunnan Branch Secretariat was established, commanderies and counties were introduced for the first time, and Shanchan was renamed Zhongqing Circuit.

sentences.zh: 領司一、縣三、州四。

translations.literal: It governed one bureau, three counties, and four prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: It administered one bureau, three counties, and four prefectures.

sentences.zh: 州領八縣。

translations.literal: The prefectures governed eight counties.
translations.idiomatic: Those prefectures in turn governed eight counties.

sentences.zh: 本路軍民屯田二萬二千四百雙有奇。

translations.literal: This circuit had military-civilian colony fields of more than twenty-two thousand four hundred shuang.
translations.idiomatic: This circuit had more than 22,400 shuang of military-civilian colony land.

sentences.zh: 錄事司。

translations.literal: Record-keeping Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Record-keeping Bureau.

sentences.zh: 昆明，中。

translations.literal: Kunming, middle rank.
translations.idiomatic: Kunming, middle grade.

sentences.zh: 倚郭。

translations.literal: Attached to the seat of the circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Seat of the circuit administration.

sentences.zh: 唐置。

translations.literal: Established in the Tang.
translations.idiomatic: It was established under the Tang.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗四年，分其地立千戶二。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Möngke two chiliarch offices were established by dividing its territory.
translations.idiomatic: In 1254 its territory was split to establish two chiliarch offices.

sentences.zh: 至元十二年，改善州，領縣。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan it was changed to Yizhou and governed counties.
translations.idiomatic: In 1275 it was upgraded to Yizhou and given jurisdiction over counties.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，州革，縣如故。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year the prefecture was abolished and the county remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: In 1284 the prefecture was abolished and the county status was restored.

sentences.zh: 其地有昆明池，五百餘里，夏潦必冒城郭。

translations.literal: In this region there is Kunming Pool, more than five hundred li around; in summer floods it invariably inundates the city walls.
translations.idiomatic: The area contains Kunming Pool, over five hundred li in circumference; summer floods regularly threaten the walled city.

sentences.zh: 張立道為大理等處勸農使，求泉源所出，泄其水，得地萬餘頃，皆為良田云。

translations.literal: Zhang Lidao served as Agricultural Commissioner for Dali and other places; he sought the source of the springs, drained the water, and obtained more than ten thousand qing of land, all of which became fertile fields, it is said.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Lidao, serving as agricultural commissioner for Dali and neighboring regions, traced the springs to their source and drained the water, reclaiming more than ten thousand qing of land that became fertile farmland, according to tradition.

sentences.zh: 富民，下。

translations.literal: Fumin, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Fumin, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 至元四年，立黎灢千戶。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhiyuan the Litan chiliarch office was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1267 the Litan chiliarch office was established.

sentences.zh: 十二年，即黎灢立縣。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year a county was established at Litan.
translations.idiomatic: In 1275 a county was created at Litan.

sentences.zh: 宜良。

translations.literal: Yiliang.
translations.idiomatic: Yiliang.

sentences.zh: 下。

translations.literal: Lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower grade.

sentences.zh: 唐匡州，即其地。

translations.literal: In the Tang it was Kuangzhou; this is that place.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang it was Kuangzhou—the same territory.

sentences.zh: 蠻酋羅氏於此立城居之，名曰羅裒龍，乃今縣也。

translations.literal: The barbarian chieftain of the Luo clan built a city and dwelt here, naming it Luopilong; this is the present county.
translations.idiomatic: A tribal chieftain of the Luo clan built a walled settlement here called Luopilong, which is the present county seat.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗六年，立太池千戶，隸嵩明萬戶。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Möngke the Taichi chiliarch office was established, subordinate to the Songming myriarch office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1256 the Taichi chiliarch office was set up under the Songming myriarch.

sentences.zh: 至元十三年，升宜良州，治太池縣。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan it was promoted to Yiliang Prefecture, administering Taichi County.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 it was promoted to Yiliang Prefecture with Taichi County as its seat.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，州罷為縣，後廢太池來屬。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year the prefecture was abolished and became a county; later Taichi was abolished and attached to it.
translations.idiomatic: In 1284 the prefecture was reduced to a county; Taichi was later abolished and merged into it.

sentences.zh: 嵩明州，下。

translations.literal: Songming Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Songming Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 州在中慶東北，治沙劄臥城。

translations.literal: The prefecture lies northeast of Zhongqing; its seat is Shazhawo City.
translations.idiomatic: The prefecture lay northeast of Zhongqing, with its seat at Shazhawo City.

sentences.zh: 烏蠻車氏所築，白蠻名為嵩明。

translations.literal: It was built by the Che clan of the Wuman; the Baiman called it Songming.
translations.idiomatic: The Wuman Che clan built it; the Baiman knew it as Songming.

sentences.zh: 昔漢人居之，後烏、白蠻強盛，漢人徙去，盟誓於此，因號嵩盟，今州南有土台，盟會處也。

translations.literal: Formerly Han people dwelt here; later when the Wuman and Baiman grew powerful the Han migrated away, and they swore an alliance here, hence the name Songmeng; south of the present prefecture there is an earthen platform, the place of the alliance meeting.
translations.idiomatic: Han settlers once lived here, but as the Wuman and Baiman grew powerful they moved away. The tribes swore an alliance on this spot, hence the name Songmeng ('Song Alliance'); an earthen platform south of the prefecture marks where the covenant was made.

sentences.zh: 漢人嘗立長州，築金城、阿葛二城。

translations.literal: The Han once established Changzhou and built the two cities of Jincheng and Age.
translations.idiomatic: The Han once established Changzhou and built the cities of Jincheng and Age.

sentences.zh: 蒙氏興，改長州為嵩盟部，段氏因之。

translations.literal: When the Meng clan rose to power, Changzhou was changed to the Songmeng Division; the Duan clan followed this arrangement.
translations.idiomatic: When the Meng clan rose to power, Changzhou was renamed the Songmeng Division, a designation retained under the Duan clan.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗六年，立嵩明萬戶。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Möngke the Songming myriarch office was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1256 the Songming myriarch office was established.

sentences.zh: 至元十二年，復改長州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan it was again changed to Changzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In 1275 it was restored as Changzhou.

sentences.zh: 十五年，升嵩明府。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year it was promoted to Songming Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1278 it was promoted to Songming Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，降為州。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year it was reduced to a prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1285 it was reduced to prefecture status.

sentences.zh: 領二縣：

translations.literal: It governed two counties:
translations.idiomatic: It governed two counties:

sentences.zh: 楊林，下。

translations.literal: Yanglin, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Yanglin, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 在州東南，治楊林城，乃雜蠻枳氏、車氏、鬥氏、麼氏四種所居之地，城東門內有石如羊形，故又作羊。

translations.literal: It lies southeast of the prefecture; its seat is Yanglin City, the dwelling place of the four mixed-barbarian clans Zhi, Che, Dou, and Mo; inside the east gate of the city there is a stone shaped like a sheep, hence it is also written with the character for sheep.
translations.idiomatic: Southeast of the prefecture seat at Yanglin City, this was the homeland of four mixed tribal groups—the Zhi, Che, Dou, and Mo clans. A sheep-shaped stone inside the east gate gave the place its alternate name written with the character for 'sheep.'

sentences.zh: 唐有羊林部落，即此地。

translations.literal: In the Tang there was the Yanglin tribal division; this is that place.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang there was a Yanglin tribal division—this same territory.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗七年，立羊林千戶。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Möngke the Yanglin chiliarch office was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1257 the Yanglin chiliarch office was established.

sentences.zh: 至元十二年，改為縣。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan it was changed to a county.
translations.idiomatic: In 1275 it was converted to a county.

sentences.zh: 邵甸。

translations.literal: Shaodian.
translations.idiomatic: Shaodian.

sentences.zh: 下。

translations.literal: Lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower grade.

sentences.zh: 在州西，治白邑村，無城郭，車蠻、鬥蠻舊地，名為束甸，以束為邵，憲宗七年，立邵甸千戶。

translations.literal: It lies west of the prefecture; its seat is Baiyi Village, without walls or moats; the old territory of the Che and Dou barbarians, called Shudian; taking shu as shao, in the seventh year of Möngke the Shaodian chiliarch office was established.
translations.idiomatic: West of the prefecture, administered from Baiyi Village without walled defenses, this was the former territory of the Che and Dou tribes, called Shudian ('Bound District'). The name was rendered as Shaodian, and in 1257 the Shaodian chiliarch office was established.

sentences.zh: 至元十二年，改為縣。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan it was changed to a county.
translations.idiomatic: In 1275 it was converted to a county.

sentences.zh: 晉寧州，下。

translations.literal: Jinning Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Jinning Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 唐晉甯縣，蒙氏、段氏皆為陽城堡部。

translations.literal: In the Tang it was Jinning County; under both the Meng and Duan clans it was the Yangcheng Fort Division.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang it was Jinning County; under both the Meng and Duan clans it formed the Yangcheng Fort Division.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗七年，立陽城堡萬戶。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Möngke the Yangcheng Fort myriarch office was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1257 the Yangcheng Fort myriarch office was established.

sentences.zh: 至元十二年，改晉寧州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan it was changed to Jinning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1275 it was renamed Jinning Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 領二縣：

translations.literal: It governed two counties:
translations.idiomatic: It governed two counties:

sentences.zh: 呈貢，下。

translations.literal: Chenggong, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Chenggong, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 西臨滇澤之濱，在路之南，州之北，其間相去六十里，有故城曰呈貢，世為些莫強宗邵蠻所居。

translations.literal: It borders the shore of Dian Marsh on the west; it lies south of the circuit and north of the prefecture, sixty li between them; there is an old city called Chenggong, for generations the dwelling place of the powerful Zong clan of the Xiemo and the Shao barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: On the western shore of Dian Marsh, sixty li between the circuit to the north and the prefecture to the south, stood the old city of Chenggong, long home to the powerful Zong clan of the Xiemo and Shao tribes.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗六年，立呈貢千戶。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Möngke the Chenggong chiliarch office was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1256 the Chenggong chiliarch office was established.

sentences.zh: 至元十二年，割詔營、切龍、呈貢、雌甸、塔羅、和羅忽六城及烏納山立呈貢縣。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan the six cities of Zhaoying, Qielong, Chenggong, Cidian, Taluo, and Heluohu and Wuna Mountain were carved out to establish Chenggong County.
translations.idiomatic: In 1275 Chenggong County was created from the six settlements of Zhaoying, Qielong, Chenggong, Cidian, Taluo, and Heluohu, together with Wuna Mountain.

sentences.zh: 歸化。

translations.literal: Guihua.
translations.idiomatic: Guihua.

sentences.zh: 下。

translations.literal: Lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower grade.

sentences.zh: 在州東北，呈貢縣南，西賓滇澤，地名大吳龍，昔吳氏所居，後為些莫徒蠻所有，世隸善闡。

translations.literal: It lies northeast of the prefecture, south of Chenggong County, facing Dian Marsh on the west; the place is called Dawulong; formerly the Wu clan dwelt here, later it was possessed by the Tuman of the Xiemo, for generations subordinate to Shanchan.
translations.idiomatic: Northeast of the prefecture and south of Chenggong County, facing Dian Marsh to the west, the place called Dawulong was once home to the Wu clan, later held by the Tuman branch of the Xiemo, who for generations were subject to Shanchan.

sentences.zh: 憲宗六年，分隸呈貢千戶。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Möngke it was separately attached to the Chenggong chiliarch office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1256 it was placed under the Chenggong chiliarch.

sentences.zh: 至元十二年，割大吳龍、安江、安淜立歸化縣。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan Dawulong, Anjiang, and Anming were carved out to establish Guihua County.
translations.idiomatic: In 1275 Guihua County was created from Dawulong, Anjiang, and Anming.

sentences.zh: 昆陽州，下。

translations.literal: Kunyang Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Kunyang Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 在滇池南，僰、獹雜夷所居，有城曰巨橋，今為州治。

translations.literal: It lies south of Dianchi; the Bo and various Yi peoples dwell here; there is a city called Juqiao, now the seat of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: South of Dianchi Lake, where Bo and various Yi peoples lived, the walled settlement of Juqiao serves as the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 閣羅鳳叛唐，令曲旂蠻居之。

translations.literal: When Geluofeng rebelled against the Tang, he ordered the Quqi barbarians to dwell here.
translations.idiomatic: After Geluofeng rebelled against the Tang, he resettled the Quqi tribe here.

sentences.zh: 段氏興，隸善闡。

translations.literal: When the Duan clan rose, it was subordinate to Shanchan.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Duan clan it was subject to Shanchan.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗並羅瑀等十二城，立巨橋萬戶。

translations.literal: Under Möngke the twelve cities including Luoyu were combined and the Juqiao myriarch office was established.
translations.idiomatic: Under Möngke, twelve cities including Luoyu were consolidated into the Juqiao myriarch office.

sentences.zh: 至元十三年，改昆陽州。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan it was changed to Kunyang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 it was renamed Kunyang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 領二縣：

translations.literal: It governed two counties:
translations.idiomatic: It governed two counties:

sentences.zh: 三泊，下。

translations.literal: Sanbo, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Sanbo, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 至元十三年，于那龍城立縣。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan a county was established at Nalong City.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 a county was established at Nalong City.

sentences.zh: 易門。

translations.literal: Yimen.
translations.idiomatic: Yimen.

sentences.zh: 下。

translations.literal: Lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower grade.

sentences.zh: 在州之西，治市坪村，世為烏蠻所居。

translations.literal: It lies west of the prefecture; its seat is Shiping Village; for generations the Wuman have dwelt here.
translations.idiomatic: West of the prefecture, administered from Shiping Village, this land had long been home to the Wuman.

sentences.zh: 段氏時，高智升治善闡，奄而有之。

translations.literal: In the time of the Duan clan, Gao Zhisheng governed Shanchan and encompassed this territory.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Duan clan, Gao Zhisheng, who ruled Shanchan, absorbed this territory.

sentences.zh: 至元四年，立洟門千戶。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhiyuan the Timen chiliarch office was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1267 the Timen chiliarch office was established.

sentences.zh: 十二年，改為縣。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year it was changed to a county.
translations.idiomatic: In 1275 it was converted to a county.

sentences.zh: 縣西有泉曰洟源。

translations.literal: West of the county there is a spring called Tiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: West of the county lies a spring called Tiyuan.

sentences.zh: 訛作易門。

translations.literal: Erroneously written as Yimen.
translations.idiomatic: The name was corrupted to Yimen.

sentences.zh: 安寧州，下。

translations.literal: Anning Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Anning Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 唐初置安寧縣，隸昆州。

translations.literal: In early Tang Anning County was established, subordinate to Kunzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Tang, Anning County was established under Kunzhou.

sentences.zh: 閣羅鳳叛唐後，烏、白蠻遷居。

translations.literal: After Geluofeng rebelled against the Tang, the Wuman and Baiman migrated and settled here.
translations.idiomatic: After Geluofeng's rebellion against the Tang, Wuman and Baiman settlers moved in.

sentences.zh: 蒙氏終，善闡酋孫氏為安寧城主，及袁氏、高氏互有其地。

translations.literal: When the Meng clan ended, the Shanchan chieftain of the Sun clan became lord of Anning City, and the Yuan and Gao clans each held parts of the territory.
translations.idiomatic: After the fall of the Meng clan, the Sun chieftain of Shanchan became lord of Anning City, while the Yuan and Gao clans held overlapping claims to the land.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗七年，隸陽城堡萬戶。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Möngke it was subordinate to the Yangcheng Fort myriarch office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1257 it came under the Yangcheng Fort myriarch.

sentences.zh: 至元三年，立安寧千戶。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhiyuan the Anning chiliarch office was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1266 the Anning chiliarch office was established.

sentences.zh: 十二年，改安寧州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year it was changed to Anning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1275 it was renamed Anning Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 領二縣：

translations.literal: It governed two counties:
translations.idiomatic: It governed two counties:

sentences.zh: 祿豐，下。

translations.literal: Lufeng, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lufeng, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 在州西，治白村，其地瘴熱，非大酋所居，惟烏、雜蠻居之，遷徙不常。

translations.literal: It lies west of the prefecture; its seat is Bai Village; the land is malarial and hot, not a dwelling place for great chieftains; only the Wuman and mixed barbarians dwell here, migrating without fixed abode.
translations.idiomatic: West of the prefecture, administered from Bai Village, the land was malarial and unsuited to major chieftains; only Wuman and mixed tribal groups lived there, moving about without permanent settlements.

sentences.zh: 至元十三年，割安寧千戶之碌琫、化泥、驥琮籠三處立祿豐縣。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan the three places of Lubeng, Huanai, and Jiconglong from the Anning chiliarch office were carved out to establish Lufeng County.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 Lufeng County was created from the three districts of Lubeng, Huanai, and Jiconglong, carved out of the Anning chiliarch territory.

sentences.zh: 因江中有石如甑，俗名碌琫，譯謂碌為石，琫為甑，訛為今名。

translations.literal: Because in the river there is a stone like a steamer, the common name is Lubeng; translated, lu means stone and beng means steamer, corrupted into the present name.
translations.idiomatic: A stone in the river shaped like a cooking pot gave the place its folk name Lubeng ('stone pot'); the characters were corrupted into the present name Lufeng.

sentences.zh: 羅次。

translations.literal: Luoci.
translations.idiomatic: Luoci County.

sentences.zh: 下。

translations.literal: Lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower grade.

sentences.zh: 在州北，治壓磨呂白村，本烏蠻羅部，地險俗悍。

translations.literal: It lies north of the prefecture; its seat is Yamolübai Village; originally the Lu division of the Wuman; the terrain is perilous and the customs fierce.
translations.idiomatic: North of the prefecture, administered from Yamolübai Village, this was the Lu branch of the Wuman tribes—a rugged land whose people were known for their fierce ways.

sentences.zh: 至元十二年，因羅部立羅次州，隸中慶路。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan, Luoci Prefecture was established from the Luo division and was subordinate to Zhongqing Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1275 Luoci Prefecture was created from the Luo tribe and placed under Zhongqing Circuit.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，改州為縣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, the prefecture was changed to a county.
translations.idiomatic: In 1287 it was reduced from prefecture to county.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，隸安寧州。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, it was subordinate to Anning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1290 it was placed under Anning Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 威楚開南等路，下。

translations.literal: Weichu, Ka'nan, and other circuits, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Weichu Circuit, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 為雜蠻耕牧之地，夷名俄碌，歷代無郡邑，後爨酋威楚築城俄碌睒居之。

translations.literal: It was a land where mixed barbarians farmed and herded; the Yi name was Elu; through the ages there were no commanderies or districts; later the Cuan chieftain Weichu built a city at Elushan and dwelt there.
translations.idiomatic: Mixed tribal peoples farmed and grazed here under the local name Elu. No administrative seats existed until the Cuan chieftain Weichu built a fortress at Elushan and made it his seat.

sentences.zh: 唐時蒙舍詔閣羅鳳合六詔為一，侵俄碌，取和子城，今鎮南州是也。

translations.literal: In Tang times Geluofeng of the Mengshe Zhao combined the six zhao into one, invaded Elu, and took Hezi City—this is present Zhennan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the Tang, Geluofeng of Mengshe united the six zhao, seized Elu, and captured Hezi City—the site of present-day Zhennan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 後閣羅鳳叛，於本境立郡縣，諸爨盡附。

translations.literal: Later Geluofeng rebelled, established commanderies and counties within his own territory, and all the Cuan submitted.
translations.idiomatic: When Geluofeng later rebelled, he founded commanderies and counties in his domain, and every Cuan group submitted to him.

sentences.zh: 蒙氏立二都督、六節度，銀生節度即今路也。

translations.literal: The Meng clan established two grand protectors and six military commissions; the Yinsheng Commission is the present circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Meng kingdom set up two protectorates and six military commissions; the Yinsheng Commission became this circuit.

sentences.zh: 及段氏興，銀生隸姚州，又名當箸驗。

translations.literal: When the Duan clan rose, Yinsheng was subordinate to Yaozhou and was also called Dangzhuyan.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Duan clan, Yinsheng fell under Yaozhou and was also known as Dangzhuyan.

sentences.zh: 及高升泰執大理國柄，封其侄子明量于威楚，築外城，號德江城，傳至其裔長壽。

translations.literal: When Gao Shengtai held the power of the Dali kingdom, he enfeoffed his nephew Mingliang at Weichu, built an outer city called Dejiang City, and the line passed to his descendant Changshou.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Shengtai seized control of Dali, he granted Weichu to his nephew Mingliang, who built an outer wall and named the settlement Dejiang; the line passed to his descendant Changshou.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗三年征大理，平之。

translations.literal: In the third year of Möngke the Yuan campaign against Dali pacified it.
translations.idiomatic: In 1253 the Mongols conquered Dali and brought it to submission.

sentences.zh: 六年，立威楚萬戶。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, the Weichu myriarch office was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1256 the Weichu myriarch was established.

sentences.zh: 至元八年，改威楚路，置總管府。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Zhiyuan it was changed to Weichu Circuit and a general administration bureau was set up.
translations.idiomatic: In 1271 it became Weichu Circuit with a general administration.

sentences.zh: 領縣二、州四。

translations.literal: It governed two counties and four prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: It administered two counties and four prefectures.

sentences.zh: 州領一縣。

translations.literal: Each prefecture governed one county.
translations.idiomatic: Each prefecture had one county under it.

sentences.zh: 本路軍民屯田共七千一百雙。

translations.literal: This circuit's military-civilian colony fields totaled seven thousand one hundred shuang.
translations.idiomatic: The circuit had 7,100 shuang of military-civilian colony land.

sentences.zh: 威楚，下。

translations.literal: Weichu, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Weichu, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 倚郭。

translations.literal: Attached to the seat of the circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Seat of the circuit administration.

sentences.zh: 至元十五年，升威州，仍立富民、淨樂二縣。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Zhiyuan Weizhou was upgraded, and Fumin and Jing'e counties were still established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1278 it was upgraded to Weizhou, with Fumin and Jing'e counties established.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，降州為威楚縣，革二縣為鄉來屬。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year the prefecture was reduced to Weichu County, the two counties were abolished and made townships attached to it.
translations.idiomatic: In 1284 it was demoted to Weichu County, and the two counties were abolished and reorganized as townships under its jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 定遠。

translations.literal: Dingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Dingyuan County.

sentences.zh: 下。

translations.literal: Lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower grade.

sentences.zh: 在路北，地名目直睒，雜蠻居之。

translations.literal: It lies north of the circuit; the place is called Muzhishan; mixed barbarians dwell there.
translations.idiomatic: North of the circuit seat at Muzhishan lived mixed tribal groups.

sentences.zh: 諸葛孔明征南中，經此睒，後號為牟州。

translations.literal: When Zhuge Kongming campaigned in the southern central region, he passed through this shan; later it was called Mouzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuge Liang's southern campaign passed through here, and the place was later known as Mouzhou.

sentences.zh: 唐蒙氏遣爨蠻酋抬萼鎮牟州，築城曰耐籠。

translations.literal: The Tang Meng clan sent the Cuan barbarian chieftain Taie to garrison Mouzhou and built a city called Nailong.
translations.idiomatic: The Meng kingdom posted Cuan chieftain Taie to garrison Mouzhou and built a fortress called Nailong.

sentences.zh: 至高氏專大理國政，命雲南些莫徒酋夷羨徙民二百戶于黃蓬阱，其抬萼故城隸高氏。

translations.literal: When the Gao clan monopolized Dali state affairs, they ordered the Yunnan Somotu chieftain Yixian to move two hundred households to Huangpengjing; Taie's old city was subordinate to the Gao clan.
translations.idiomatic: Once the Gao clan dominated Dali politics, they resettled two hundred households under Somotu chieftain Yixian at Huangpengjing, while Taie's former fortress fell under Gao control.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗四年，立牟州千戶，黃蓬阱為百戶。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Möngke the Mouzhou chiliarch office was established, and Huangpengjing became a century office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1254 the Mouzhou chiliarch and Huangpengjing century offices were set up.

sentences.zh: 至元十二年，改為定遠州，黃蓬阱為南寧縣，後革縣為鄉，改州為縣，隸本路。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan it was changed to Dingyuan Prefecture and Huangpengjing to Nanning County; later the county was abolished to a township, the prefecture changed to a county, and it was subordinate to this circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1275 it became Dingyuan Prefecture with Huangpengjing as Nanning County; the county was later abolished to a township, the prefecture reduced to a county under this circuit.

sentences.zh: 鎮南州，下。

translations.literal: Zhennan Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Zhennan Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 州在路北，昔樸、落蠻所居。

translations.literal: The prefecture is north of the circuit; formerly the Pu and Luo barbarians dwelt there.
translations.idiomatic: North of the circuit seat, once home to the Pu and Luo tribes.

sentences.zh: 川名欠舍，中有城曰雞和。

translations.literal: The valley is called Qianshe; within it is a city called Jihe.
translations.idiomatic: The Qianshe valley held a fortress called Jihe.

sentences.zh: 至唐時，蒙氏並六詔，征東蠻，取和子、雞和二城，置石鼓縣，又于沙卻置俗富郡。

translations.literal: By Tang times the Meng clan united the six zhao, campaigned against the eastern barbarians, took Hezi and Jihe cities, established Shigu County, and at Shaqi set up Sufu Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang, the Meng kingdom united the six zhao, conquered the eastern tribes, seized Hezi and Jihe, created Shigu County, and established Sufu Commandery at Shaqi.

sentences.zh: 沙卻即今州治。

translations.literal: Shaqi is the present prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: The prefectural government is at Shaqi.

sentences.zh: 至段氏封高明量為楚公，欠舍、沙卻皆隸之。

translations.literal: When the Duan clan enfeoffed Gao Mingliang as Duke of Chu, Qianshe and Shaqi were both subordinate to him.
translations.idiomatic: The Duan clan made Gao Mingliang Duke of Chu, with Qianshe and Shaqi under his authority.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗三年，其酋內附。

translations.literal: In the third year of Möngke its chieftain submitted from within.
translations.idiomatic: In 1253 its chieftain submitted to the Mongols.

sentences.zh: 七年，立欠舍千戶、石鼓百戶。

translations.literal: In the seventh year the Qianshe chiliarch and Shigu century offices were established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1257 the Qianshe chiliarch and Shigu century offices were set up.

sentences.zh: 至元二十二年，改欠舍千戶為鎮南州，立定邊、石鼓二縣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year of Zhiyuan the Qianshe chiliarch was changed to Zhennan Prefecture, establishing Dingbian and Shigu counties.
translations.idiomatic: In 1285 Qianshe was upgraded to Zhennan Prefecture, with Dingbian and Shigu counties created.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，革二縣為鄉，仍隸本州。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year the two counties were abolished to townships, still subordinate to this prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1287 the two counties were abolished and made townships under this prefecture.

sentences.zh: 南安州，下。

translations.literal: Nan'an Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Nan'an Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 州在路東南，山嶺稠疊，內一峰竦秀，林麓四周，其頂有泉。

translations.literal: The prefecture is southeast of the circuit; ridges are densely layered; within, one peak towers gracefully, forested slopes surround it on all sides, and there is a spring on its summit.
translations.idiomatic: Southeast of the circuit, amid densely stacked ridges, a lone peak rose with forested slopes and a spring at its summit.

sentences.zh: 昔黑爨蠻祖瓦晟吳立柵居其上，子孫漸盛，不隸他部，至高氏封威楚方隸焉。

translations.literal: Formerly the Black Cuan barbarian ancestor Washeng Wu established a stockade and dwelt atop it; his descendants gradually flourished and were not subordinate to other divisions; only when the Gao clan enfeoffed Weichu did they become subordinate.
translations.idiomatic: The Black Cuan ancestor Washeng Wu once built a stockade on the peak; his line grew strong and remained independent until the Gao enfeoffment at Weichu brought them under authority.

sentences.zh: 憲宗立摩芻千戶，隸威楚萬戶。

translations.literal: Möngke established the Mochu chiliarch office, subordinate to the Weichu myriarch.
translations.idiomatic: Under Möngke the Mochu chiliarch was established under the Weichu myriarch.

sentences.zh: 至元十二年，改千戶為南安州，隸本路。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan the chiliarch was changed to Nan'an Prefecture, subordinate to this circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1275 the chiliarch was converted to Nan'an Prefecture under this circuit.

sentences.zh: 領一縣：

translations.literal: It governs one county:
translations.idiomatic: It administered one county:

sentences.zh: 廣通。

translations.literal: Guangtong.
translations.idiomatic: Guangtong County.

sentences.zh: 下。

translations.literal: Lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower grade.

sentences.zh: 縣在州之北，夷名為路睒，雜蠻居之。

translations.literal: The county is north of the prefecture; the Yi name is Lushan; mixed barbarians dwell there.
translations.idiomatic: North of the prefecture, at Lushan, lived mixed tribal peoples.

sentences.zh: 南詔閣羅鳳曾立路睒縣，至段氏封高明量于威楚，其後宜州酋些莫徒裔易裒等附之，至高長壽遂處於路睒，易裒去舊堡二十里，山上築城白龍戲新柵。

translations.literal: Geluofeng of Nanzhao once established Lushan County; when the Duan clan enfeoffed Gao Mingliang at Weichu, afterward Yizhou chieftain Somotu descendant Yipou and others attached to him; when Gao Changshou then resided at Lushan, Yipou left his old fort twenty li and built a city on the mountain called Bailongxi Xinzhai.
translations.idiomatic: Geluofeng of Nanzhao once created Lushan County. Under the Duan, when Gao Mingliang held Weichu, Somotu chieftain Yipou and others joined him. Gao Changshou later settled at Lushan, while Yipou moved twenty li from his old fort to build Xinzhai fortress on a hill called Bailongxi.

sentences.zh: 憲宗七年，長壽內附，立路睒千户。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Möngke Changshou submitted from within, and the Lushan chiliarch office was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1257 Changshou submitted to the Mongols and the Lushan chiliarch was established.

sentences.zh: 至元十二年改為廣通縣，隸南安州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan it was changed to Guangtong County, subordinate to Nan'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1275 it became Guangtong County under Nan'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 開南州，下。

translations.literal: Ka'nan Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Ka'nan Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 州在路西南，其川分十二甸，昔樸、和泥二蠻所居也。

translations.literal: The prefecture is southwest of the circuit; its valleys divide into twelve dian; formerly the Pu and Heni barbarians dwelt there.
translations.idiomatic: Southwest of the circuit, its valleys divided into twelve dian where the Pu and Heni tribes once lived.

sentences.zh: 莊皃王滇池，漢武開西南夷，諸葛孔明定益州，皆未嘗涉其境。

translations.literal: From King Zhuangmao of Dian Lake through Emperor Wu's opening of the Southwestern Yi and Zhuge Kongming's pacification of Yizhou, none had ever entered its territory.
translations.idiomatic: From the legendary King Zhuangmao of Dian Lake through Emperor Wu's opening of the Southwestern Yi and Zhuge Liang's pacification of Yizhou, none had ever entered this territory.

sentences.zh: 至蒙氏興，立銀生府，後為金齒、白蠻所陷，移府治于威楚，開南遂為生蠻所據。

translations.literal: When the Meng clan rose, the Yinsheng prefecture was established; later it was overrun by the Jinci and Baiman, the prefectural seat was moved to Weichu, and Ka'nan was then occupied by the Shengman.
translations.idiomatic: When the Meng kingdom rose, it established Yinsheng Prefecture; after Jinci and Baiman tribes overran it, the seat moved to Weichu, and Ka'nan fell to the Shengman.

sentences.zh: 自南詔至段氏，皆為徼外荒僻之地。

translations.literal: From Nanzhao through the Duan clan, it was all a remote and desolate land beyond the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: From Nanzhao through the Duan dynasty, the region remained a remote frontier wilderness.

sentences.zh: 元中統三年平之，以所部隸威楚萬戶。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhongtong under the Yuan it was pacified, and its divisions were subordinate to the Weichu myriarch.
translations.idiomatic: In 1262 the Yuan pacified the region and placed its divisions under the Weichu myriarch.

sentences.zh: 至元十二年，改為開南州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan it was changed to Ka'nan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1275 it became Ka'nan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 威遠州，下。

translations.literal: Weiyuan Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Weiyuan Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 州在開南州西南，其川有六，昔撲、和泥二蠻所居。

translations.literal: The prefecture is southwest of Ka'nan Prefecture; its valleys number six; formerly the Pu and Heni barbarians dwelt there.
translations.idiomatic: Southwest of Ka'nan Prefecture, its six valleys were once home to the Pu and Heni tribes.

sentences.zh: 至蒙氏興，開威楚為郡，而州境始通。

translations.literal: When the Meng clan rose, Weichu was opened as a commandery, and only then did the prefecture's territory become accessible.
translations.idiomatic: When the Meng kingdom rose and opened Weichu as a commandery, this region first came within reach of the administrative network.

sentences.zh: 其後金齒、白夷蠻酋阿只步等奪其地。

translations.literal: Afterward the Jinci and Baiyi barbarian chieftains Azhibu and others seized its territory.
translations.idiomatic: Later Jinci and Baiyi chieftains such as Azhibu seized the land.

sentences.zh: 中統三年征之，悉降。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhongtong it was campaigned against, and all submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In 1262 a campaign against them brought complete submission.

sentences.zh: 至元十二年，立開南州及威遠州，隸威楚路。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan Ka'nan Prefecture and Weiyuan Prefecture were established, subordinate to Weichu Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1275 Ka'nan and Weiyuan prefectures were established under Weichu Circuit.

sentences.zh: 武定路軍民府，下。

translations.literal: Wuding Circuit Military-Civilian Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Wuding Circuit Military and Civilian Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 唐隸姚州，在滇北，昔獹鹿等蠻居之。

translations.literal: Under the Tang it was subordinate to Yaozhou; it lies in northern Dian; formerly the Juolu and other barbarians dwelt there.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang it fell under Yaozhou in northern Yunnan, where the Juolu and other tribes once lived.

sentences.zh: 至段氏使烏蠻阿舟治納洟胒共龍城於共甸，又築城名曰易龍，其裔孫法瓦浸盛，以其遠祖羅婺為部名。

translations.literal: When the Duan clan had the Wuman Azou govern Nazhinigong Long City at Gongdian, also built a city called Yilong; his descendant Fawa gradually flourished and took his remote ancestor Luowu as the division name.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Duan, Wuman leader Azou built Long City at Nazhinigong in Gongdian and another fortress called Yilong. His descendant Fawa grew powerful and took the name of their ancestor Luowu for the tribal division.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗四年內附。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Möngke it submitted from within.
translations.idiomatic: In 1254 it submitted to the Mongols.

sentences.zh: 七年，立為萬戶，隸威楚。

translations.literal: In the seventh year it was established as a myriarch office, subordinate to Weichu.
translations.idiomatic: In 1257 it was established as a myriarch under Weichu.

sentences.zh: 至元八年，並仁德、於矢入本部為北路。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Zhiyuan Rend and Yushi were merged into this headquarters as the Northern Route.
translations.idiomatic: In 1271 Rende and Yushi were merged into the headquarters as the Northern Route.

sentences.zh: 十二年，割出二部，改本路為武定。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year the two divisions were carved out, and this circuit was changed to Wuding.
translations.idiomatic: In 1275 the two divisions were separated and the circuit was renamed Wuding.

sentences.zh: 領州二。

translations.literal: It governs two prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: It administered two prefectures.

sentences.zh: 州領四縣。

translations.literal: The prefectures govern four counties.
translations.idiomatic: Its prefectures together administered four counties.

sentences.zh: 本路屯田七百四十八雙。

translations.literal: This circuit's colony fields number seven hundred forty-eight shuang.
translations.idiomatic: The circuit had 748 shuang of colony land.

sentences.zh: 和曲州，下。

translations.literal: Hequ Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Hequ Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 州在路西南，蠻名叵簉甸，僰、𤡊諸種蠻所居。

translations.literal: The prefecture is southwest of the circuit; the barbarian name is Pokedian; the Bo, Lu, and various barbarian peoples dwell there.
translations.idiomatic: Southwest of the circuit at Pokedian lived the Bo, Lu, and other tribal groups.

sentences.zh: 地多漢冢，或謂漢人曾居。

translations.literal: The land has many Han tombs; some say Han people once dwelt there.
translations.idiomatic: Numerous Han tombs led some to believe Chinese settlers had once lived there.

sentences.zh: 蒙氏時，白蠻據其地，至段氏以烏蠻阿𠠝併吞諸蠻聚落三十餘處，分兄弟子姪治之，皆隸羅婺部。

translations.literal: In the time of the Meng clan the Baiman held its territory; when the Duan clan came, the Wuman A Lie annexed more than thirty barbarian settlements, assigning brothers, sons, and nephews to govern them, all subordinate to the Luowu division.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Meng, Baiman tribes held the land; under the Duan, Wuman leader A Lie absorbed more than thirty tribal settlements, assigning kinsmen to govern them under the Luowu division.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗六年，改叵簉甸曰和曲。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Möngke Pokedian was changed to Hequ.
translations.idiomatic: In 1256 Pokedian was renamed Hequ.

sentences.zh: 至元二十六年，升為州。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year of Zhiyuan it was upgraded to a prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1289 it was upgraded to prefecture status.

sentences.zh: 領二縣：

translations.literal: It governs two counties:
translations.idiomatic: It administered two counties:

sentences.zh: 南甸，下。

translations.literal: Nandian, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Nandian, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 路治本縣，蠻曰瀼甸，又稱洟陬籠。

translations.literal: The circuit seat is in this county; the barbarians call it Rangdian, also called Tizoulung.
translations.idiomatic: The circuit seat lay in this county, known to locals as Rangdian or Tizoulung.

sentences.zh: 至元二十六年改為縣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year of Zhiyuan it was changed to a county.
translations.idiomatic: In 1289 it was established as a county.

sentences.zh: 元謀。

translations.literal: Yuanmou.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanmou County.

sentences.zh: 下。

translations.literal: Lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower grade.

sentences.zh: 夷中舊名環州，元治五甸，至元十六年改為縣。

translations.literal: Among the Yi the old name was Huanzhou; under the Yuan it governed five dian; in the sixteenth year of Zhiyuan it was changed to a county.
translations.idiomatic: Locals once called it Huanzhou; under the Yuan it governed five dian, and in 1279 it became a county.

sentences.zh: 祿勸州，下。

translations.literal: Luquan Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Luquan Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 州在路東北，甸名洪農碌券，雜蠻居之，無郡所。

translations.literal: The prefecture is northeast of the circuit; the dian is called Hongnongluquan; mixed barbarians dwell there; there was no commandery seat.
translations.idiomatic: Northeast of the circuit at Hongnongluquan lived mixed tribal peoples with no prior administrative seat.

sentences.zh: 至元二十六年，立祿勸州。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year of Zhiyuan Luquan Prefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1289 Luquan Prefecture was established.

sentences.zh: 領二縣：

translations.literal: It governs two counties:
translations.idiomatic: It administered two counties:

sentences.zh: 易籠，下。

translations.literal: Yilong, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Yilong, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 易籠者，城名，在州北，地名倍場。

translations.literal: Yilong is a city name; it lies north of the prefecture; the place is called Beichang.
translations.idiomatic: Yilong was a fortress name; north of the prefecture at a place called Beichang.

sentences.zh: 縣境有二水，蠻語謂洟為水，籠為城，因此為名。

translations.literal: Within the county territory are two waters; in barbarian speech ti means water and long means city, hence the name.
translations.idiomatic: Two streams ran through the county; in the local language ti meant water and long meant fortress, giving the place its name.

sentences.zh: 昔羅婺部大酋居之，為群酋會集之所。

translations.literal: Formerly the great chieftain of the Luowu division dwelt there; it was a place where chieftains assembled.
translations.idiomatic: The great chieftain of the Luowu division once lived here, and it served as a gathering place for tribal leaders.

sentences.zh: 至元二十六年，立縣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year of Zhiyuan the county was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1289 the county was established.

sentences.zh: 石舊。

translations.literal: Shijiu.
translations.idiomatic: Shijiu County.

sentences.zh: 下。

translations.literal: Lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower grade.

sentences.zh: 縣在州東，有四甸：曰掌鳩，曰法塊，曰抹撚，曰曲蔽。

translations.literal: The county lies east of the prefecture and has four dian: called Zhangjiu, called Fakuai, called Monian, and called Qubi.
translations.idiomatic: East of the prefecture, the county comprised four tribal districts: Zhangjiu, Fakuai, Monian, and Qubi.

sentences.zh: 掌鳩甸有溪繞其三面，凡數十渡，故名，今訛名石舊。

translations.literal: The Zhangjiu dian has a stream winding around three sides; altogether there are several tens of fords, hence the name; now it is erroneously called Shijiu.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhangjiu district a stream wrapped three sides of the land with dozens of fords, giving the place its name; the name was later corrupted to Shijiu.

sentences.zh: 至元二十六年，立縣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year of Zhiyuan the county was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1289 the county was established.

sentences.zh: 鶴慶路軍民府，下。

translations.literal: Heqing Circuit Military-Civilian Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Heqing Circuit Military and Civilian Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 府治在麗江路東南，大理路東北，夷名其地曰鶴川、樣共。

translations.literal: The prefectural seat lies southeast of Lijiang Circuit and northeast of Dali Circuit; in barbarian speech the land is called Hechuan and Yanggong.
translations.idiomatic: The seat stood southeast of Lijiang Circuit and northeast of Dali Circuit, known in the local language as Hechuan and Yanggong.

sentences.zh: 昔隸越析詔，漢、唐未建城邑。

translations.literal: Formerly it was subordinate to the Yuexi zhao; in Han and Tang no walled cities or towns were established.
translations.idiomatic: It had belonged to the Yuexi zhao, and through the Han and Tang dynasties no cities or towns had been built there.

sentences.zh: 開元末，閣羅鳳合六詔為一，稱南詔，徙治羊苴城，地近龍尾、鶴柘，今府即其地也。

translations.literal: At the end of the Kaiyuan era Geluofeng united the six zhao into one and called it Nanzhao; he moved the seat to Yangju City — the land lay near Longwei and Hezhe — and the present prefecture is that same place.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Kaiyuan reign Geluofeng united the six zhao into Nanzhao and relocated the capital to Yangju City near Longwei and Hezhe, the site of the present prefecture.

sentences.zh: 大和中，蒙勸封祐於樣共立謀統郡。

translations.literal: In the Dahe era Mengquan Fengyou established Moutong Commandery at Yanggong.
translations.idiomatic: During the Dahe reign Mengquan Fengyou founded Moutong Commandery at Yanggong.

sentences.zh: 蒙氏後，經數姓如故。

translations.literal: After the Meng clan, it passed through several surnames as before.
translations.idiomatic: After the Meng line ended, rule passed through several other lineages unchanged.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗三年內附，為鶴州。

translations.literal: In the third year of Möngke it submitted from within and became He Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1253 it submitted to the Mongols and was made He Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 七年，立二千戶，仍稱謀統，隸大理上萬戶。

translations.literal: In the seventh year a two-thousand-household office was established; it was still called Moutong and was subordinate to the Upper Dali myriarch office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1257 a two-thousand-household office was set up, still under the name Moutong and subordinate to the Upper Dali myriarch.

sentences.zh: 至元十一年，罷謀統千戶，復為鶴州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Zhiyuan the Moutong chiliarch office was abolished and it again became He Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1274 the Moutong chiliarch was abolished and the region reverted to He Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十年，為燕王分地，隸行省。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year it became a territorial allotment for the Prince of Yan and was subordinate to the Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In 1283 it was assigned as a fief of the Prince of Yan and placed under the Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，升為鶴慶府。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year it was upgraded to Heqing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1286 it was upgraded to Heqing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 領一縣：

translations.literal: It governs one county:
translations.idiomatic: It administered one county:

sentences.zh: 劍川。

translations.literal: Jianchuan.
translations.idiomatic: Jianchuan County.

sentences.zh: 下。

translations.literal: Lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower grade.

sentences.zh: 縣治在劍川湖西，夷雲羅魯城。

translations.literal: The county seat lies west of Jianchuan Lake; in barbarian speech it is called Yunluo Fort.
translations.idiomatic: The seat stood west of Jianchuan Lake at Yunluo Fort in the local language.

sentences.zh: 按《唐史》南詔有六節度，劍川其一也。

translations.literal: According to the History of Tang, Nanzhao had six military commissions; Jianchuan was one of them.
translations.idiomatic: The History of Tang records six Nanzhao military commissions, of which Jianchuan was one.

sentences.zh: 初蒙氏未合六詔時，有浪穹詔與南詔戰，不勝，遂保劍川，更稱劍浪。

translations.literal: When the Meng clan had not yet united the six zhao, the Langqiong zhao fought with Nanzhao, was not victorious, thereupon held to Jianchuan, and changed its name to Jianlang.
translations.idiomatic: Before the Meng clan united the six zhao, the Langqiong zhao fought Nanzhao and, defeated, withdrew to Jianchuan and took the name Jianlang.

sentences.zh: 貞元中，南詔擊破之，奪劍、共諸川地，其酋徙居劍睒西北四百里，號劍羌。

translations.literal: In the Zhenyuan era Nanzhao struck and shattered them, seized the lands of Jian and Gong and their various valleys; their chieftain moved to dwell four hundred li northwest of Jianshan and called himself the Jian Qiang.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhenyuan reign Nanzhao crushed them, took the valleys of Jian and Gong, and their chief resettled four hundred li northwest of Jianshan under the title Jian Qiang.

sentences.zh: 蒙氏終，至段氏，改劍川為義督瞼。

translations.literal: When the Meng clan ended and the Duan clan came, Jianchuan was changed to Yidu lien.
translations.idiomatic: When the Meng line gave way to the Duan, Jianchuan was renamed Yidu lien.

sentences.zh: 憲宗四年內附。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Möngke it submitted from within.
translations.idiomatic: In 1254 it submitted to the Mongols.

sentences.zh: 七年，立義督千戶。

translations.literal: In the seventh year the Yidu chiliarch office was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1257 the Yidu chiliarch was established.

sentences.zh: 至元十一年，罷千戶，立劍川縣，隸鶴州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Zhiyuan the chiliarch office was abolished, Jianchuan County was established, subordinate to He Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1274 the chiliarch was abolished and Jianchuan County was created under He Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 軍民屯田共一千餘雙。

translations.literal: Military-civilian colony fields totaled more than one thousand shuang.
translations.idiomatic: Military-civilian colony land totaled over 1,000 shuang.

sentences.zh: 雲遠路軍民總管府，元貞二年置。

translations.literal: The Yunyuan Circuit Military-Civilian General Administration, established in the second year of Yuanzhen.
translations.idiomatic: The Yunyuan Circuit Military and Civilian General Administration was established in 1296.

sentences.zh: 徹裏軍民總管府，大德中置。

translations.literal: The Chelai Military-Civilian General Administration, established in the Dade era.
translations.idiomatic: The Chelai Military and Civilian General Administration was established during the Dade reign.

sentences.zh: 大德中，雲南省言：「大徹裏地與八百媳婦犬牙相錯，勢均力敵。

translations.literal: In the Dade era the Yunnan Province said: "The lands of Greater Chelai and Babai Xifu are interlocked like the teeth of a dog and a comb, and their strength is evenly matched.
translations.idiomatic: During the Dade reign Yunnan Province reported: "Greater Chelai and Babai Xifu were interlocked like dogteeth and their strength was evenly matched.

sentences.zh: 今大徹裏胡念已降，小徹裏復控扼地利，多相殺掠，胡念日與相拒，不得離，遣其弟胡倫入朝，指畫地形，乞別立徹裏軍民宣撫司，擇通習蠻夷情狀者為之帥，招其來附，以為進取之地。」

translations.literal: Now Greater Chelai Hunian has already submitted; Lesser Chelai again holds strategic terrain and mutual killing and plunder are frequent; Hunian daily contends against them and cannot leave; he sent his younger brother Hunlun to court to trace and describe the terrain and requested that a separate Chelai military-civilian pacification commission be established, with one versed in barbarian and Yi conditions chosen as commander, to summon them to submit and make it a base for advance."
translations.idiomatic: Greater Chelai under Hunian had surrendered, but Lesser Chelai still held advantageous ground and raiding was constant; Hunian fought them daily and could not leave, so he sent his brother Hunlun to court with a map and asked for a separate Chelai military-civilian pacification commission under a commander who knew the tribal peoples and Yi, to win submission and provide a foothold for further advances."

sentences.zh: 乃立徹裏軍民總管府。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Chelai Military-Civilian General Administration was established.
translations.idiomatic: The court then established the Chelai Military and Civilian General Administration.

sentences.zh: 廣南西路宣撫司。

translations.literal: The Guangnan West Circuit Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangnan West Circuit Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 闕。

translations.literal: Lacuna.
translations.idiomatic: The text is missing.

sentences.zh: 麗江路軍民宣撫司，路因江為名，謂金沙江出沙金，故云。

translations.literal: The Lijiang Circuit Military-Civilian Pacification Commission — the circuit takes its name from the river, meaning that the Jinsha River yields river gold, hence the name.
translations.idiomatic: The Lijiang Circuit Military and Civilian Pacification Commission was named for the river, the Jinsha said to yield gold-bearing sand.

sentences.zh: 源出吐蕃界。

translations.literal: Its source issues from the Tibetan borderlands.
translations.idiomatic: Its headwaters rose in the Tibetan frontier.

sentences.zh: 今麗江即古麗水，兩漢至隋、唐皆為越巂郡西徼地，昔麼蠻、些蠻居之，遂為越析詔。

translations.literal: Present Lijiang is the ancient Lishui; from the two Han dynasties through Sui and Tang all was the western marchland of Yuexi Commandery; formerly the Mo and Suo tribes dwelt there, and it became the Yuexi zhao.
translations.idiomatic: Lijiang was ancient Lishui, the western frontier of Yuexi Commandery from Han through Tang, where Mo and Suo tribes lived and formed the Yuexi zhao.

sentences.zh: 二部皆烏蠻種，居鐵橋。

translations.literal: Both divisions were of Wuman stock and dwelt at Iron Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: Both were Black Man tribes living at Iron Bridge.

sentences.zh: 貞元中，其地歸南詔。

translations.literal: In the Zhenyuan era its land returned to Nanzhao.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhenyuan reign the region came under Nanzhao.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗三年，征大理，從金沙濟江，麼、些負固不服。

translations.literal: In the third year of Möngke the Yuan campaign against Dali crossed the Jinsha and forded the river; the Mo and Suo held firm and would not submit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1253, campaigning against Dali, the Mongols crossed the Jinsha at a ford; the Mo and Suo held out stubbornly.

sentences.zh: 四年春，平之，立茶罕章管民官。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year it was pacified and the Chahan Zhang civilian administration was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of 1254 they were pacified and a Chahan Zhang civilian office was set up.

sentences.zh: 至元八年，立宣慰司。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Zhiyuan the Pacification Commission was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1271 a Pacification Commission was established.

sentences.zh: 十三年，改為麗江路，立軍民總管府。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year it was changed to Lijiang Circuit and the Military-Civilian General Administration was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 it became Lijiang Circuit with a Military and Civilian General Administration.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，府罷，于通安、巨津之間立宣撫司。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year the prefectural administration was abolished and a Pacification Commission was established between Tong'an and Jujin.
translations.idiomatic: In 1285 the general administration was abolished and a Pacification Commission was placed between Tong'an and Jujin.

sentences.zh: 領府一、州七。

translations.literal: It governs one prefecture and seven prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: It administered one prefecture and seven subordinate prefectures.

sentences.zh: 州領一縣。

translations.literal: Each prefecture governs one county.
translations.idiomatic: Each subordinate prefecture administered one county.

sentences.zh: 北勝府，在麗江之東。

translations.literal: Beisheng Prefecture lies east of Lijiang.
translations.idiomatic: Beisheng Prefecture stood east of Lijiang.

sentences.zh: 唐南詔時，鐵橋西北有施蠻者，貞元中為異牟尋所破，遷其種居之，號劍羌，名其地曰成偈睒，又改名善巨郡。

translations.literal: In Tang during Nanzhao there were the She tribes northwest of Iron Bridge; in the Zhenyuan era Yimouxun shattered them and relocated their kind to dwell there, calling them Jian Qiang; he named the land Chengjieshan, then again changed the name to Shanjun Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: During Tang Nanzhao times northwest of Iron Bridge lived the She tribes; Yimouxun defeated them in the Zhenyuan reign and resettled them there as the Jian Qiang at a place called Chengjieshan, later renamed Shanjun Commandery.

sentences.zh: 蒙氏終，段氏時，高智升使其孫高大惠鎮此郡。

translations.literal: When the Meng clan ended, in Duan clan times Gao Zhisheng sent his grandson Gao Dayihui to garrison this commandery.
translations.idiomatic: After the Meng line, under the Duan, Gao Zhisheng stationed his grandson Gao Dayihui to hold the commandery.

sentences.zh: 後隸大理。

translations.literal: Later it was subordinate to Dali.
translations.idiomatic: It later came under Dali.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗三年，其酋高俊內附。

translations.literal: In the third year of Möngke its chieftain Gao Jun submitted from within.
translations.idiomatic: In 1253 its chieftain Gao Jun submitted to the Mongols.

sentences.zh: 至元十五年，立為施州。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Zhiyuan it was established as Shi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1278 it was established as Shi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十七年，改為北勝州。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year it was changed to Beisheng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1280 it was renamed Beisheng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十年，升為府。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year it was upgraded to a prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1283 it was upgraded to prefecture status.

sentences.zh: 順州，在麗江之東，俗名牛睒。

translations.literal: Shun Prefecture lies east of Lijiang; its popular name is Niushan.
translations.idiomatic: Shun Prefecture lay east of Lijiang, commonly called Niushan.

sentences.zh: 昔順蠻種居劍、共川。

translations.literal: Formerly the Shun tribal stock dwelt in the valleys of Jian and Gong.
translations.idiomatic: The Shun tribe once lived in the Jian and Gong valleys.

sentences.zh: 唐貞元間，南詔異牟尋破之，徙居鐵橋、大婆、小婆、三探覽等川。

translations.literal: Between the Zhenyuan years of Tang, Nanzhao's Yimouxun shattered them and they were relocated to dwell in the valleys of Iron Bridge, Dapo, Xiaopo, Santanlan, and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhenyuan era Yimouxun of Nanzhao defeated them and resettled them along Iron Bridge, Dapo, Xiaopo, Santanlan, and neighboring valleys.

sentences.zh: 其酋成鬥族漸盛，自為一部，遷于牛睒。

translations.literal: Their chieftain the Chengdu clan gradually grew strong, became a division of its own, and moved to Niushan.
translations.idiomatic: The Chengdu chieftain line grew powerful, formed an independent division, and moved to Niushan.

sentences.zh: 至十三世孫自瞠猶隸大理。

translations.literal: Down to the thirteenth-generation descendant Zichang it was still subordinate to Dali.
translations.idiomatic: Through the thirteenth-generation descendant Zichang it remained under Dali.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗三年內附。

translations.literal: In the third year of Möngke it submitted from within.
translations.idiomatic: In 1253 it submitted to the Mongols.

sentences.zh: 至元十五年，改牛睒為順州。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Zhiyuan Niushan was changed to Shun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1278 Niushan was renamed Shun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 蒗蕖州，治羅共睒。

translations.literal: Langqu Prefecture; its seat is at Luogongshan.
translations.idiomatic: Langqu Prefecture, seated at Luogongshan.

sentences.zh: 在麗江之東，北勝、永寧南北之間，羅落、麼、些三種蠻世居之。

translations.literal: It lies east of Lijiang, between Beisheng and Yongning north and south; the Luoluo, Mo, and Suo — three kinds of barbarians — have dwelt there for generations.
translations.idiomatic: East of Lijiang between Beisheng and Yongning, Luoluo, Mo, and Suo tribes had lived for generations.

sentences.zh: 憲宗三年，征大理。

translations.literal: In the third year of Möngke Dali was campaigned against.
translations.idiomatic: In 1253 the campaign against Dali was launched.

sentences.zh: 至元九年內附。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Zhiyuan it submitted from within.
translations.idiomatic: In 1272 it submitted to the Mongols.

sentences.zh: 十六年，改羅共睒為蒗蕖州。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year Luogongshan was changed to Langqu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1279 Luogongshan was renamed Langqu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 永寧州，昔名樓頭睒。

translations.literal: Yongning Prefecture; formerly it was called Loutoushan.
translations.idiomatic: Yongning Prefecture was formerly called Loutoushan.

sentences.zh: 接吐蕃東徼，地名答藍，麼、些蠻祖泥月烏逐出吐蕃，遂居此睒。

translations.literal: It adjoins the eastern march of Tibet; the place is called Dalan; the Mo and Suo barbarians' ancestor Niyuewu was driven out of Tibet and thereupon dwelt in this shan.
translations.idiomatic: On Tibet's eastern frontier at a place called Dalan, the Mo and Suo tribes' ancestor Niyuewu was expelled from Tibet and settled there.

sentences.zh: 世屬大理。

translations.literal: For generations it belonged to Dali.
translations.idiomatic: For generations it had belonged to Dali.

sentences.zh: 憲宗三年，其三十一世孫和字內附。

translations.literal: In the third year of Möngke its thirty-first-generation descendant Hezi submitted from within.
translations.idiomatic: In 1253 its thirty-first-generation descendant Hezi submitted to the Mongols.

sentences.zh: 至元十六年，改為州。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Zhiyuan it was changed to a prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1279 it was established as a prefecture.

sentences.zh: 通安州，治在麗江之東，雪山之下。

translations.literal: Tong'an Prefecture; its seat lies east of Lijiang, below Snow Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Tong'an Prefecture lay east of Lijiang beneath Snow Mountain.

sentences.zh: 昔名三睒。

translations.literal: Formerly it was called Sanshan.
translations.idiomatic: It was formerly called Sanshan.

sentences.zh: 僕繲蠻所居，其後麼、些蠻葉古乍奪而有之，世隸大理。

translations.literal: The Puxie barbarians dwelt there; afterward the Mo and Suo barbarian Yeguzha seized and held it, and for generations it was subordinate to Dali.
translations.idiomatic: The Puxie tribe once lived there until the Mo-Suo chieftain Yeguzha seized it; for generations it had belonged to Dali.

sentences.zh: 憲宗三年，其二十三世孫麥良內附。

translations.literal: In the third year of Möngke its twenty-third-generation descendant Mailiang submitted from within.
translations.idiomatic: In 1253 its twenty-third-generation descendant Mailiang submitted to the Mongols.

sentences.zh: 中統四年，以麥良為察罕章管民官。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhongtong Mailiang was made the Chahan Zhang civilian administrator.
translations.idiomatic: In 1263 Mailiang was appointed Chahan Zhang civilian administrator.

sentences.zh: 至元九年，其子麥兀襲父職。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Zhiyuan his son Maiwu inherited his father's office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1272 his son Maiwu succeeded to his father's post.

sentences.zh: 十四年，改三睒為通安州。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year Sanshan was changed to Tong'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1277 Sanshan was renamed Tong'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 蘭州，在蘭滄水之東。

translations.literal: Lan Prefecture lies east of the Lancang River.
translations.idiomatic: Lan Prefecture stood east of the Lancang River.

sentences.zh: 漢永平中始通博南山道，渡蘭滄水，置博南縣。

translations.literal: In the Yongping era of Han the Bonan Mountain road was first opened, the Lancang was forded, and Bonan County was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yongping reign of Han the Bonan Mountain route was opened, the Lancang crossed, and Bonan County established.

sentences.zh: 唐為盧鹿蠻部。

translations.literal: In Tang it was the territory of the Lulu barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: In Tang it belonged to the Lulu tribe.

sentences.zh: 至段氏時，置蘭溪郡，隸大理。

translations.literal: In Duan clan times Lanxi Commandery was established, subordinate to Dali.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Duan it became Lanxi Commandery under Dali.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗四年內附，隸茶罕章管民官。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Möngke it submitted from within and was subordinate to the Chahan Zhang civilian administrator.
translations.idiomatic: In 1254 it submitted to the Mongols and came under the Chahan Zhang civilian office.

sentences.zh: 至元十二年，改蘭州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan it was changed to Lan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1275 it was renamed Lan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 寶山州，在雪山之東，麗江西來，環帶三面。

translations.literal: Baoshan Prefecture lies east of Snow Mountain; the Lijiang River comes from the west and wraps around on three sides.
translations.idiomatic: Baoshan Prefecture lay east of Snow Mountain where the Lijiang River swept around it on three sides.

sentences.zh: 昔麼、些蠻居之。

translations.literal: Formerly the Mo and Suo barbarians dwelt there.
translations.idiomatic: Mo and Suo tribes once lived there.

sentences.zh: 其先自樓頭徙居此，二十餘世。

translations.literal: Their forebears moved from Loutou to dwell here for more than twenty generations.
translations.idiomatic: Their ancestors had moved from Loutou and lived there for more than twenty generations.

sentences.zh: 世祖征大理，自卞頭濟江，由羅邦至羅寺，圍大匱等寨，其酋內附，名其寨曰察罕忽魯罕。

translations.literal: When Kublai campaigned against Dali he forded the river at Biantou, went from Luobang to Luosi, besieged the stockades of Dakui and others; its chieftain submitted from within and the stockade was named Chahan Huluhan.
translations.idiomatic: In Kublai's campaign against Dali he crossed at Biantou, passed from Luobang to Luosi, and besieged Dakui's stockade; its chief submitted and the stockade was named Chahan Huluhan.

sentences.zh: 至元十四年，以大匱七處立寶山縣，十六年升為州。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Zhiyuan seven places of Dakui were used to establish Baoshan County; in the sixteenth year it was upgraded to a prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1277 seven Dakui settlements became Baoshan County, upgraded to a prefecture in 1279.

sentences.zh: 巨津州，昔名羅波九睒，北接三川、鐵橋，西鄰吐蕃。

translations.literal: Jujin Prefecture; formerly it was called Luobo Jiushan; north it adjoins Sanchuan and Iron Bridge, west it neighbors Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: Jujin Prefecture was formerly Luobo Jiushan, bordering Sanchuan and Iron Bridge to the north and Tibet to the west.

sentences.zh: 按《唐書》，南詔居鐵橋之南，西北與吐蕃接。

translations.literal: According to the History of Tang, Nanzhao dwelt south of Iron Bridge, northwest bordering Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: The History of Tang states that Nanzhao lay south of Iron Bridge with Tibet to the northwest.

sentences.zh: 今州境實大理西北陬要害地，麼、些大酋世居之。

translations.literal: The present prefecture's territory is in truth a strategic corner of northwest Dali, where great chieftains of the Mo and Suo have dwelt for generations.
translations.idiomatic: The prefecture marked a strategic corner of northwest Dali where Mo and Suo chieftains had long ruled.

sentences.zh: 憲宗三年內附。

translations.literal: In the third year of Möngke it submitted from within.
translations.idiomatic: In 1253 it submitted to the Mongols.

sentences.zh: 至元十四年，於九睒立巨津州，蓋以鐵橋自昔為南詔、吐蕃交會之大津渡，故名。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Zhiyuan Jujin Prefecture was established at Jiushan — for Iron Bridge from ancient times was the great ferry crossing where Nanzhao and Tibet met, hence the name.
translations.idiomatic: In 1277 Jujin Prefecture was created at Jiushan, named for the great Iron Bridge ferry where Nanzhao and Tibet had long met.

sentences.zh: 領一縣：

translations.literal: It governs one county:
translations.idiomatic: It administered one county:

sentences.zh: 臨西。

translations.literal: Linxi.
translations.idiomatic: Linxi County.

sentences.zh: 下。

translations.literal: Lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower grade.

sentences.zh: 縣在州之西北，乃大理極邊險僻之地，夷名羅裒間，居民皆麼、些二種蠻。

translations.literal: The county lies northwest of the prefecture; it is the most remote, dangerous, and secluded land of Dali; in barbarian speech it is called Luobojian; the inhabitants are all of the Mo and Suo — two kinds of barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: Northwest of the prefecture at the most remote and perilous edge of Dali, known in the local tongue as Luobojian, lived only Mo and Suo tribes.

sentences.zh: 至元十四年，立大理州縣，于羅裒間立臨西縣，以西臨吐蕃境故也，隸巨津州。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Zhiyuan prefectures and counties of Dali were established; at Luobojian Linxi County was established because it faced the Tibetan border to the west, subordinate to Jujin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1277, as Dali's prefectures and counties were being set up, Linxi County was established at Luobojian on the Tibetan frontier westward and placed under Jujin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 東川路，下。

translations.literal: Dongchuan Circuit, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Dongchuan Circuit, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 至元二十八年立。

translations.literal: Established in the twenty-eighth year of Zhiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Established in 1291.

sentences.zh: 茫部路軍民總管府。

translations.literal: Mangbu Circuit Military-Civilian General Administration.
translations.idiomatic: The Mangbu Circuit Military and Civilian General Administration.

sentences.zh: 下。

translations.literal: Lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower grade.

sentences.zh: 益良州。

translations.literal: Yiliang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yiliang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 下。

translations.literal: Lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower grade.

sentences.zh: 強州。

translations.literal: Qiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Qiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 下。

translations.literal: Lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower grade.

sentences.zh: 孟傑路。

translations.literal: Mengjie Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Mengjie Circuit.

sentences.zh: 自東川路以下闕。

translations.literal: From Dongchuan Circuit downward is absent.
translations.idiomatic: From Dongchuan Circuit onward the record is incomplete.

sentences.zh: 泰定三年，八百媳婦蠻請官守，置木安、孟傑二府於其地。

translations.literal: In the third year of Taiding the Babai Xifu barbarians requested official guardians; the two administrations of Mu'an and Mengjie were established in their land.
translations.idiomatic: In 1326 the Babai Xifu people petitioned for official oversight, and Mu'an and Mengjie prefectures were established on their territory.

sentences.zh: 普安路，下。

translations.literal: Pu'an Circuit, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Pu'an Circuit, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 治在盤町山陽，巴盤江東。

translations.literal: Its seat lies on the sunny slope of Panding Mountain, east of the Bapan River.
translations.idiomatic: The seat stood on the south face of Panding Mountain, east of the Bapan River.

sentences.zh: 古夜郎地。

translations.literal: The ancient land of Yelang.
translations.idiomatic: Ancient territory of Yelang.

sentences.zh: 秦為黔中地，兩漢隸牂牁郡，蜀隸興古郡，隋立牂州。

translations.literal: In Qin it was Qianzhong territory; in the Two Han it was subordinate to Zangke Commandery; under Shu it was subordinate to Xinggu Commandery; in Sui Zang Prefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Qin it formed part of Qianzhong; in Han it fell within Zangke Commandery; under Shu within Xinggu Commandery; and in Sui it became Zang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 唐置西平州，後改興古郡為盤州。

translations.literal: In Tang Xiping Prefecture was established; later Xinggu Commandery was changed to Pan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang created Xiping Prefecture, later converting Xinggu Commandery into Pan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 蒙氏叛唐，其地為南詔東鄙，東爨烏蠻七部落居之。

translations.literal: The Meng clan rebelled against Tang; its land became the eastern border of Nanzhao; seven tribes of the Eastern Cuan Wuman dwelt there.
translations.idiomatic: When the Meng clan rebelled against the Tang, the region became Nanzhao's eastern frontier, home to seven Eastern Cuan Wuman tribes.

sentences.zh: 其後爨酋阿宋逐諸蠻據其地，號於失部，世為酋長。

translations.literal: Afterward the Cuan chieftain A Song drove out the various barbarians and held their land, calling it the Yushi Division, generation after generation serving as chieftain.
translations.idiomatic: Later Cuan chieftain A Song expelled the tribal peoples, seized the territory, and established the Yushi division, his line ruling as chieftains for generations.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗七年，其酋內附，命為于失萬戶。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Möngke of Yuan, its chieftain submitted from within and was appointed Yushi myriarch.
translations.idiomatic: In 1257 its chieftain submitted to the Mongols and was made myriarch of Yushi.

sentences.zh: 至元十三年，改普安路總管府。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan it was changed to the Pu'an Circuit General Administration.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 it became the Pu'an Circuit General Administration.

sentences.zh: 明年，更立招討司。

translations.literal: The next year a Campaign Pacification Commission was established in its place.
translations.idiomatic: The following year a Campaign Pacification Commission replaced it.

sentences.zh: 十六年，改為宣撫司。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year it was changed to a Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In 1279 it was converted into a Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，罷司為路。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year the commission was abolished and it became a circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1285 the commission was abolished and the area reverted to circuit status.

sentences.zh: 曲靖等路宣慰司軍民萬戶府，曲、靖二州在漢為夜郎味縣地。

translations.literal: The Qujing and Other Circuits Pacification Commission Military-Civilian Myriarch Office — Qu and Jing, the two prefectures, in Han times were the land of Yelang Wei County.
translations.idiomatic: Qujing and Other Circuits Pacification Commission, Military and Civilian Myriarch Office: Qu and Jing prefectures occupied what had been Yelang's Wei County under the Han.

sentences.zh: 蜀分置興古郡。

translations.literal: Shu separately established Xinggu Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Shu later set up Xinggu Commandery there.

sentences.zh: 隋初為恭州、協州。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Sui it was Gong Prefecture and Xie Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Sui it comprised Gong and Xie prefectures.

sentences.zh: 唐置南寧州。
