translations.literal: In Tang Nanning Prefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang established Nanning Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 東、西爨分烏、白蠻二種，自曲靖州西南昆川距龍和城，通謂之西爨白蠻。

translations.literal: East and West Cuan divided into Wuman and Baiman, two kinds; from the southwest of Qujing Prefecture from Kunchuan to Longhe City, jointly called the Western Cuan Baiman.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern and Western Cuan split into Wuman and Baiman peoples; from southwestern Qujing from Kunchuan to Longhe City they were collectively known as the Western Cuan Baiman.

sentences.zh: 自彌鹿、升麻二川南至步頭，通謂之東爨烏蠻。

translations.literal: From the two valleys Mili and Shengma south to Butou, jointly called the Eastern Cuan Wuman.
translations.idiomatic: From the Mili and Shengma valleys south to Butou they were known as the Eastern Cuan Wuman.

sentences.zh: 貞觀中，以西爨歸王為南寧都督，襲殺東爨首領蓋聘。

translations.literal: In the Zhenguan era the Western Cuan Guiwang was made Nanning Area Commander; he attacked and killed the Eastern Cuan chieftain Gai Pin.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhenguan reign Cuan Guiwang of the Western Cuan was appointed area commander of Nanning and killed Eastern Cuan leader Gai Pin in a surprise attack.

sentences.zh: 南詔閣羅鳳以兵脅西爨，徙之至龍和，皆殘於兵。

translations.literal: Nanzhao's Geluofeng coerced the Western Cuan with troops and relocated them to Longhe; all were devastated by war.
translations.idiomatic: Geluofeng of Nanzhao forced the Western Cuan at swordpoint to relocate to Longhe, where warfare ravaged them.

sentences.zh: 東爨烏蠻復振，徙居西爨故地，世與南詔為婚，居故曲靖州。

translations.literal: The Eastern Cuan Wuman recovered strength, migrated to dwell in the Western Cuan's old land, generation after generation intermarried with Nanzhao, dwelling in the old Qujing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Cuan Wuman revived, moved into the former Western Cuan lands, intermarried with Nanzhao for generations, and settled at old Qujing.

sentences.zh: 天寶末，征南詔，進次曲靖州，大敗，其地遂沒於蠻。

translations.literal: At the end of Tianbao, campaigning against Nanzhao, the army halted at Qujing Prefecture and suffered great defeat; its land then sank into barbarian possession.
translations.idiomatic: At the close of the Tianbao reign the Tang campaign against Nanzhao reached Qujing and met disaster; the region passed entirely to tribal control.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗六年，立磨彌部萬戶。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Möngke of Yuan the Momi Division myriarch office was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1256 the Momi division myriarch office was established.

sentences.zh: 至元八年，改為中路。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Zhiyuan it was changed to a Middle Route.
translations.idiomatic: In 1271 it became a Middle Route.

sentences.zh: 十三年，改曲靖路總管府。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year it was changed to the Qujing Circuit General Administration.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 it became the Qujing Circuit General Administration.

sentences.zh: 二十年，以隸皇太子。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year it was made subordinate to the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In 1283 it was placed under the crown prince's jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，升宣撫司。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year it was promoted to a Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In 1288 it was elevated to a Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 領縣一、州五。

translations.literal: It governs one county and five prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: It administered one county and five prefectures.

sentences.zh: 州領六縣。

translations.literal: The prefectures govern six counties.
translations.idiomatic: Its prefectures oversaw six counties.

sentences.zh: 本路屯田四千四百八十雙，歲輸金三千五百五十兩、馬一百八十四。

translations.literal: This circuit's colony fields number four thousand four hundred eighty shuang; annual tribute is three thousand five hundred fifty taels of gold and one hundred eighty-four horses.
translations.idiomatic: The circuit had 4,480 shuang of colony land and paid an annual tribute of 3,550 taels of gold and 184 horses.

sentences.zh: 南寧。

translations.literal: Nanning.
translations.idiomatic: Nanning County.

sentences.zh: 下。

translations.literal: Lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower grade.

sentences.zh: 倚郭。

translations.literal: Attached to the seat of the circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Seat of the circuit administration.

sentences.zh: 唐以爨歸王為南寧州都督，治石城。

translations.literal: In Tang Cuan Guiwang was made governor of Nanning Prefecture; he governed from Shicheng.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang, Cuan Guiwang served as governor of Nanning Prefecture from Shicheng.

sentences.zh: 及閣羅鳳叛，州廢，蒙氏改石城郡。

translations.literal: When Geluofeng rebelled the prefecture was abolished; the Meng clan changed it to Shicheng Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: After Geluofeng's rebellion the prefecture was dissolved and the Meng clan renamed the area Shicheng Commandery.

sentences.zh: 至段氏，烏蠻莫瀰部酋據石城。

translations.literal: Reaching the Duan clan, the Wuman Momi Division chieftain held Shicheng.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Duan, a Momi Wuman chieftain controlled Shicheng.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗三年內附。

translations.literal: In the third year of Möngke of Yuan it submitted from within.
translations.idiomatic: In 1253 it submitted to the Mongols.

sentences.zh: 六年，立千戶，隸莫瀰部萬戶。

translations.literal: In the sixth year a chiliarch office was established, subordinate to the Momi Division myriarch office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1256 a chiliarch office was created under the Momi myriarch.

sentences.zh: 至元十三年，升南寧州。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan Nanning Prefecture was promoted.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 Nanning was raised to prefecture status.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，革為縣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year it was reformed to become a county.
translations.idiomatic: In 1284 it was reduced to a county.

sentences.zh: 陸涼州，下。

translations.literal: Luliang Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Luliang Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 即漢牂牁郡之平夷縣。

translations.literal: It is the Pingyi County of Han Zangke Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: It was Pingyi County in Han-era Zangke Commandery.

sentences.zh: 南詔叛後，落溫部蠻世居之。

translations.literal: After Nanzhao rebelled, the Luowen Division barbarians dwelt there for generations.
translations.idiomatic: After Nanzhao's rebellion the Luowen tribe held the area for generations.

sentences.zh: 憲宗三年內附，立落溫千戶，屬落蒙萬戶。

translations.literal: In the third year of Möngke it submitted from within; the Luowen chiliarch office was established, belonging to the Luomeng myriarch office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1253 it submitted; a Luowen chiliarch was established under the Luomeng myriarch.

sentences.zh: 至元十三年，改為陸涼州。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan it was changed to Luliang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 it became Luliang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 領二縣：

translations.literal: It governs two counties:
translations.idiomatic: It administered two counties:

sentences.zh: 芳華，下。

translations.literal: Fanghua, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Fanghua, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 在州西。

translations.literal: It lies west of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: West of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 河納。

translations.literal: Hena.
translations.idiomatic: Hena County.

sentences.zh: 下，在州南，治蔡村。

translations.literal: Lower rank, south of the prefecture; its seat is at Caicun.
translations.idiomatic: Lower grade, south of the prefectural seat, administered from Caicun Village.

sentences.zh: 越州，下。

translations.literal: Yue Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 在路之南，其川名魯望，普麼部蠻世居之。

translations.literal: South of the circuit; its valley is called Luwang; the Pumo Division barbarians have dwelt there for generations.
translations.idiomatic: South of the circuit in the Luwang valley, long home to the Pumo tribe.

sentences.zh: 憲宗四年內附。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Möngke it submitted from within.
translations.idiomatic: In 1254 it submitted to the Mongols.

sentences.zh: 六年，立千戶，隸末迷萬戶。

translations.literal: In the sixth year a chiliarch office was established, subordinate to the Memi myriarch office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1256 a chiliarch office was set up under the Memi myriarch.

sentences.zh: 至元十二年，改越州，隸曲靖路。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan it was changed to Yue Prefecture, subordinate to Qujing Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1275 it became Yue Prefecture under Qujing Circuit.

sentences.zh: 羅雄州，下。

translations.literal: Luoxiong Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Luoxiong Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 與溪洞蠻獠接壤，歷代未嘗置郡，夷名其地為塔敝納夷甸。

translations.literal: It borders stream-cave barbarians and Liao; through successive dynasties no commandery was ever established; in Yi speech they call its land Tabina Yidian.
translations.idiomatic: Bordering stream-dwelling tribes and Liao peoples, no commandery had ever been established there; locally it was called Tabina Yidian.

sentences.zh: 俗傳盤瓠六男，其一曰蒙由丘，後裔有羅雄者居此甸。

translations.literal: Popular tradition says Panhu had six sons; one called Meng Youqiu; among their descendants one named Luoxiong dwelt in this dian.
translations.idiomatic: Tradition held that Panhu's six sons included Meng Youqiu, whose descendant Luoxiong settled this dian.

sentences.zh: 至其孫普恐，名其部曰羅雄。

translations.literal: Reaching his grandson Pukong, he named his division Luoxiong.
translations.idiomatic: His grandson Pukong gave the division the name Luoxiong.

sentences.zh: 憲宗四年內附。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Möngke it submitted from within.
translations.idiomatic: In 1254 it submitted to the Mongols.

sentences.zh: 七年，隸普摩千戶。

translations.literal: In the seventh year it was subordinate to the Pumo chiliarch office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1257 it fell under the Pumo chiliarch.

sentences.zh: 至元十三年，割夜苴部為羅雄州，隸曲靖路。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan the Yeju Division was cut off to form Luoxiong Prefecture, subordinate to Qujing Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 the Yeju division was separated as Luoxiong Prefecture under Qujing Circuit.

sentences.zh: 馬龍州，下。

translations.literal: Malong Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Malong Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 夷名曰撒匡。

translations.literal: In Yi speech it is called Sakuang.
translations.idiomatic: Known in the local tongue as Sakuang.

sentences.zh: 昔僰、剌居之，盤瓠裔納垢逐舊蠻而有其地。

translations.literal: In former times the Bo and La dwelt there; Nagou, descendant of Panhu, drove out the old barbarians and possessed their land.
translations.idiomatic: Once home to Bo and La peoples, Panhu's descendant Nagou expelled the earlier tribes and took the land.

sentences.zh: 至羅苴內附，於本部立千戶。

translations.literal: When Luoju submitted from within, a chiliarch office was established in his division.
translations.idiomatic: When Luoju submitted, a chiliarch was established in his division.

sentences.zh: 至元十三年，改為州，即舊馬龍城也。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan it was changed to a prefecture — that is the old Malong City.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 it was made a prefecture at the site of old Malong City.

sentences.zh: 領一縣：

translations.literal: It governs one county:
translations.idiomatic: It administered one county:

sentences.zh: 通泉。

translations.literal: Tongquan.
translations.idiomatic: Tongquan County.

sentences.zh: 下。

translations.literal: Lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower grade.

sentences.zh: 在州西南，與嵩明州楊林縣接壤，納垢之孫易陬分居其地。

translations.literal: Southwest of the prefecture, bordering Yanglin County of Songming Prefecture; Nagou's grandson Yizou separately dwelt on its land.
translations.idiomatic: Southwest of the prefecture adjoining Yanglin County in Songming, where Nagou's grandson Yizou had established his branch settlement.

sentences.zh: 元初為易龍百戶，隸馬龍千戶。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yuan it was the Yilong century office, subordinate to the Malong chiliarch office.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Yuan it was the Yilong century under the Malong chiliarch.

sentences.zh: 至元十三年，改名通泉縣，隸馬龍州。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan it was renamed Tongquan County, subordinate to Malong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 it was renamed Tongquan County and placed under Malong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 霑益州，下。

translations.literal: Zhanyi Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Zhanyi Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 在本路之東北，據南盤江、北盤江之間。

translations.literal: Northeast of this circuit, occupying the land between the Southern Pan River and the Northern Pan River.
translations.idiomatic: Northeast of the circuit between the Southern and Northern Pan Rivers.

sentences.zh: 唐初置州，天寶末，沒於蠻，為僰、剌二種所居。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tang a prefecture was established; at the end of Tianbao it sank into barbarians, where Bo and La, two kinds, dwelt.
translations.idiomatic: A prefecture was founded early in the Tang; by the Tianbao era it had fallen to tribal control and was held by Bo and La peoples.

sentences.zh: 後磨彌部奪之。

translations.literal: Later the Momi Division seized it.
translations.idiomatic: The Momi division later seized it.

sentences.zh: 元初其孫普垢𠠝內附。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yuan his grandson Pugou Lie submitted from within.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Yuan his grandson Pugou Lie submitted.

sentences.zh: 憲宗七年，以本部隸曲靖磨彌萬戶府。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Möngke this division was made subordinate to the Qujing Momi myriarch office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1257 the division was placed under the Qujing Momi myriarch.

sentences.zh: 至元十三年，改沾益州。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan it was changed to Zhanyi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 it became Zhanyi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 領三縣：

translations.literal: It governs three counties:
translations.idiomatic: It administered three counties:

sentences.zh: 交水，下。

translations.literal: Jiaoshui, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaoshui, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 治易陬龍城。

translations.literal: Its seat is at Yizou Long City.
translations.idiomatic: Administered from Yizou Long City.

sentences.zh: 其先磨彌部酋蒙提居之，後大理國高護軍逐其子孫為私邑。

translations.literal: Formerly the Momi Division chieftain Mengti dwelt there; later Dali kingdom's Gao Hujun drove out his descendants and made it a private fief.
translations.idiomatic: The Momi chieftain Mengti had ruled there until Gao Hujun of Dali ousted his heirs and made it a private estate.

sentences.zh: 憲宗五年內附。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Möngke it submitted from within.
translations.idiomatic: In 1255 it submitted to the Mongols.

sentences.zh: 至元十三年，即其城立縣。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan a county was established at its city.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 a county was founded at that city.

sentences.zh: 石梁，下。

translations.literal: Shiliang, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Shiliang, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 係磨彌部，又名伍勒部。

translations.literal: It belongs to the Momi Division, also called the Wule Division.
translations.idiomatic: Part of the Momi division, also known as Wule.

sentences.zh: 其酋世為巫，居石梁原山。

translations.literal: Its chieftains generation after generation served as shamans, dwelling on Shiliang Plateau Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Its chieftains were hereditary shamans on Mount Shiliangyuan.

sentences.zh: 至元十三年為縣。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan it became a county.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 it was established as a county.

sentences.zh: 羅山。

translations.literal: Luoshan.
translations.idiomatic: Luoshan County.

sentences.zh: 下。

translations.literal: Lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower grade.

sentences.zh: 夷名落蒙山，乃磨彌部東境。

translations.literal: In Yi speech it is called Luomeng Mountain; it is the eastern border of the Momi Division.
translations.idiomatic: Known locally as Luomeng Mountain, on the eastern edge of the Momi division.

sentences.zh: 澂江路，下。

translations.literal: Chenglu Circuit, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Chenglu Circuit, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 治在滇池東南。

translations.literal: Its seat is southeast of Dian Lake.
translations.idiomatic: Administered from southeast of Lake Dian.

sentences.zh: 唐屬牂州，隸黔州都督府。

translations.literal: In Tang it belonged to Zang Prefecture and was subordinate to the Qianzhou Area Command.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang it was part of Zang Prefecture under the Qianzhou military governor.

sentences.zh: 開元中，降為羈縻州。

translations.literal: During the Kaiyuan era it was reduced to a jimi prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the Kaiyuan period it became a jimi (indirectly ruled) prefecture.

sentences.zh: 今夷中名其地曰羅伽甸。

translations.literal: Today among the Yi they call its land Luojia Dian.
translations.idiomatic: Local Yi still call the region Luojia Dian.

sentences.zh: 初，麼、些蠻居之，後為僰蠻所奪。

translations.literal: At first the Mo and Xie barbarians dwelt there; later it was seized by the Bo barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: The Mo and Xie tribes lived there first until the Bo tribe took it.

sentences.zh: 南詔蒙氏為河陽郡，至段氏，麼、些蠻之裔復居此甸，號羅伽部。

translations.literal: The Nanzhao Meng clan made it Heyang Commandery; under the Duan clan, descendants of the Mo and Xie barbarians again dwelt in this dian and were called the Luojia Division.
translations.idiomatic: Nanzhao's Meng clan organized it as Heyang Commandery; under the Duan dynasty Mo-Xie descendants returned to this dian as the Luojia division.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗四年內附，六年以羅伽部為萬戶。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yuan Möngke it submitted from within; in the sixth year the Luojia Division was made a myriarch office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1254 it submitted to the Mongols; in 1256 the Luojia division became a myriarchate.

sentences.zh: 至元三年，改萬戶為中路。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhiyuan the myriarch office was changed to a Middle Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1266 the myriarchate became a Middle Circuit.

sentences.zh: 十六年，升為澄江路。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year it was promoted to Chenglu Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1279 it was elevated to Chenglu Circuit.

sentences.zh: 領縣三、州二。

translations.literal: It governs three counties and two prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: It administered three counties and two prefectures.

sentences.zh: 州領三縣。

translations.literal: The prefectures govern three counties.
translations.idiomatic: The prefectures together administered three counties.

sentences.zh: 本路屯田四千一百雙。

translations.literal: This circuit's colony fields number four thousand one hundred shuang.
translations.idiomatic: The circuit had 4,100 shuang of colony land.

sentences.zh: 河陽，下。

translations.literal: Heyang, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Heyang, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 內附後為千戶。

translations.literal: After submitting from within it became a chiliarch office.
translations.idiomatic: After submission it became a chiliarchate.

sentences.zh: 至元十六年，為河陽州。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Zhiyuan it became Heyang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1279 it became Heyang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，降為縣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year it was reduced to a county.
translations.idiomatic: In 1289 it was demoted to a county.

sentences.zh: 江川，下。

translations.literal: Jiangchuan, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangchuan, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 在抃江路南，星雲湖之北。

translations.literal: South of Bianjiang Road and north of Xingyun Lake.
translations.idiomatic: South of Bianjiang Road and north of Lake Xingyun.

sentences.zh: 蒙氏叛唐，使白蠻居之。

translations.literal: The Meng clan rebelled against Tang and had the Bai barbarians dwell there.
translations.idiomatic: When the Meng clan rebelled against Tang, they settled the Bai tribe there.

sentences.zh: 至段氏，些麼徒蠻之裔居此城。

translations.literal: Under the Duan clan, descendants of the Xiemo Tu barbarians dwelt in this city.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Duan dynasty descendants of the Xiemo Tu tribe occupied this city.

sentences.zh: 更名步雄部。

translations.literal: It was renamed the Buxiong Division.
translations.idiomatic: The settlement was renamed the Buxiong division.

sentences.zh: 其後弄景內附，即本部為千戶。

translations.literal: Afterwards Longjing submitted from within, and this division became a chiliarch office.
translations.idiomatic: Later Longjing submitted, and his division became a chiliarchate.

sentences.zh: 至元十三年，改千戶為江川州。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan the chiliarch office was changed to Jiangchuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 the chiliarchate became Jiangchuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十年，降為縣。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year it was reduced to a county.
translations.idiomatic: In 1283 it was demoted to a county.

sentences.zh: 陽宗。

translations.literal: Yangzong.
translations.idiomatic: Yangzong County.

sentences.zh: 下。

translations.literal: Lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower grade.

sentences.zh: 在本路西北，明湖之南。

translations.literal: Northwest of this circuit, south of Ming Lake.
translations.idiomatic: Northwest of the circuit, south of Lake Ming.

sentences.zh: 昔麼、些蠻居之，號曰強宗部，其酋盧舍內附，立本部千戶。

translations.literal: Formerly the Mo and Xie barbarians dwelt there and were called the Qiangzong Division; its chieftain Lushe submitted from within, and a chiliarch office was established in this division.
translations.idiomatic: The Mo and Xie tribes once lived there as the Qiangzong division until chieftain Lushe submitted and a chiliarchate was established in his division.

sentences.zh: 至元十三年，改為縣。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan it was changed to a county.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 it became a county.

sentences.zh: 新興州，下。

translations.literal: Xinxing Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Xinxing Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 漢新興縣。

translations.literal: The Han-era Xinxing County.
translations.idiomatic: It was Xinxing County in Han times.

sentences.zh: 唐初隸牂州，後南詔叛，降為羈縻州。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tang it was subordinate to Zang Prefecture; later Nanzhao rebelled and it was reduced to a jimi prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Tang it fell under Zang Prefecture; after Nanzhao's rebellion it became a jimi prefecture.

sentences.zh: 蒙氏為溫富州。

translations.literal: The Meng clan made it Wenfu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Meng clan organized it as Wenfu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 段氏時麼、些蠻分居其地。

translations.literal: During the Duan clan the Mo and Xie barbarians separately dwelt on its land.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Duan dynasty Mo and Xie tribes held separate settlements there.

sentences.zh: 內附後，立為千戶。

translations.literal: After submitting from within, a chiliarch office was established.
translations.idiomatic: After submission a chiliarchate was established.

sentences.zh: 至元十三年，改新興州，隸澄江路。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan it was changed to Xinxing Prefecture, subordinate to Chenglu Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 it became Xinxing Prefecture under Chenglu Circuit.

sentences.zh: 領二縣：

translations.literal: It governs two counties:
translations.idiomatic: It administered two counties:

sentences.zh: 普舍，下。

translations.literal: Pushhe, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Pushhe, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 在州西北。

translations.literal: It lies northwest of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Northwest of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 昔有強宗部蠻之裔，長曰部傍，據普具龍城，次曰普舍，據普劄龍城。

translations.literal: Formerly there were descendants of the Qiangzong Division barbarians: the elder called Bu Bang held Puju Long City, the younger called Pushhe held Puzha Long City.
translations.idiomatic: Descendants of the Qiangzong division once split the land: the elder Bu Bang held Puju Long City and the younger Pushhe held Puzha Long City.

sentences.zh: 二城之西有白城，漢人所築。

translations.literal: West of the two cities is White City, built by Han people.
translations.idiomatic: West of the two cities stood White City, built by Han settlers.

sentences.zh: 二酋屢爭其地，莫能定。

translations.literal: The two chiefs repeatedly fought over its land and could not settle it.
translations.idiomatic: The two chiefs fought repeatedly over the territory without resolution.

sentences.zh: 後普舍孫苴𠠝內附，立本部為千戶。

translations.literal: Later Pushhe's grandson Ju Lie submitted from within, and a chiliarch office was established in this division.
translations.idiomatic: Later Pushhe's grandson Ju Lie submitted, and his division became a chiliarchate.

sentences.zh: 十三年，改千戶為普舍縣，治普劄龍城，隸新興州。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year the chiliarch office was changed to Pushhe County, seated at Puzha Long City, subordinate to Xinxing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 the chiliarchate became Pushhe County, administered from Puzha Long City under Xinxing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 研和。

translations.literal: Yanhe.
translations.idiomatic: Yanhe County.

sentences.zh: 下。

translations.literal: Lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower grade.

sentences.zh: 麼些徒蠻步雄居之，其孫龍鍾內附，立百戶。

translations.literal: The Mo-Xie Tu barbarian Buxiong dwelt there; his grandson Longzhong submitted from within, and a century office was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Mo-Xie Tu chieftain Buxiong lived there until his grandson Longzhong submitted and a century was established.

sentences.zh: 至元十三年，改為縣。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan it was changed to a county.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 it became a county.

sentences.zh: 路南州，下。

translations.literal: Lunan Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lunan Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 州在本路之東，夷名路甸，有城曰撒呂，黑爨蠻之裔落蒙所築，子孫世居之，因名落蒙部。

translations.literal: The prefecture lies east of this circuit; in Yi speech it is Ludian; there is a city called Salü, built by Luomeng, descendant of the Heicuan barbarians, whose descendants dwelt there for generations — hence the name Luomeng Division.
translations.idiomatic: East of the circuit in a region the Yi called Ludian stood Salü City, built by Luomeng of the Heicuan line; his descendants held it for generations, giving the division its name.

sentences.zh: 憲宗朝內附，即本部立萬戶。

translations.literal: During Möngke's reign it submitted from within, and a myriarch office was established in this division.
translations.idiomatic: It submitted during Möngke's reign and its division became a myriarchate.

sentences.zh: 至元七年，並落蒙、羅伽、末迷三萬戶為中路。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Zhiyuan the three myriarch offices of Luomeng, Luojia, and Memi were merged into a Middle Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1270 the Luomeng, Luojia, and Memi myriarchates were merged into a Middle Circuit.

sentences.zh: 十三年，分中路為二路，改羅伽為澄江路，落蒙為路南州，隸澄江路。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year the Middle Circuit was divided into two circuits: Luojia was changed to Chenglu Circuit and Luomeng to Lunan Prefecture, subordinate to Chenglu Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 the Middle Circuit was split: Luojia became Chenglu Circuit and Luomeng became Lunan Prefecture under it.

sentences.zh: 領一縣：

translations.literal: It governs one county:
translations.idiomatic: It administered one county:

sentences.zh: 邑市。

translations.literal: Yishi.
translations.idiomatic: Yishi County.

sentences.zh: 下。

translations.literal: Lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower grade.

sentences.zh: 至元十三年，即邑市、彌歪二城立邑市縣，彌沙等五城立彌沙縣。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan Yishi County was established at the two cities of Yishi and Miyai, and Misha County was established at the five cities including Misha.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 Yishi County was founded at Yishi and Miyai, and Misha County at Misha and four other towns.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，並彌沙入本縣，隸路南州。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year Misha was merged into this county, subordinate to Lunan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1287 Misha was merged into this county under Lunan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 普定路，本普裏部，歸附後改普定府。

translations.literal: Puding Circuit — originally the Puli Division; after submission it was changed to Puding Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Puding Circuit began as the Puli division and became Puding Prefecture after submission.

sentences.zh: 至元二十七年，初斡羅思、呂國瑞入賄丞相桑哥及要束木等，請創羅甸宣慰司。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year of Zhiyuan, Wolaosi and Lü Guorui initially bribed the chancellor Sangge and Yaosumu and others, requesting the creation of a Luodian Pacification Commission Office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1290 Wolaosi and Lü Guorui bribed Chancellor Sangge, Yaosumu, and others to petition for a new Luodian Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 至是，言招到羅甸國劄哇並龍家、宋家、犵狫、貓人諸種蠻夷四萬六千六百戶。

translations.literal: At this time they reported having attracted the Luodian kingdom's Zhawa together with the Long, Song, Gelao, Maoren, and various kinds of barbarian Yi — forty-six thousand six hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: They now claimed to have brought in Zhawa of the Luodian kingdom along with Long, Song, Gelao, Maoren, and other tribal peoples — 46,600 households in all.

sentences.zh: 阿卜、阿牙者來朝，為曲靖路宣慰同知脫因及普安路官所阻。

translations.literal: Abu and Ayazhe came to court but were obstructed by Tuoyin, associate pacification commissioner of Qujing Circuit, and officials of Pu'an Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: When Abu and Ayazhe came to court, Tuoyin, deputy pacification commissioner of Qujing Circuit, and Pu'an officials blocked them.

sentences.zh: 會雲南行省言：「羅甸即普裏也，歸附後改普定府，印信具存，隸雲南省三十餘年，賦役如期。

translations.literal: Just then the Yunnan Branch Secretariat stated: "Luodian is precisely Puli; after submission it was changed to Puding Prefecture, the seals remain intact, subordinate to Yunnan Province for more than thirty years, taxes and corvée delivered on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: The Yunnan Branch Secretariat responded: "Luodian is Puli — after submission it became Puding Prefecture, its seals are still intact, and for more than thirty years it has been under Yunnan with taxes and corvée paid on time.

sentences.zh: 今所創羅甸宣慰安撫司，隸湖南省。

translations.literal: The Luodian Pacification and Pacification Office now created is subordinate to Hunan Province.
translations.idiomatic: The new Luodian Pacification and Pacification Office would fall under Hunan Province.

sentences.zh: 斡羅思等擅以兵脅降普定土官矣資男、劄哇、希古等，勒令同其入覲，邀功希賞。

translations.literal: Wolaosi and others on their own authority used troops to coerce the surrender of Puding native officials Yizinan, Zhawa, Xigu, and others, forcing them to accompany them to court in audience to seek merit and reward.
translations.idiomatic: Wolaosi and his party had used troops without authorization to coerce Puding native officials including Yizinan, Zhawa, and Xigu into accompanying them to court, hoping to claim credit and rewards.

sentences.zh: 氣罷之，仍以其地隸雲南。」

translations.literal: In indignation it was abolished, and the land still subordinated to Yunnan."
translations.idiomatic: The court angrily abolished the new office and kept the territory under Yunnan."

sentences.zh: 制可。

translations.literal: Decree approved.
translations.idiomatic: Decree approved.

sentences.zh: 大德七年，改為路。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Dade it was changed to a circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1303 it was elevated to a circuit.

sentences.zh: 大德七年，中書省臣言：「蛇節、宋隆濟等作亂，普定知府容苴率眾效順。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Dade a Central Secretariat minister stated: "Shejie, Song Longji, and others rebelled; Puding prefectural governor Rong Ju led the masses in showing loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: That same year a Central Secretariat minister reported: "When Shejie, Song Longji, and others rose in rebellion, Puding prefect Rong Ju led his people in loyal service.

sentences.zh: 容苴沒，其妻適姑亦能宣力戎行，乞令襲其夫職。

translations.literal: Rong Ju died; his wife Shigu also could exert strength on campaign; requesting permission for her to inherit her husband's office.
translations.idiomatic: Rong Ju has since died, but his wife Shigu also served capably in the field; we ask that she inherit her husband's post.

sentences.zh: 仍改普定為路，隸曲靖宣慰司，以適姑為本路總管，虎符。」

translations.literal: Also change Puding to a circuit, subordinate to the Qujing Pacification Commission, appoint Shigu as this circuit's general overseer, with tiger tally."
translations.idiomatic: Puding should be made a circuit under the Qujing Pacification Commission, with Shigu as its general overseer bearing a tiger tally."

sentences.zh: 仁德府，昔僰、剌蠻居之，無郡縣。

translations.literal: Rende Prefecture — formerly Bo and La barbarians dwelt there, with no commandery or counties.
translations.idiomatic: Rende Prefecture was once home to Bo and La tribes, with no commandery or county administration.

sentences.zh: 其部曰仲紮溢源，後烏蠻之裔新丁奪而有之。

translations.literal: Its division was called Zhongzha Yiyuan; later Xinding, descendant of the Wuman, seized and possessed it.
translations.idiomatic: The division was called Zhongzha Yiyuan until Xinding, a Wuman descendant, seized it.

sentences.zh: 至四世孫，因其祖名新丁，以為部號，語訛為仁地。

translations.literal: Reaching the fourth-generation descendant, because of the ancestor's name Xinding, it was taken as the division name; through phonetic corruption it became Rendi.
translations.idiomatic: By the fourth generation the division took its ancestor Xinding's name as its title, which in local speech became Rendi.

sentences.zh: 憲宗五年內附。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Möngke it submitted from within.
translations.idiomatic: In 1255 it submitted to the Mongols.

sentences.zh: 明年，立本部為仁地萬戶。

translations.literal: The following year this division was established as the Rendi Myriarch Office.
translations.idiomatic: The next year the division became the Rendi myriarchate.

sentences.zh: 至元初復叛，四年降之，仍為萬戶。

translations.literal: Early in Zhiyuan it rebelled again; in the fourth year it was subdued and remained a myriarch office.
translations.idiomatic: It rebelled again early in the Yuan; subdued in 1267, it remained a myriarchate.

sentences.zh: 十三年，改萬戶為仁德府。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year the myriarch office was changed to Rende Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 the myriarchate became Rende Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 本府屯田五百六十雙。

translations.literal: This prefecture's colony fields number five hundred sixty shuang.
translations.idiomatic: The prefecture had 560 shuang of colony land.

sentences.zh: 領縣二：

translations.literal: It governs two counties:
translations.idiomatic: It administered two counties:

sentences.zh: 為美，下。

translations.literal: Weimei, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Weimei, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 縣治在府北，地名溢浦適侶睒甸，即仁地故部。

translations.literal: The county seat is north of the prefecture; the place is called Yipu Shilv Shan dian — the former Rendi Division.
translations.idiomatic: North of the prefectural seat at Yipu Shilv Shan dian, the old Rendi division.

sentences.zh: 至元二十四年置縣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Zhiyuan the county was established.
translations.idiomatic: The county was established in 1287.

sentences.zh: 歸厚。

translations.literal: Guihou.
translations.idiomatic: Guihou County.

sentences.zh: 下。

translations.literal: Lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower grade.

sentences.zh: 縣治在府西，地名易浪湳龍，舊隸仁地部。

translations.literal: The county seat is west of the prefecture; the place is called Yilang Nannong, formerly subordinate to the Rendi Division.
translations.idiomatic: West of the prefectural seat at Yilang Nannong, once part of the Rendi division.

sentences.zh: 至元二十四年，分立二縣，曰倘俸，曰為美。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Zhiyuan two counties were separately established: Tangbang and Weimei.
translations.idiomatic: In 1287 two counties were split off: Tangbang and Weimei.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，改倘俸曰歸厚。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year Tangbang was changed to Guihou.
translations.idiomatic: In 1288 Tangbang was renamed Guihou.

sentences.zh: 羅羅蒙慶等處宣慰司都元帥府

translations.literal: Luoluo Mengqing and Other Places Pacification Commission Office and Grand Marshal's Headquarters
translations.idiomatic: Pacification Commission and Grand Marshal's Headquarters for Luoluo, Mengqing, and Related Territories

sentences.zh: 建昌路，下。

translations.literal: Jianchang Circuit, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Jianchang Circuit, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 本古越嶲地，唐初設中都〔督〕府，治越嶲。

translations.literal: Originally ancient Yuexi land; at the beginning of Tang a Central Area Command was established, seated at Yuexi.
translations.idiomatic: Ancient Yuexi territory; early in the Tang a Central Area Command was founded with its seat at Yuexi.

sentences.zh: 至德中，沒於吐蕃。

translations.literal: Midway through the Zhide era it was lost to Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: Midway through the Zhide era it fell to Tibet.

sentences.zh: 貞元中復之。

translations.literal: During the Zhenyuan era it was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: It was recovered in the Zhenyuan period.

sentences.zh: 懿宗時，蒙詔立城曰建昌府，以烏、白二蠻實之。

translations.literal: During Emperor Yizong, Mengzhao established a city called Jianchang Prefecture and filled it with Wu and Bai barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: Under Emperor Yizong, Mengzhao built Jianchang Prefecture and settled it with Wu and Bai tribes.

sentences.zh: 其後諸酋爭強，不能相下，分地為四，推段興為長。

translations.literal: Afterwards the various chiefs competed for strength and could not subordinate one another; the land was divided into four parts and Duan Xing was chosen as chief.
translations.idiomatic: Later the chiefs vied for power without yielding to one another; the territory was split four ways and Duan Xing was chosen as their leader.

sentences.zh: 其裔浸強，遂並諸酋，自為府主，大理不能制。

translations.literal: His descendants gradually grew strong, then merged the various chiefs, became lords of the prefecture themselves, and Dali could not control them.
translations.idiomatic: His line grew steadily stronger, absorbed the other chiefs, and ruled the prefecture on its own beyond Dali's control.

sentences.zh: 傳至阿宗，娶落蘭部建蔕女沙智。

translations.literal: The line passed to Azong, who married Shazhi, daughter of Jiandi of the Luolan Division.
translations.idiomatic: Power passed to Azong, who married Shazhi, daughter of Jiandi of the Luolan division.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗朝，建蔕內附，以其壻阿宗守建昌。

translations.literal: During Möngke's reign, Jiandi submitted from within, and his son-in-law Azong was put in charge of Jianchang.
translations.idiomatic: In Möngke's reign Jiandi submitted to the Mongols, and his son-in-law Azong was appointed to hold Jianchang.

sentences.zh: 至元十二年，析其地置總管府五、州二十三，建昌其一路也，設羅羅宣慰司以總之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan its land was divided and five general overseer prefectures and twenty-three prefectures were established; Jianchang was one circuit, and a Luoluo Pacification Commission Office was set up to oversee them all.
translations.idiomatic: In 1275 the territory was partitioned into five general overseer prefectures and twenty-three prefectures; Jianchang became one circuit under a new Luoluo Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 本路領縣一、州九。

translations.literal: This circuit governs one county and nine prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: The circuit administered one county and nine prefectures.

sentences.zh: 州領一縣。

translations.literal: The prefectures govern one county.
translations.idiomatic: The prefectures together administered one county.

sentences.zh: 本路立軍民屯田。

translations.literal: This circuit established military-civilian colony fields.
translations.idiomatic: Military-civilian colony lands were established in the circuit.

sentences.zh: 中縣。

translations.literal: Zhong County.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong County.

sentences.zh: 縣治在住頭回甸，蓋越嶲之東境也。

translations.literal: The county seat is at Zhutou Hui dian — essentially the eastern border of Yuexi.
translations.idiomatic: The county seat stood at Zhutou Hui dian, on the eastern edge of Yuexi territory.

sentences.zh: 所居烏蠻自別為沙麻部，以酋長所立處為中州。

translations.literal: The Wuman who dwelt there separately formed the Shama Division; the place where the chieftain established himself was called Zhong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The local Wuman formed the Shama division and named the chieftain's seat Zhong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 至元十年內附。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Zhiyuan it submitted from within.
translations.idiomatic: It submitted in 1273.

sentences.zh: 十四年，仍為中州。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year it remained Zhong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1277 it remained a prefecture under the name Zhong.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，降為縣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year it was reduced to a county.
translations.idiomatic: In 1285 it was demoted to a county.

sentences.zh: 隸建昌路。

translations.literal: Subordinate to Jianchang Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: It came under Jianchang Circuit.

sentences.zh: 建安州，下。

translations.literal: Jian'an Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Jian'an Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 即總府所治。

translations.literal: It is where the general headquarters is seated.
translations.idiomatic: It was the seat of the circuit headquarters.

sentences.zh: 建蔕既平，分建昌府為萬戶二，又置千戶二。

translations.literal: Once Jiandi was pacified, Jianchang Prefecture was divided into two myriarch offices, and two chiliarch offices were also established.
translations.idiomatic: After Jiandi was subdued, Jianchang Prefecture was split into two myriarchates with two additional chiliarchates.

sentences.zh: 至元十五年，割建鄉城十四村及建蔕四村立寶安州。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Zhiyuan fourteen villages of Jianxiang City and four villages of Jiandi were carved out to establish Bao'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1278 fourteen villages around Jianxiang City plus four from Jiandi's domain were set apart as Bao'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十七年，改本千戶為建安州。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year this chiliarch office was changed to Jian'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1280 the local chiliarchate became Jian'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，革寶安州，以其鄉村來屬。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year Bao'an Prefecture was abolished and its villages and hamlets were brought under this prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1289 Bao'an Prefecture was abolished and its villages annexed to Jian'an.

sentences.zh: 永寧州，下。

translations.literal: Yongning Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Yongning Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 在建昌之東郭。

translations.literal: In the eastern suburb of Jianchang.
translations.idiomatic: In Jianchang's eastern suburb.

sentences.zh: 唐時南詔立建昌郡，領建安、永寧二州。

translations.literal: In Tang times Nanzhao established Jianchang Commandery, governing Jian'an and Yongning prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang, Nanzhao made Jianchang a commandery with Jian'an and Yongning prefectures.

sentences.zh: 元至元九年，西平王平建蔕。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Yuan Zhiyuan the Prince of Xiping pacified Jiandi.
translations.idiomatic: In 1272 the Prince of Xiping subjugated Jiandi.

sentences.zh: 十六年，分建昌為二州，在城曰建安，東郭曰永寧，俱隸建昌路。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year Jianchang was divided into two prefectures: within the city called Jian'an, in the eastern suburb called Yongning — both subordinate to Jianchang Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1279 Jianchang was split: the walled city became Jian'an and the eastern suburb Yongning, both under Jianchang Circuit.

sentences.zh: 瀘州，下。

translations.literal: Lu Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 州在路西，昔名沙城瞼，即諸葛武侯禽孟獲之地。

translations.literal: The prefecture lies west of the circuit; formerly called Shacheng Lian — the place where Zhuge Liang captured Meng Huo.
translations.idiomatic: West of the circuit lay what was once Shacheng Lian, where Zhuge Liang took Meng Huo prisoner.

sentences.zh: 有瀘水，深廣而多瘴，鮮有行者，冬夏常熱，其源可燅雞豚。

translations.literal: There is the Lu River — deep, broad, and malarial; few travelers pass through; winter and summer it is constantly hot; at its source one can scald chickens and pigs.
translations.idiomatic: The Lu River ran deep and wide through fever country; travelers were rare, the heat persisted year-round, and its headwaters were hot enough to cook meat.

sentences.zh: 至段氏時，於熱水甸立城。

translations.literal: By the time of the Duan clan a city was built at Reshui dian.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Duan dynasty a city was founded at Reshui dian.

sentences.zh: 名洟籠，隸建昌。

translations.literal: Named Tilong, subordinate to Jianchang.
translations.idiomatic: It was called Tilong and fell under Jianchang.

sentences.zh: 憲宗時，建蔕內附，復叛，至元九年平之。

translations.literal: During Möngke's reign Jiandi submitted from within but rebelled again; in the ninth year of Zhiyuan it was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Jiandi submitted during Möngke's reign, rebelled again, and was subdued in 1272.

sentences.zh: 十五年，改洟籠為瀘州。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year Tilong was changed to Lu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1278 Tilong was renamed Lu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 禮州，下。

translations.literal: Li Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Li Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 州在路西北，瀘沽水東，所治曰籠麼城。

translations.literal: The prefecture lies northwest of the circuit, east of the Lugu River; its seat is called Longme City.
translations.idiomatic: Northwest of the circuit, east of the Lugu River, its seat was Longme City.

sentences.zh: 南詔末，諸蠻相侵奪，至段氏興，並有其地。

translations.literal: At the end of Nanzhao the various barbarians invaded and seized from one another; when the Duan clan rose, it held all this land.
translations.idiomatic: Late in the Nanzhao period rival tribes raided one another until the Duan dynasty united the region.

sentences.zh: 裔孫阿宗內附，復叛，至元九年平之，設千戶。

translations.literal: A descendant Azong submitted from within but rebelled again; in the ninth year of Zhiyuan it was pacified and a chiliarch office was established.
translations.idiomatic: Azong's line submitted, rebelled again, and after pacification in 1272 a chiliarchate was established.

sentences.zh: 十五年，改為禮州。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year it was changed to Li Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1278 it became Li Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 領一縣：

translations.literal: It governs one county:
translations.idiomatic: It administered one county:

sentences.zh: 瀘沽。

translations.literal: Lugu.
translations.idiomatic: Lugu County.

sentences.zh: 縣在州北。

translations.literal: The county lies north of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: North of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 昔羅落蠻所居，至蒙氏霸諸部，以烏蠻酋守此城，後漸盛，自號曰落蘭部，或稱羅落。

translations.literal: Formerly the Luoluo barbarians dwelt there; when the Meng clan dominated the various divisions, a Wuman chieftain guarded this city; later it gradually grew strong and called itself the Luolan Division, sometimes also Luoluo.
translations.idiomatic: The Luoluo tribe lived there first; under the Meng clan a Wuman chief held the city, and as his power grew his line styled itself the Luolan division, also called Luoluo.

sentences.zh: 其裔蒲德遣其姪建蔕內附。

translations.literal: His descendant Pude sent his nephew Jiandi to submit from within.
translations.idiomatic: Pude's descendant sent his nephew Jiandi to submit to the Mongols.

sentences.zh: 建蔕繼叛，殺蒲德，自為酋長，併有諸部。

translations.literal: Jiandi then rebelled, killed Pude, made himself chieftain, and possessed all the divisions.
translations.idiomatic: Jiandi soon rebelled, killed Pude, declared himself chief, and united the divisions under his rule.

sentences.zh: 至元九年平之，設千戶。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Zhiyuan it was pacified and a chiliarch office was established.
translations.idiomatic: Subdued in 1272, the territory received a chiliarchate.

sentences.zh: 十三年升萬戶，十五年改縣。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year it was promoted to myriarch; in the fifteenth year changed to a county.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted to a myriarchate in 1276, it became a county in 1278.

sentences.zh: 里州，下。

translations.literal: Li Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Li Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 唐隸嶲州都督。

translations.literal: In Tang it was subordinate to the Yuexi Area Command.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang it fell under the Yuexi military governor.

sentences.zh: 蒙詔時落蘭部小酋阿都之裔居此，因名阿都部。

translations.literal: During Mengzhao a descendant of the minor Luolan chief Adu dwelt here, hence the name Adu Division.
translations.idiomatic: In Mengzhao's day descendants of Luolan minor chief Adu settled here as the Adu division.

sentences.zh: 傳至納空，隨建蔕內附。

translations.literal: The line passed to Nakong, who submitted from within together with Jiandi.
translations.idiomatic: The line reached Nakong, who submitted alongside Jiandi.

sentences.zh: 中統三年叛。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhongtong it rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: It rebelled in 1262.

sentences.zh: 至元十年，其子耶吻效順，隸烏蒙。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Zhiyuan his son Yewen showed loyalty and submission, subordinate to Wumeng.
translations.idiomatic: In 1273 his son Yewen submitted and came under Wumeng.

sentences.zh: 十八年，設千戶。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year a chiliarch office was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1281 a chiliarchate was established.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，同烏蠻叛，奔羅羅斯。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year together with the Wuman it rebelled and fled to Luolosi.
translations.idiomatic: In 1285 it joined the Wuman in rebellion and fled to Luolosi.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，升軍民總管府。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year it was promoted to a Military-Civilian General Overseer Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1286 it was elevated to a military-civilian general overseer prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，府罷為州，隸建昌路。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year the general overseer prefecture was abolished and made a prefecture, subordinate to Jianchang Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1289 the military-civilian overseer prefecture was dissolved into a prefecture under Jianchang Circuit.

sentences.zh: 闊州，下。

translations.literal: Kuo Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Kuo Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 州治蜜納甸。

translations.literal: The prefectural seat is at Minad dian.
translations.idiomatic: The prefectural seat was at Minad dian.

sentences.zh: 古無城邑，烏蒙所居。

translations.literal: Anciently there were no walled cities or towns — Wumeng dwelt there.
translations.idiomatic: The region had no cities in antiquity; the Wumeng tribe lived there.

sentences.zh: 昔仲由蒙之裔孫名科居此，因以名為部號，後訛為闊。

translations.literal: Formerly Zhongyou Meng's descendant named Ke dwelt here; hence the division took his name as its title, later corrupted to Kuo.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongyou Meng's descendant Ke gave his name to the division, which later became corrupted to Kuo.

sentences.zh: 至三十七世孫僰羅內附。

translations.literal: Reaching the thirty-seventh-generation descendant Boruo, it submitted from within.
translations.idiomatic: In Boruo's time — the thirty-seventh generation — the division submitted.

sentences.zh: 至元九年，設千戶。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Zhiyuan a chiliarch office was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1272 a chiliarchate was established.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，改為州。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year it was changed to a prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1289 it became a prefecture.

sentences.zh: 邛部州，下。

translations.literal: Qiongbu Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Qiongbu Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 州在路東北，大渡河之南，越巂之東北。

translations.literal: The prefecture lies northeast of the circuit, south of the Dadu River, northeast of Yuexi.
translations.idiomatic: Northeast of the circuit, south of the Dadu River and northeast of Yuexi.

sentences.zh: 君長十數，筰都最大。

translations.literal: There were more than ten chieftains; Zuodu was the largest.
translations.idiomatic: More than a dozen chiefs held sway; Zuodu was the greatest.

sentences.zh: 唐立邛部縣，後沒於蠻。

translations.literal: In Tang Qiongbu County was established; later it was lost to the barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang founded Qiongbu County, but it later fell to tribal control.

sentences.zh: 至宋歲貢名馬土物，封其酋為邛都王。

translations.literal: By Song times it paid annual tribute of famous horses and local products, and its chief was enfeoffed as King of Qiongdou.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Song it paid annual tribute of fine horses and local goods, and its chief was enfeoffed as King of Qiongdou.

sentences.zh: 今其地夷稱為邛部川，治烏弄城，昔麼、些蠻居之，後仲由蒙之裔奪其地。

translations.literal: Now among the Yi its land is called Qiongbu River Valley, seated at Wunong City; formerly the Mo and Xie barbarians dwelt there, later Zhongyou Meng's descendants seized its land.
translations.idiomatic: Local Yi call the valley Qiongbu; its seat is Wunong City, once home to Mo and Xie tribes until Zhongyou Meng's descendants took it.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗時內附。

translations.literal: During Yuan Möngke it submitted from within.
translations.idiomatic: It submitted during Möngke's reign.

sentences.zh: 中統五年，立邛部川安撫招討使，隸成都元帥府。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Zhongtong the Qiongbu River Valley Pacification and Recruitment Office was established, subordinate to the Chengdu Marshal's Headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: In 1264 a Qiongbu pacification and recruitment office was set up under the Chengdu marshal's command.

sentences.zh: 至元十年，割屬羅羅斯宣慰司。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Zhiyuan it was carved out and placed under the Luolosi Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In 1273 it was transferred to the Luolosi Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，改為州。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year it was changed to a prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1284 it became a prefecture.

sentences.zh: 隆州，下。

translations.literal: Long Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Long Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 州在路之西南，與漢邛都縣接境，唐會川縣之西北。

translations.literal: The prefecture lies southwest of the circuit, bordering Han-era Qiongdou County, northwest of Tang Huichuan County.
translations.idiomatic: Southwest of the circuit, it bordered Han Qiongdou County and lay northwest of Tang Huichuan County.

sentences.zh: 蒙氏改會川為會同邏，立五瞼，本州為邊府瞼。

translations.literal: The Meng clan changed Huichuan to Huitong Luo, established five lian, and this prefecture was the Bianfu Lian.
translations.idiomatic: The Meng clan reorganized Huichuan as Huitong Luo with five lian districts; this prefecture was the frontier Bianfu lian.

sentences.zh: 其後瞼主楊大蘭於瞼北塏上立城，分派而居，名曰大隆城，即今州治也。

translations.literal: Afterwards the lian lord Yang Dalan built a city on the ridge north of the lian; branches of the clan dwelt separately — called Dalong City, which is today's prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: Later lian lord Yang Dalan built Dalong City on the northern ridge for his kin to settle separately; it remains the prefectural seat today.

sentences.zh: 元至元十三年內附。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Yuan Zhiyuan it submitted from within.
translations.idiomatic: It submitted in 1276.

sentences.zh: 十四年，設千戶。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year a chiliarch office was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1277 a chiliarchate was established.

sentences.zh: 十七年，改隆州。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year it was changed to Long Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1280 it became Long Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 姜州，下。

translations.literal: Jiang Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 姜者蠻名也。

translations.literal: Jiang is a barbarian name.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang was a tribal name.

sentences.zh: 烏蠻仲牟由之裔阿壇絳始居閟畔部，其孫阿羅仕大理國主高泰，是時會川有城曰龍納，羅落蠻世居焉。

translations.literal: Wuman Zhongmouyou's descendant A Tanjiang first dwelt in the Bipan Division; his grandson Aluo served Gao Tai, lord of Dali. At that time in Huichuan there was a city called Longna where Luoluo barbarians had dwelt for generations.
translations.idiomatic: The Wuman descendant A Tanjiang settled in the Bipan division; his grandson Aluo served Gao Tai of Dali when Luoluo tribes had long lived in Longna City in Huichuan.

sentences.zh: 阿羅挾高氏之勢，攻拔之，遂以祖名曰絳部。

translations.literal: Aluo relying on the Gao clan's power attacked and took it, then took his ancestor's name and called the division Jiang Division.
translations.idiomatic: Aluo used Gao clan backing to seize Longna and named his division Jiang after his ancestor.

sentences.zh: 憲宗時，隨閟畔內附，因隸焉。

translations.literal: During Möngke's reign it submitted from within together with Bipan and was subordinated thereto.
translations.idiomatic: During Möngke's reign it submitted with Bipan and fell under that division.

sentences.zh: 至元八年，為落蘭部酋建蔕所破。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Zhiyuan it was destroyed by Jiandi, chief of the Luolan Division.
translations.idiomatic: In 1271 Luolan chief Jiandi overran it.

sentences.zh: 九年平之，遂隸會川，後屬建昌。

translations.literal: In the ninth year it was pacified and subordinated to Huichuan, later belonging to Jianchang.
translations.idiomatic: Pacified in 1272, it came under Huichuan and later Jianchang.

sentences.zh: 十五年，改為姜州。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year it was changed to Jiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1278 it became Jiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，復屬閟畔部，後又屬建昌。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year it again belonged to the Bipan Division; later it again belonged to Jianchang.
translations.idiomatic: In 1290 it reverted to Bipan division, then returned to Jianchang.

sentences.zh: 德昌路軍民府，下。

translations.literal: Dechang Circuit Military-Civilian Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Dechang Circuit Military-Civilian Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 漢邛都縣地，唐沒于南詔。

translations.literal: Han-era Qiongdou County land; in Tang lost to Nanzhao.
translations.idiomatic: Former Han Qiongdou County, lost to Nanzhao under the Tang.

sentences.zh: 路在建昌西南，所居蠻號屈部。

translations.literal: The circuit lies southwest of Jianchang; the barbarians who dwelt there were called the Qu Division.
translations.idiomatic: Southwest of Jianchang, home to the Qu division.

sentences.zh: 元至元九年內附。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Yuan Zhiyuan it submitted from within.
translations.idiomatic: It submitted in 1272.

sentences.zh: 十二年，立定昌路，以本部為昌州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year Dingchang Circuit was established, with this division as Chang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1275 Dingchang Circuit was created with this division as Chang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，罷定昌路，併入德昌路，治本州葛魯城。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year Dingchang Circuit was abolished and merged into Dechang Circuit, seated at this prefecture's Gelu City.
translations.idiomatic: In 1286 Dingchang Circuit was dissolved into Dechang Circuit, administered from Gelu City.

sentences.zh: 領州四。

translations.literal: It governs four prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: It administered four prefectures.

sentences.zh: 本路立軍民屯田。

translations.literal: This circuit established military-civilian colony fields.
translations.idiomatic: Military-civilian colony lands were established in the circuit.

sentences.zh: 昌州，下。

translations.literal: Chang Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 路治本州。

translations.literal: The circuit seat is in this prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The circuit seat lay in this prefecture.

sentences.zh: 初，烏蠻阿屈之裔浸強，用祖名為屈部。

translations.literal: At first the Wuman A Qu's descendants gradually grew strong and used the ancestor's name for the Qu Division.
translations.idiomatic: A Qu's Wuman descendants grew powerful and took his name for the Qu division.

sentences.zh: 其孫烏則，至元九年內附。

translations.literal: His grandson Wuze — in the ninth year of Zhiyuan submitted from within.
translations.idiomatic: His grandson Wuze submitted in 1272.

sentences.zh: 十二年，改本部為州，兼領普濟、威龍，隸定昌路。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year this division was changed to a prefecture, also governing Puji and Weilong, subordinate to Dingchang Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1275 the division became a prefecture governing Puji and Weilong under Dingchang Circuit.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，罷定昌路，並隸德昌。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year Dingchang Circuit was abolished and merged under Dechang.
translations.idiomatic: In 1286, with Dingchang Circuit abolished, it came under Dechang.

sentences.zh: 德州，下。

translations.literal: De Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: De Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 在路之北。

translations.literal: It lies north of the circuit.
translations.idiomatic: North of the circuit.

sentences.zh: 其地今名吾越甸，城曰亦苴龍，所居蠻苴郎，以遠祖名部曰赬綖。

translations.literal: Its land is now called Wuyue dian; the city is called Yiju Long; the barbarians who dwelt there were the Jilang — using a distant ancestor's name they called the division the Chixian Division.
translations.idiomatic: The region is now Wuyue dian, its city Yiju Long; the local Jilang tribe took a distant forebear's name and styled their division Chixian.

sentences.zh: 憲宗時內附。

translations.literal: During Möngke's reign it submitted from within.
translations.idiomatic: It submitted during Möngke's reign.

sentences.zh: 至元十二年，立千戶。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan a chiliarch office was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1275 a chiliarchate was established.

sentences.zh: 十三年，改為德州，隸德平路。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year it was changed to De Prefecture, subordinate to Deiping Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 it became De Prefecture under Deiping Circuit.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，改隸德昌。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year it was changed to be subordinate to Dechang.
translations.idiomatic: In 1286 it was transferred to Dechang.

sentences.zh: 威龍州，下。

translations.literal: Weilong Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Weilong Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 州在路西南，夷名巴翠部，領小部三，一曰沙媧普宗，二曰烏雞泥祖，三曰媧諾龍菖蒲，皆獹魯蠻種也。

translations.literal: The prefecture lies southwest of the circuit; among the Yi it is called the Bacui Division. It governs three minor divisions: first, Shamu Puzong; second, Wuji Nizu; third, Wannuo Longchangpu — all are Lulu barbarian stock.
translations.idiomatic: Southwest of the circuit lay the Bacui division, governing three sub-divisions — Shamu Puzong, Wuji Nizu, and Wannuo Longchangpu — all Lulu tribes.

sentences.zh: 至元十五年，合三部立威龍州，隸德昌。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Zhiyuan the three divisions were combined to establish Weilong Prefecture, subordinate to Dechang.
translations.idiomatic: In 1278 the three divisions were merged as Weilong Prefecture under Dechang.

sentences.zh: 普濟州，下。

translations.literal: Puji Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Puji Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 州在路西北，夷名玗甸。

translations.literal: The prefecture is northwest of the circuit; the Yi name is Yudian.
translations.idiomatic: Northwest of the circuit at Yudian.

sentences.zh: 昔為荒僻之地，獹魯蠻世居之，後屬屈部。

translations.literal: Formerly it was a remote and desolate land where Lulu barbarians had dwelt for generations; later it belonged to the Qu Division.
translations.idiomatic: Once a remote backwater where Lulu tribes had lived for generations, it later fell under the Qu division.

sentences.zh: 至元九年，隨屈部內附。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Zhiyuan it submitted from within together with the Qu Division.
translations.idiomatic: It submitted with the Qu division in 1272.

sentences.zh: 十五年，于玗甸立定昌路。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year Dingchang Circuit was established at Yudian.
translations.idiomatic: In 1278 Dingchang Circuit was established at Yudian.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，路革，改隸德昌。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year the circuit was abolished and it was changed to be subordinate to Dechang.
translations.idiomatic: In 1286 the circuit was abolished and the prefecture came under Dechang.

sentences.zh: 會川路，下。

translations.literal: Huichuan Circuit, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Huichuan Circuit, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 路在建昌南。

translations.literal: The circuit lies south of Jianchang.
translations.idiomatic: South of Jianchang.

sentences.zh: 唐移邛都於此。

translations.literal: In Tang Qiongdou was moved here.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang the seat of Qiongdou was moved here.

sentences.zh: 其地當征蠻之要衝，諸酋聽會之所，故名。

translations.literal: This land stood at a vital pass on campaigns against the barbarians — the place where the various chiefs gathered to hear and decide — hence the name.
translations.idiomatic: It stood on a main route for campaigns against the tribes and was where chiefs assembled in council, which gave it its name.

sentences.zh: 天寶末，沒于南詔，立會川都督府，又號清寧郡。

translations.literal: At the end of Tianbao it was lost to Nanzhao; the Huichuan Area Command was established, also styled Qingning Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Tianbao era it fell to Nanzhao, which established the Huichuan area command, also called Qingning Commandery.

sentences.zh: 至段氏仍為會川府。

translations.literal: By the time of the Duan clan it remained Huichuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Duan dynasty it remained Huichuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元至元九年內附。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Yuan Zhiyuan it submitted from within.
translations.idiomatic: It submitted in 1272.

sentences.zh: 十四年立會川路，治武安州。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year Huichuan Circuit was established, seated at Wu'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1277 Huichuan Circuit was established with its seat at Wu'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 領州五。

translations.literal: It governs five prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: It administered five prefectures.

sentences.zh: 本路立軍民屯田。

translations.literal: This circuit established military-civilian colony fields.
translations.idiomatic: Military-civilian colony lands were established in the circuit.

sentences.zh: 武安州，下。

translations.literal: Wu'an Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Wu'an Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 蠻稱龍泥城。

translations.literal: The barbarians call it Longni City.
translations.idiomatic: The tribes called it Longni City.

sentences.zh: 至元十四年，立管民千戶。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Zhiyuan a civilian-governing chiliarch office was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1277 a civilian-governing chiliarchate was established.

sentences.zh: 十七年，改為武安州。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year it was changed to Wu'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1280 it became Wu'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 黎溪州，下。

translations.literal: Lixi Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lixi Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 古無城邑，蠻雲黎彄，訛為今名。

translations.literal: Anciently there were no walled cities or towns; the barbarians called it Liqiong, corrupted into the present name.
translations.idiomatic: The region had no cities in antiquity; the tribes called it Liqiong, which was corrupted into the present name.

sentences.zh: 初，烏蠻與漢人雜處，及南詔閣羅鳳叛，徙白蠻守之。

translations.literal: At first Wuman and Han people lived mixed together; when Nanzhao's Geluofeng rebelled, Bo barbarians were relocated to guard it.
translations.idiomatic: Wuman and Han once lived side by side until Geluofeng of Nanzhao rebelled and Bo tribes were resettled to hold the area.

sentences.zh: 蒙氏終，羅羅逐去白蠻。

translations.literal: When the Meng clan ended, the Luoluo drove away the Bo barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: After the Meng dynasty fell, the Luoluo expelled the Bo tribes.

sentences.zh: 段氏興，令羅羅蠻乞夷據其地。

translations.literal: When the Duan clan rose, it ordered the Luoluo barbarian Qiyi to hold this land.
translations.idiomatic: When the Duan dynasty rose, it put the Luoluo chief Qiyi in possession of the territory.

sentences.zh: 至元九年，其裔阿夷內附，改其部為黎溪州。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Zhiyuan his descendant Ayi submitted from within, and his division was changed to Lixi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1272 his descendant Ayi submitted, and the division became Lixi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 永昌州，下。

translations.literal: Yongchang Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Yongchang Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 州在路北，治故歸依城，即古會川也。

translations.literal: The prefecture lies north of the circuit; its seat is the former Guiyi City — that is, ancient Huichuan.
translations.idiomatic: North of the circuit, its seat was the old Guiyi City, ancient Huichuan.

sentences.zh: 唐天寶末，沒于南詔，置會川都督。

translations.literal: At the end of Tang Tianbao it was lost to Nanzhao, which established the Huichuan Area Command.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Tianbao era it fell to Nanzhao, which established a Huichuan area command.

sentences.zh: 至蒙氏改會同府，置五瞼，徙張、王、李、趙、楊、周、高、段、何、蘇、龔、尹十二姓於此，以趙氏為府主，居今州城。

translations.literal: By the Meng clan Huichuan was changed to Huitong Prefecture and five lian were established; the twelve surnames Zhang, Wang, Li, Zhao, Yang, Zhou, Gao, Duan, He, Su, Gong, and Yin were relocated here; the Zhao clan was made lords of the prefecture and dwelt in today's prefectural city.
translations.idiomatic: The Meng clan reorganized it as Huitong Prefecture with five lian districts, resettling twelve clans — Zhang, Wang, Li, Zhao, Yang, Zhou, Gao, Duan, He, Su, Gong, and Yin — with the Zhao as prefectural lords in the present city.

sentences.zh: 趙氏弱，王氏據之。

translations.literal: When the Zhao clan weakened, the Wang clan seized it.
translations.idiomatic: As the Zhao clan declined, the Wang clan took control.

sentences.zh: 及段氏與高氏專政，逐王氏，以其子高政治會川。

translations.literal: When the Duan and Gao clans held sole power, they drove out the Wang clan and put their son Gao Zheng in charge of Huichuan.
translations.idiomatic: When the Duan and Gao clans seized power, they expelled the Wang and installed Gao Zheng as governor of Huichuan.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗三年，征大理，高氏逃去。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yuan Möngke, on the campaign against Dali, the Gao clan fled.
translations.idiomatic: In 1253, during the campaign against Dali, the Gao clan fled.

sentences.zh: 九年，故酋王氏孫阿龍率眾內附。

translations.literal: In the ninth year the former chieftain Wang's grandson Along led the multitude to submit from within.
translations.idiomatic: In 1259 Wang's grandson Along led his people to submit.

sentences.zh: 至元八年，以其男阿禾領會川。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Zhiyuan his son A He was put in charge of Huichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In 1271 his son A He was appointed to govern Huichuan.

sentences.zh: 十四年，改管民千戶。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year it was changed to a civilian-governing chiliarch office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1277 it became a civilian-governing chiliarchate.

sentences.zh: 十七年，立永昌州，隸會川路。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year Yongchang Prefecture was established, subordinate to Huichuan Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1280 Yongchang Prefecture was established under Huichuan Circuit.

sentences.zh: 會理州，下。

translations.literal: Huili Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Huili Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 州在會川府東南。

translations.literal: The prefecture lies southeast of Huichuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Southeast of Huichuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 唐時南詔屬會川節度，地名昔陀。

translations.literal: In Tang times under Nanzhao it belonged to the Huichuan military governorship; the place was called Xituo.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang it fell within Nanzhao's Huichuan military governorship at a place called Xituo.

sentences.zh: 有蠻名阿壇絳，亦仲由蒙之遺種。

translations.literal: There was a barbarian named A Tanjiang — also a remnant stock of Zhongyou Meng.
translations.idiomatic: A tribal leader named A Tanjiang belonged to the line of Zhongyou Meng.

sentences.zh: 其裔羅於則，得昔陀地居之，取祖名曰絳部，後強盛，盡有四州之地，號蒙歪。

translations.literal: His descendant Luo Yuzhe obtained Xituo land and dwelt there; taking his ancestor's name he called the division the Jiang Division. Later it grew strong, possessed all the land of four prefectures, and styled itself Mengwai.
translations.idiomatic: His descendant Luo Yuzhe settled at Xituo and named his division Jiang after his ancestor; as his power grew he held four prefectures and styled his realm Mengwai.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗八年，其孫亦蘆內附，隸閟畔萬戶。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Yuan Möngke his grandson Yilu submitted from within and was subordinate to the Bipan myriarch office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1258 his grandson Yilu submitted and came under the Bipan myriarchate.

sentences.zh: 至元四年，屬落蘭部。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhiyuan it belonged to the Luolan Division.
translations.idiomatic: In 1267 it came under the Luolan division.

sentences.zh: 十三年，改隸會川路。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year it was changed to be subordinate to Huichuan Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 it was transferred to Huichuan Circuit.

sentences.zh: 十五年，置會理州，仍隸會川。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year Huili Prefecture was established, still subordinate to Huichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In 1278 Huili Prefecture was established, still under Huichuan.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，復屬閟畔部。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year it again belonged to the Bipan Division.
translations.idiomatic: In 1290 it reverted to the Bipan division.

sentences.zh: 麻龍州，下。

translations.literal: Malong Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Malong Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 麻龍者，城名也，地名棹羅能。

translations.literal: Malong is a city name; the place is called Zhaoluo Neng.
translations.idiomatic: Malong was the city name; the region was called Zhaoluo Neng.

sentences.zh: 烏蠻蒙次次之裔，祖居閟畔東川，後普恐遷苗臥龍，其孫阿麻內附。

translations.literal: Descendants of the Wuman Meng Cici — their ancestors dwelt in Bipan Dongchuan; later Pukong moved to Miaowolong; his grandson Ama submitted from within.
translations.idiomatic: Descendants of the Wuman Meng Cici first lived in Bipan Dongchuan; later Pukong moved to Miaowolong, and his grandson Ama submitted.

sentences.zh: 至元五年，為建蔕所併。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Zhiyuan it was annexed by Jiandi.
translations.idiomatic: In 1268 Jiandi annexed it.

sentences.zh: 十二年，屬會川。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year it belonged to Huichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In 1275 it came under Huichuan.

sentences.zh: 十四年，立管民千戶，隸會川路。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year a civilian-governing chiliarch office was established, subordinate to Huichuan Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1277 a civilian-governing chiliarchate was established under Huichuan Circuit.

sentences.zh: 十七年，立為州。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year it was established as a prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1280 it became a prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，割屬閟畔部。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year it was carved out and placed under the Bipan Division.
translations.idiomatic: In 1290 it was transferred to the Bipan division.

sentences.zh: 柏興府，昔摩沙夷所居。

translations.literal: Baixing Prefecture — where the Mosha Yi formerly dwelt.
translations.idiomatic: Baixing Prefecture, once home to the Mosha Yi.

sentences.zh: 漢為定莋縣，隸越嶲郡。

translations.literal: Under Han it was Dingzhuo County, subordinate to Yuexi Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Han it was Dingzhuo County in Yuexi Commandery.

sentences.zh: 唐立昆明縣。

translations.literal: In Tang Kunming County was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang established Kunming County there.

sentences.zh: 天寶末沒於吐蕃。

translations.literal: At the end of Tianbao it was lost to Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Tianbao era it fell to Tibet.

sentences.zh: 後復屬南詔，改香城郡。

translations.literal: Later it again belonged to Nanzhao and was changed to Xiangcheng Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: It later returned to Nanzhao and was renamed Xiangcheng Commandery.

sentences.zh: 元至元十年，其鹽井摩沙酋羅羅將𤡊鹿、茹庫內附。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Yuan Zhiyuan the Mosha chieftain of its salt wells, Luoluo Jiang, led the Lulu and Ruku to submit from within.
translations.idiomatic: In 1273 Mosha salt-well chief Luoluo Jiang led the Lulu and Ruku tribes to submit.

sentences.zh: 十四年，立鹽井管民千戶。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year a salt-well civilian-governing chiliarch office was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1277 a salt-well civilian-governing chiliarchate was established.

sentences.zh: 十七年，改為閏鹽州，以𤡊鹿部為普樂州，俱隸德平路。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year it was changed to Runyan Prefecture; the Lulu Division was made Pule Prefecture — both subordinate to Deiping Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1280 it became Runyan Prefecture and the Lulu division became Pule Prefecture, both under Deiping Circuit.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，並普樂、閏鹽二州為閏鹽縣，立柏興府，隸羅羅宣慰司。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year Pule and Runyan prefectures were merged into Runyan County; Baixing Prefecture was established, subordinate to the Luoluo Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In 1290 Pule and Runyan were merged as Runyan County, Baixing Prefecture was established, and both came under the Luoluo Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 領縣二：

translations.literal: It governs two counties:
translations.idiomatic: It administered two counties:

sentences.zh: 閏鹽，下。

translations.literal: Runyan, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Runyan County, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 倚郭。

translations.literal: Attached to the seat of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Seat of the prefectural administration.

sentences.zh: 夷名為賀頭甸，以縣境有鹽井故名。

translations.literal: Among the Yi it is called Hetou dian; because the county territory has salt wells, hence the name.
translations.idiomatic: The Yi called it Hetou dian; it took its name from the salt wells within the county.

sentences.zh: 金縣。

translations.literal: Jin County.
translations.idiomatic: Jin County.

sentences.zh: 下。

translations.literal: Lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower grade.

sentences.zh: 縣在府北，夷名利竇揭勒。

translations.literal: The county lies north of the prefecture; among the Yi it is called Lidoujiele.
translations.idiomatic: North of the prefectural seat, known to the Yi as Lidoujiele.

sentences.zh: 所居蠻因茹庫，乃漢越嶲郡北境，與土蕃接。

translations.literal: The barbarians who dwelt there were the Yin Ruku — the northern border of Han Yuexi Commandery, adjoining native tribes.
translations.idiomatic: The Yin Ruku tribe lived there on the northern edge of Han Yuexi Commandery, bordering native tribal lands.

sentences.zh: 至元十五年，立為金州，後降為縣，以縣境斛僰和山出金，故名焉。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Zhiyuan it was established as Jin Prefecture; later it was reduced to a county — because Hubohe Mountain within the county territory produces gold, hence the name.
translations.idiomatic: Established as Jin Prefecture in 1278 and later demoted to a county, it was named for the gold mined on Hubohe Mountain within its borders.

sentences.zh: 臨安廣西元江等處宣慰司兼管軍萬戶府

translations.literal: Pacification Commission for Lin'an, Guangxi, Yuanjiang and other places, jointly overseeing the Military Myriarch Headquarters.
