translations.idiomatic: Pacification Commission for Lin'an, Guangxi, Yuanjiang and other districts, jointly overseeing the military myriarch headquarters.

sentences.zh: 臨安路，下。

translations.literal: Lin'an Circuit, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lin'an Circuit, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 唐隸牂州，天寶末沒于南詔。

translations.literal: In Tang it was subordinate to Zang Prefecture; at the end of Tianbao it was lost to Nanzhao.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang it fell under Zang Prefecture and was lost to Nanzhao at the end of the Tianbao era.

sentences.zh: 蒙氏立都督府二，其一曰通海郡，段氏改為秀山郡，阿僰部蠻居之。

translations.literal: The Meng clan established two area-command prefectures; one was called Tonghai Commandery. The Duan clan changed it to Xiushan Commandery; the A Bo Division barbarians dwelt there.
translations.idiomatic: The Meng clan set up two area commands, one being Tonghai Commandery; the Duan renamed it Xiushan Commandery, where the A Bo tribe lived.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗六年內附，以本部為萬戶。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Yuan Möngke it submitted from within, and this division was made a myriarch office.
translations.idiomatic: It submitted in 1256 and its division became a myriarchate.

sentences.zh: 至元八年改為南路，十三年又改為臨安路。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Zhiyuan it was changed to Southern Circuit; in the thirteenth year it was again changed to Lin'an Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1271 it became Southern Circuit and in 1276 was renamed Lin'an Circuit.

sentences.zh: 領縣二、千戶一、州三。

translations.literal: It governs two counties, one chiliarch office, and three prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: It administered two counties, one chiliarchate, and three prefectures.

sentences.zh: 州領二縣。

translations.literal: The prefectures govern two counties.
translations.idiomatic: The prefectures together administered two counties.

sentences.zh: 宣慰司所領屯田六百雙，本路有司所管三千四百雙，爨僰軍千戶所管一千一百五十雙有奇。

translations.literal: The Pacification Commission's colony fields number six hundred shuang; the circuit's regular offices manage three thousand four hundred shuang; the Cuan Bo Military Chiliarch Office manages more than one thousand one hundred fifty shuang.
translations.idiomatic: The pacification commission held 600 shuang of colony land, the circuit administration 3,400 shuang, and the Cuan Bo military chiliarchate slightly more than 1,150 shuang.

sentences.zh: 河西，下。

translations.literal: Hexi, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Hexi, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 縣在杞麓湖之南，夷名其地曰休臘。

translations.literal: The county lies south of Qilu Lake; the Yi name for the place is Xiula.
translations.idiomatic: South of Qilu Lake, the Yi called the place Xiula.

sentences.zh: 昔莊蹻王其地。

translations.literal: Formerly King Zhuang Qiao held this land.
translations.idiomatic: King Zhuang Qiao once ruled this land.

sentences.zh: 唐初于姚州之南置西宗州，領三縣，河西其一也。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tang, south of Yaozhou Xizong Prefecture was established, governing three counties — Hexi was one of them.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Tang, Xizong Prefecture was established south of Yaozhou with three counties, Hexi among them.

sentences.zh: 天寶後沒於蠻，為步雄部，後阿僰蠻易渠奪而居之。

translations.literal: After Tianbao it was lost to the barbarians and became the Buxiong Division; later the A Bo barbarian Yiqu seized it and dwelt there.
translations.idiomatic: After the Tianbao era it fell to tribal control as the Buxiong division until the A Bo chief Yiqu seized and settled it.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗六年內附。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Yuan Möngke it submitted from within.
translations.idiomatic: It submitted in 1256.

sentences.zh: 七年，即阿僰部立萬戶，休臘隸之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year a myriarch office was established for the A Bo Division, and Xiula was subordinated to it.
translations.idiomatic: In 1257 a myriarchate was established for the A Bo division with Xiula under its authority.

sentences.zh: 至元十三年，始為河西州，隸臨安路。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan it first became Hexi Prefecture, subordinate to Lin'an Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 it first became Hexi Prefecture under Lin'an Circuit.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，降為縣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year it was reduced to a county.
translations.idiomatic: In 1289 it was demoted to a county.

sentences.zh: 蒙自。

translations.literal: Mengzi.
translations.idiomatic: Mengzi.

sentences.zh: 下。

translations.literal: Lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower grade.

sentences.zh: 縣界南鄰交趾，西近建水州。

translations.literal: The county border adjoins Jiaozhi to the south and lies close to Jianshui Prefecture to the west.
translations.idiomatic: Its southern border touched Jiaozhi and its western edge lay near Jianshui Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 縣境有山名自則，漢語訛為蒙自，上有故城。

translations.literal: Within the county territory is a mountain called Zize; corrupted in Chinese speech to Mengzi; atop it is an old city.
translations.idiomatic: A mountain in the county called Zize was corrupted in Chinese to "Mengzi"; an old city stood on its summit.

sentences.zh: 白夷所築，即今縣治，下臨巴甸。

translations.literal: The Bo Yi built it — that is today's county seat; below it overlooks Badian.
translations.idiomatic: Built by the Bo tribes, it became the present county seat overlooking Badian below.

sentences.zh: 南詔時以趙氏鎮守，至段氏，阿僰蠻居之。

translations.literal: During Nanzhao the Zhao clan was posted to guard it; by the Duan clan the A Bo barbarians dwelt there.
translations.idiomatic: Under Nanzhao the Zhao clan held it as garrison; under the Duan dynasty the A Bo tribe settled there.

sentences.zh: 憲宗六年內附，繼叛，七年平之，立千戶，隸阿僰萬戶。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Möngke it submitted from within; subsequently it rebelled; in the seventh year it was pacified; a chiliarch office was established, subordinate to the A Bo myriarch office.
translations.idiomatic: It submitted in 1256, rebelled soon after, and was pacified in 1257; a chiliarchate was then established under the A Bo myriarchate.

sentences.zh: 至元十三年，改阿僰萬戶為臨安路，以本千戶為縣。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan the A Bo myriarch office was changed to Lin'an Circuit, and this chiliarch office became a county.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 the A Bo myriarchate became Lin'an Circuit and this chiliarchate became a county.

sentences.zh: 舍資千戶。

translations.literal: Shezi Chiliarch Office.
translations.idiomatic: Shezi Chiliarchate.

sentences.zh: 蒙自縣之東，阿僰蠻所居地。

translations.literal: East of Mengzi County — land where the A Bo barbarians dwelt.
translations.idiomatic: East of Mengzi County, where the A Bo tribe lived.

sentences.zh: 昔名褒古，又曰部嫋踵甸。

translations.literal: Formerly called Baogu, also called Buniaozhong dian.
translations.idiomatic: It was once called Baogu, also known as Buniaozhong dian.

sentences.zh: 傳至裔孫舍資，因以為名。

translations.literal: Passed down to descendant Shezi, and thereby took its name.
translations.idiomatic: When it passed to the descendant Shezi, it took his name.

sentences.zh: 內附後，隸蒙自千戶。

translations.literal: After submitting from within, it was subordinate to the Mengzi chiliarch office.
translations.idiomatic: After submission it came under the Mengzi chiliarchate.

sentences.zh: 至元十三年，改蒙自為縣，其地近交趾，遂以舍資為安南道防送軍千戶，隸臨安路。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan Mengzi was changed to a county; since the land lay close to Jiaozhi, Shezi was made the Annam Circuit Escort Army chiliarch office, subordinate to Lin'an Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 Mengzi became a county; because the region bordered Jiaozhi, Shezi was made an escort-army chiliarchate on the Annam route under Lin'an Circuit.

sentences.zh: 建水州，下。

translations.literal: Jianshui Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Jianshui Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 在本路之南，近接交趾，為雲南極邊。

translations.literal: It lies south of this circuit, closely adjoining Jiaozhi — the extreme border of Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: South of the circuit, abutting Jiaozhi, it marked Yunnan's outermost frontier.

sentences.zh: 治故建水城，唐元和間蒙氏所築，古稱步頭，亦云巴甸。

translations.literal: Its seat is the former Jianshui City — built by the Meng clan during Tang Yuanhe, anciently called Butou, also called Badian.
translations.idiomatic: Its seat was old Jianshui City, built by the Meng clan in the Tang Yuanhe era, anciently called Butou, also known as Badian.

sentences.zh: 每秋夏溪水漲溢如海，夷謂海為惠，曆刂為大，故名惠曆刂，漢語曰建水，曆趙、楊、李、段數姓，皆仍舊名，些麼徒蠻所居。

translations.literal: Each autumn and summer stream waters swell and overflow like a sea; among the Yi "sea" is hui and lì means "great," hence the name Huili — in Chinese called Jianshui. Through the Zhao, Yang, Li, and Duan clans in succession, all kept the old name; the Xiemo Tu barbarians dwelt there.
translations.idiomatic: Each autumn and summer the streams flooded like a sea; in Yi hui meant "sea" and lì meant "great," giving the name Huili — rendered in Chinese as Jianshui. Under the Zhao, Yang, Li, and Duan clans in turn it kept its old name; the Xiemo Tu tribe lived there.

sentences.zh: 內附後，立千戶，隸阿僰萬戶。

translations.literal: After submitting from within, a chiliarch office was established, subordinate to the A Bo myriarch office.
translations.idiomatic: After submission a chiliarchate was established under the A Bo myriarchate.

sentences.zh: 至元十三年，改建水州，隸臨安路。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan it was changed to Jianshui Prefecture, subordinate to Lin'an Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 it became Jianshui Prefecture under Lin'an Circuit.

sentences.zh: 石平州，下。

translations.literal: Shiping Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Shiping Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 在路之西南，阿僰蠻據之，得石坪，聚為居邑，名曰石坪。

translations.literal: Southwest of the circuit; the A Bo barbarians held it — they obtained Shiping, gathered into a settlement, called Shiping.
translations.idiomatic: Southwest of the circuit, the A Bo tribe settled on a stone plateau they called Shiping and formed a town there.

sentences.zh: 至元七年，改邑為州，隸臨安路。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Zhiyuan the settlement was changed to a prefecture, subordinate to Lin'an Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1270 the settlement became Shiping Prefecture under Lin'an Circuit.

sentences.zh: 寧州，下。

translations.literal: Ning Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Ning Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 在本路之東。

translations.literal: It lies east of this circuit.
translations.idiomatic: East of the circuit.

sentences.zh: 唐置黎州，天寶末沒於蠻。

translations.literal: In Tang Lizhou was established; at the end of Tianbao it was lost to the barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang established Lizhou there; at the end of the Tianbao era it fell to tribal control.

sentences.zh: 地號浪曠，夷語謂旱龍也。

translations.literal: The place was called Langkuang — in Yi speech it means "drought dragon."
translations.idiomatic: The region was called Langkuang, Yi for "drought dragon."

sentences.zh: 步雄部蠻些麼徒據之，後屬爨蠻酋阿幾，以浪曠割與寧酋豆圭。

translations.literal: The Buxiong Division Xiemo Tu barbarians held it; later it belonged to the Cuan barbarian chieftain Aji, who carved off Langkuang and gave it to the Ning chieftain Dougui.
translations.idiomatic: The Buxiong Xiemo Tu held it until Cuan chief Aji ceded Langkuang to Ning chief Dougui.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗四年，寧酋內附。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yuan Möngke the Ning chieftain submitted from within.
translations.idiomatic: In 1254 the Ning chieftain submitted.

sentences.zh: 至元十三年，改為寧州，隸臨安路。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan it was changed to Ning Prefecture, subordinate to Lin'an Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 it became Ning Prefecture under Lin'an Circuit.

sentences.zh: 舊領三縣：通海，嶍峨，西沙。

translations.literal: Formerly it governed three counties: Tonghai, Xian'e, and Xisha.
translations.idiomatic: It formerly administered three counties: Tonghai, Xian'e, and Xisha.

sentences.zh: 西沙在州東，寧部蠻世居之。

translations.literal: Xisha lay east of the prefecture; the Ning Division barbarians had dwelt there for generations.
translations.idiomatic: Xisha lay east of the prefecture, long home to the Ning division tribes.

sentences.zh: 其裔孫西沙築城於此，因名西沙籠。

translations.literal: His descendant Xisha built a city here, hence the name Xisha Long.
translations.idiomatic: His descendant Xisha built a fort there, giving it the name Xisha Long.

sentences.zh: 憲宗四年，其酋普提內附，就居此城為萬戶。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Möngke its chieftain Puti submitted from within and, dwelling in this city, became a myriarch office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1254 chieftain Puti submitted and established his myriarchate in that city.

sentences.zh: 至元十三年，立為西沙縣。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan it was established as Xisha County.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 Xisha County was established.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，以隸寧州。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year it was made subordinate to Ning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1289 it was transferred to Ning Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 至治二年，併入州。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhizhi it was merged into the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1322 it was incorporated into the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 領二縣：

translations.literal: It governs two counties:
translations.idiomatic: It administered two counties:

sentences.zh: 通海，下。

translations.literal: Tonghai, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Tonghai County, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 倚郭。

translations.literal: Attached to the seat of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Seat of the prefectural administration.

sentences.zh: 元初立通海千戶，隸善闡萬戶。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yuan a Tonghai chiliarch office was established, subordinate to the Shanchan myriarch office.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Yuan dynasty a Tonghai chiliarchate was established under the Shanchan myriarchate.

sentences.zh: 至元十三年，改通海縣，隸寧海府。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan it was changed to Tonghai County, subordinate to Ninghai Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 it became Tonghai County under Ninghai Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，府革，直隸臨安路，今割隸寧州。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year the prefecture was abolished and it was directly subordinate to Lin'an Circuit; now it has been carved out and placed under Ning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1290 the prefecture was abolished and it came directly under Lin'an Circuit; it was later transferred to Ning Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 嶍峨。

translations.literal: Xian'e.
translations.idiomatic: Xian'e.

sentences.zh: 下。

translations.literal: Lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower grade.

sentences.zh: 縣在河西縣之西，控扼山谷，北接滇池，亦屬滇國。

translations.literal: The county lies west of Hexi County, controlling mountain passes and valleys; to the north it adjoins Dian Lake — it also belonged to the Dian kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: West of Hexi County, it guarded mountain passes north of Dian Lake and had once belonged to the kingdom of Dian.

sentences.zh: 昔嶍猊蠻居之，後阿僰酋逐嶍猊據其地。

translations.literal: Formerly the Xianni barbarians dwelt there; later the A Bo chieftain drove out the Xianni and seized the land.
translations.idiomatic: The Xianni tribe lived there until an A Bo chief expelled them and took the territory.

sentences.zh: 至其孫阿次內附，以其部立千戶。

translations.literal: When his grandson A Ci submitted from within, his division was made a chiliarch office.
translations.idiomatic: When his grandson A Ci submitted, his division became a chiliarchate.

sentences.zh: 至元十三年，改為州，領邛洲、平甸二縣。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan it was changed to a prefecture, governing Qiongzhou and Pingdian counties.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 it became a prefecture administering Qiongzhou and Pingdian counties.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，降為縣，並二縣為鄉，隸臨安路。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year it was reduced to a county; the two counties were merged into townships, subordinate to Lin'an Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1289 it was demoted to a county, its two counties merged into townships under Lin'an Circuit.

sentences.zh: 今割隸寧州。

translations.literal: Now it has been carved out and placed under Ning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: It was later transferred to Ning Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 廣西路，下。

translations.literal: Guangxi Circuit, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi Circuit, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 東爨烏蠻彌鹿等部所居。

translations.literal: Where the Eastern Cuan Wuman Mili and other divisions dwelt.
translations.idiomatic: Home to the Eastern Cuan Wuman Mili and related divisions.

sentences.zh: 唐為羈縻州，隸黔州都督府。

translations.literal: Under Tang it was a jimi prefecture, subordinate to the Qianzhou Area Command.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang it was a jimi (indirectly ruled) prefecture under the Qianzhou area command.

sentences.zh: 後師宗、彌勒二部浸盛，蒙氏、段氏莫能制。

translations.literal: Later the Shizong and Mile divisions gradually grew strong; neither the Meng nor Duan clans could control them.
translations.idiomatic: Later the Shizong and Mile divisions grew powerful beyond the Meng or Duan clans' control.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗七年，二部內附，隸落蒙萬戶。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Yuan Möngke the two divisions submitted from within, subordinate to the Luomeng myriarch office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1257 both divisions submitted under the Luomeng myriarchate.

sentences.zh: 至元十二年，籍二部為軍，立廣西路。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan the two divisions were registered as troops and Guangxi Circuit was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1275 both divisions were registered as military households and Guangxi Circuit was established.

sentences.zh: 十八年，復為民。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year they were again made civilians.
translations.idiomatic: In 1281 they reverted to civilian status.

sentences.zh: 領州二。

translations.literal: It governs two prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: It administered two prefectures.

sentences.zh: 師宗州，下。

translations.literal: Shizong Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Shizong Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 在路之東南。

translations.literal: Southeast of the circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Southeast of the circuit.

sentences.zh: 昔爨蠻逐獠、僰等居之，其後師宗據匿弄甸，故名師宗部。

translations.literal: Formerly the Cuan barbarians drove out the Liao, Bo, and others to dwell there; afterward Shizong seized Ninong dian, hence the Shizong Division.
translations.idiomatic: Cuan tribes displaced the Liao and Bo peoples; later Shizong held Ninong dian and gave his name to the division.

sentences.zh: 至元十二年，立為千戶。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan it was established as a chiliarch office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1275 a chiliarchate was established.

sentences.zh: 十八年，復為民。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year it was again made civilians.
translations.idiomatic: In 1281 it reverted to civilian status.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，改為州。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year it was changed to a prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1290 it became a prefecture.

sentences.zh: 彌勒州，下。

translations.literal: Mile Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Mile Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 在路南。

translations.literal: South of the circuit.
translations.idiomatic: South of the circuit.

sentences.zh: 昔些莫徒蠻之裔彌勒得郭甸、巴甸、部籠而居之，故名其部曰彌勒。

translations.literal: A descendant of the Xiemo Tu barbarian named Mile obtained Guo dian, Ba dian, and Bulong and dwelt there; hence his division was called Mile.
translations.idiomatic: Mile, descended from the Xiemo Tu, settled in Guo dian, Ba dian, and Bulong and named his division after himself.

sentences.zh: 至元十二年，為千戶。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan it became a chiliarch office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1275 it became a chiliarchate.

sentences.zh: 十八年，復為民。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year it was again made civilians.
translations.idiomatic: In 1281 it reverted to civilian status.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，改為州。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year it was changed to a prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1290 it became a prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元江路，下。

translations.literal: Yuanjiang Circuit, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanjiang Circuit, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 古西南夷地。

translations.literal: Ancient land of the Southwestern Yi.
translations.idiomatic: An ancient domain of the southwestern tribes.

sentences.zh: 今元江在梁州之西南，又當在黑水之西南也。

translations.literal: Present-day Yuanjiang lies southwest of Liang Province, and also ought to lie southwest of the Black River.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanjiang lay southwest of Liang Province and southwest of the Black River.

sentences.zh: 阿僰諸部蠻自昔據之。

translations.literal: The various A Bo divisions of barbarians had held it since ancient times.
translations.idiomatic: Various A Bo tribal divisions had held it since antiquity.

sentences.zh: 憲宗四年內附，七年復叛，率諸部築城以拒命。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Möngke it submitted from within; in the seventh year it rebelled again, leading the various divisions to build cities to resist command.
translations.idiomatic: It submitted in 1254, rebelled again in 1257, and led the tribal divisions in fortifying towns to resist the Yuan.

sentences.zh: 至元十三年，遙立元江府以羈縻之。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan Yuanjiang Prefecture was established from afar to keep them on jimi terms.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 Yuanjiang Prefecture was established at a distance as a jimi (indirectly ruled) jurisdiction over them.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，命雲南王討平之，割羅盤、馬籠、步日、思麼、羅醜、羅陀、步騰、步竭、台威、台陽、設棲、你陀十二部於威遠，立元江路。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year the Prince of Yunnan was ordered to campaign and pacify them; the twelve divisions of Luopan, Malong, Buri, Simo, Luochou, Luotuo, Buteng, Bujie, Taiwei, Taiyang, Sheqi, and Nituo were carved off to Weiyuan and Yuanjiang Circuit was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1288 the Prince of Yunnan was sent to pacify the region; twelve divisions — Luopan, Malong, Buri, Simo, Luochou, Luotuo, Buteng, Bujie, Taiwei, Taiyang, Sheqi, and Nituo — were assigned to Weiyuan and Yuanjiang Circuit was established.

sentences.zh: 步日部。

translations.literal: Buri Division.
translations.idiomatic: Buri Division.

sentences.zh: 在本路之西。

translations.literal: West of this circuit.
translations.idiomatic: West of the circuit.

sentences.zh: 蒙氏立此甸，徙白蠻鎮之，名步日瞼。

translations.literal: The Meng clan established this dian, relocated Bo barbarians to garrison it — called Buri lian.
translations.idiomatic: The Meng clan established this district and posted Bo tribes to garrison it as Buri lian.

sentences.zh: 馬籠部。

translations.literal: Malong Division.
translations.idiomatic: Malong Division.

sentences.zh: 因馬籠山立寨，在本路之北，所居蠻阿僰。

translations.literal: A stockade was established because of Malong Mountain; north of this circuit; the barbarians who dwelt there were A Bo.
translations.idiomatic: A stockade was built on Malong Mountain north of the circuit, home to the A Bo tribe.

sentences.zh: 元初立為千戶，屬甯州萬戶。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yuan it was established as a chiliarch office, belonging to the Ningzhou myriarch office.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Yuan a chiliarchate was established under the Ningzhou myriarchate.

sentences.zh: 至元十三年，改隸元江萬戶。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan it was changed to be subordinate to the Yuanjiang myriarch office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 it was transferred to the Yuanjiang myriarchate.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，屬元江路。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year it belonged to Yuanjiang Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1288 it came under Yuanjiang Circuit.

sentences.zh: 大理金齒等處宣慰司都元帥府

translations.literal: Pacification Commission and Chief Military Command for Dali, Jinchi, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Military Command of the Pacification Commission for Dali, Jinchi, and other districts.

sentences.zh: 大理路軍民總管府，上。

translations.literal: Dali Circuit Military-Civilian General Office, upper rank.
translations.idiomatic: Dali Circuit Military-Civilian General Office, upper grade.

sentences.zh: 本漢楪榆縣地。

translations.literal: Originally the land of Han Dieru County.
translations.idiomatic: Originally the territory of Han Dieru County.

sentences.zh: 唐于昆明之梇棟川置姚州都督府，治楪榆洱河蠻。

translations.literal: In Tang at Kunming's Qiongdong Chuan the Yaozhou Area Command was established, governing the Dieru and Erhe barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang established the Yaozhou area command at Qiongdong Chuan in Kunming to govern the Dieru and Erhe tribes.

sentences.zh: 後蒙舍詔皮羅閣逐河蠻取太和城，至閣羅鳳號大蒙國。

translations.literal: Later Pi Luoge of the Mengshe chao drove out the Erhe barbarians and took Taihe City; by the time of Geluofeng it was styled the Great Meng State.
translations.idiomatic: Later Pi Luoge of Mengshe drove out the Erhe tribes and seized Taihe City; under Geluofeng the realm was styled Great Meng.

sentences.zh: 雲南先有六詔，至是請於朝，求合為一，從之。

translations.literal: Yunnan originally had six chao; at this time they requested of the court to merge into one — it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan had six chao; they now petitioned the Tang court to unite as one state, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 蒙舍在其南，故稱南詔。

translations.literal: Mengshe lay to its south, hence it was called Nanzhao.
translations.idiomatic: Because Mengshe lay to the south, the realm was called Nanzhao, "Southern Zhao."

sentences.zh: 徙治太和城。

translations.literal: The seat of government was moved to Taihe City.
translations.idiomatic: The capital was moved to Taihe City.

sentences.zh: 至異牟尋又遷于喜郡史城，又徙居羊苴乖城，即今府治。

translations.literal: By Yimouxun it was again moved to Xijun Shicheng, then again relocated to Yangju Guai City — that is, today's prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: Yimouxun moved it to Xijun Shicheng and then to Yangjumie City, the present prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 改號大禮國。

translations.literal: The designation was changed to the Great Li State.
translations.idiomatic: The realm was renamed Great Li.

sentences.zh: 其後鄭、趙、楊三氏互相篡奪，至石晉時，段思平更號大理國。

translations.literal: Afterward the Zheng, Zhao, and Yang clans successively usurped one another; by the time of Later Jin Duan Siping changed the designation to the Dali State.
translations.idiomatic: The Zheng, Zhao, and Yang clans then seized power in turn until Duan Siping renamed the realm Dali under Later Jin.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗三年收附。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yuan Möngke it was brought under submission.
translations.idiomatic: It was brought under Yuan control in 1253.

sentences.zh: 六年，立上下二萬戶。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, upper and lower myriarch offices were established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1256 upper and lower myriarchates were established.

sentences.zh: 至元七年，並二萬戶為大理路。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Zhiyuan the two myriarch offices were merged into Dali Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1270 the upper and lower myriarchates were combined as Dali Circuit.

sentences.zh: 有點蒼山在大理城西，周廣四百里，為雲南形勝要害之地。

translations.literal: There is Diancang Mountain west of Dali City; its circumference is four hundred li — a strategically vital place of scenic advantage in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Diancang Mountain west of Dali City sprawled four hundred li around its base and formed Yunnan's chief strategic stronghold.

sentences.zh: 城中有五花樓，唐大中十年，南詔王券豐佑所建。

translations.literal: Within the city is the Five-Flower Tower — in the tenth year of Tang Dazhong it was built by Nanzhao King Quan Fengyou.
translations.idiomatic: Within the city stood the Five-Flower Tower, built in 856 by Nanzhao King Quan Fengyou.

sentences.zh: 樓方五里，高百尺，上可容萬人。

translations.literal: The tower measured five li square, stood one hundred chi high, and its upper level could hold ten thousand people.
translations.idiomatic: The tower measured five li on a side, rose one hundred chi, and its upper level could hold ten thousand people.

sentences.zh: 世祖征大理時，駐兵樓前。

translations.literal: When Kublai Khan campaigned against Dali, he stationed troops before the tower.
translations.idiomatic: When Kublai Khan campaigned against Dali, he encamped his army before the tower.

sentences.zh: 至元三年，嘗賜金重修焉。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhiyuan gold was once granted to rebuild it.
translations.idiomatic: In 1266 imperial gold was granted to restore it.

sentences.zh: 領司一、縣一、府二、州五。

translations.literal: It governed one office, one county, two prefectures, and five subprefectures.
translations.idiomatic: It administered one office, one county, two fu-level prefectures, and five subprefectures.

sentences.zh: 府領一縣，州領二縣。

translations.literal: Each fu governed one county; each subprefecture governed two counties.
translations.idiomatic: The fu-level prefectures each administered one county; the subprefectures each administered two counties.

sentences.zh: 錄事司。

translations.literal: Recordkeeping Office.
translations.idiomatic: Office of Recordkeeping.

sentences.zh: 憲宗七年，立中千戶，屬大理萬戶。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Möngke the central chiliarch office was established, subordinate to the Dali myriarch office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1257 the central chiliarchate was established under the Dali myriarchate.

sentences.zh: 至元十一年，罷千戶，立錄事司。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Zhiyuan the chiliarch office was abolished and a Recordkeeping Office was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1274 the chiliarchate was abolished and an Office of Recordkeeping was established.

sentences.zh: 十二年，升理州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year it was promoted to Li Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1275 it was elevated to Li Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，州罷，復立錄事司。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year the prefecture was abolished and the Recordkeeping Office was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1284 the prefecture was abolished and the Office of Recordkeeping was restored.

sentences.zh: 太和。

translations.literal: Taihe.
translations.idiomatic: Taihe.

sentences.zh: 倚郭。

translations.literal: Attached to the seat of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Seat of the circuit administration.

sentences.zh: 憲宗七年，於城內外立上中下三千戶。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Möngke upper, middle, and lower chiliarch offices were established inside and outside the city.
translations.idiomatic: In 1257 upper, middle, and lower chiliarchates were established inside and outside the city walls.

sentences.zh: 至元二十六年，即中千戶立錄事司，上下二千戶立縣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year of Zhiyuan the central chiliarch office became a Recordkeeping Office, and the upper and lower chiliarch offices became a county.
translations.idiomatic: In 1289 the central chiliarchate became an Office of Recordkeeping and the upper and lower chiliarchates were combined as a county.

sentences.zh: 永昌府，唐時蒙氏據其地，曆段氏、高氏皆為永昌府。

translations.literal: Yongchang Prefecture — during Tang the Meng clan held this land; through the Duan and Gao clans it remained Yongchang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yongchang Prefecture: the Meng clan held it under the Tang, and under the Duan and Gao clans it remained Yongchang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗七年，分永昌之永平立千戶。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Yuan Möngke Yongping was split off from Yongchang and made a chiliarch office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1257 Yongping was carved out of Yongchang as a chiliarchate.

sentences.zh: 至元十一年，立永昌州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Zhiyuan Yongchang Prefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1274 Yongchang Prefecture was established.

sentences.zh: 十五年升為府，隸大理路。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year it was promoted to a fu and subordinated to Dali Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1278 it was elevated to fu-level status under Dali Circuit.

sentences.zh: 領一縣：

translations.literal: It governed one county:
translations.idiomatic: It administered one county:

sentences.zh: 永平。

translations.literal: Yongping.
translations.idiomatic: Yongping.

sentences.zh: 下。

translations.literal: Lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower grade.

sentences.zh: 縣在府東，鹿滄江之東，即漢博平縣。

translations.literal: The county lies east of the prefecture, east of the Lucang River — that is Han Boping County.
translations.idiomatic: East of the prefecture, across the Lucang River, it occupied the site of Han Boping County.

sentences.zh: 唐蒙氏改勝鄉郡，屬永昌。

translations.literal: Under Tang the Meng clan changed it to Shengxiang Commandery, subordinate to Yongchang.
translations.idiomatic: The Meng clan renamed it Shengxiang Commandery under Yongchang in the Tang.

sentences.zh: 至元十一年，改永平縣，隸永昌府。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Zhiyuan it was changed to Yongping County, subordinate to Yongchang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1274 it became Yongping County under Yongchang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 騰衝府，在永昌之西，即越睒地。

translations.literal: Tengchong Prefecture lies west of Yongchang — that is Yue xian territory.
translations.idiomatic: Tengchong Prefecture lay west of Yongchang in the Yue xian region.

sentences.zh: 唐置羈縻郡。

translations.literal: Under Tang a jimi commandery was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang established a jimi (indirectly ruled) commandery there.

sentences.zh: 蒙氏九世孫異牟尋取越睒，逐諸蠻有其地，為軟化府。

translations.literal: The Meng clan's ninth-generation descendant Yimouxun took Yue xian, drove out the various barbarians and seized the land — it became Ruanhua Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yimouxun, ninth in the Meng line, seized Yue xian, expelled the tribal peoples, and established Ruanhua Prefecture there.

sentences.zh: 其後白蠻徙居之，改騰衝府。

translations.literal: Afterward the Bo barbarians migrated and dwelt there; it was changed to Tengchong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Later the Bo tribes settled there and it was renamed Tengchong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗三年，府酋高救內附。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yuan Möngke the prefectural chieftain Gao Jiu submitted from within.
translations.idiomatic: In 1253 prefecture chief Gao Jiu submitted.

sentences.zh: 至元十一年，改藤越州，又立藤越縣。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Zhiyuan it was changed to Tengyue Prefecture, and Tengyue County was also established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1274 it became Tengyue Prefecture and Tengyue County was established.

sentences.zh: 十四年，改騰衝府。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year it was changed to Tengchong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1277 it was renamed Tengchong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，罷州縣，府如故。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year the prefecture and county were abolished; the fu remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: In 1288 the prefecture and county were abolished and only the fu remained.

sentences.zh: 永昌、騰衝二府軍民屯田共二萬二千一百五雙。

translations.literal: The military-civilian colonization fields of the two prefectures of Yongchang and Tengchong totaled twenty-two thousand one hundred five shuang.
translations.idiomatic: Yongchang and Tengchong together maintained 22,105 shuang of military-civilian colonization land.

sentences.zh: 鄧川州，下。

translations.literal: Dengchuan Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Dengchuan Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 在本路北。

translations.literal: North of this circuit.
translations.idiomatic: North of the circuit.

sentences.zh: 夷有六詔，邆睒其一也。

translations.literal: Among the Yi there were six chao; Deng xian was one of them.
translations.idiomatic: Of the six chao among the tribes, Deng xian was one.

sentences.zh: 唐置邆川州，治大釐。

translations.literal: Under Tang Dengchuan Prefecture was established, seated at Dali.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang established Dengchuan Prefecture with its seat at Dali.

sentences.zh: 蒙氏襲而奪之，後改德原城，隸大理。

translations.literal: The Meng clan attacked and seized it; later it was changed to Deyuan City, subordinate to Dali.
translations.idiomatic: The Meng clan seized it by force, renamed it Deyuan City, and placed it under Dali.

sentences.zh: 段氏因之。

translations.literal: The Duan clan continued this.
translations.idiomatic: The Duan clan retained this arrangement.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗三年內附。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yuan Möngke it submitted from within.
translations.idiomatic: It submitted in 1253.

sentences.zh: 七年，立德原千戶，隸大理上萬戶。

translations.literal: In the seventh year the Deyuan chiliarch office was established, subordinate to the Upper Dali myriarch office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1257 the Deyuan chiliarchate was established under the upper Dali myriarchate.

sentences.zh: 至元十一年，改德原城為鄧川州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Zhiyuan Deyuan City was changed to Dengchuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1274 Deyuan City became Dengchuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 領一縣：

translations.literal: It governed one county:
translations.idiomatic: It administered one county:

sentences.zh: 浪穹。

translations.literal: Langqiong.
translations.idiomatic: Langqiong.

sentences.zh: 下。

translations.literal: Lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lower grade.

sentences.zh: 本名彌茨，乃浪穹詔所居之地。

translations.literal: Originally named Mici — the dwelling place of the Langqiong chao.
translations.idiomatic: Originally called Mici, it was the homeland of the Langqiong chao.

sentences.zh: 唐初，其王鐸羅望與南詔戰，不勝，保劍川，更稱劍浪。

translations.literal: In early Tang its king Duo Luowang fought Nanzhao and was defeated; he held Jianchuan and changed the name to Jianlang.
translations.idiomatic: In early Tang King Duo Luowang fought Nanzhao and, defeated, held Jianchuan and styled his realm Jianlang.

sentences.zh: 貞元中，南詔破之，以浪穹、施浪、鄧睒總三浪為浪穹州。

translations.literal: During Zhenyuan Nanzhao broke them; taking Langqiong, Shilang, and Deng xian — the three Lang in all — it made Langqiong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhenyuan era Nanzhao defeated them and, combining Langqiong, Shilang, and Deng xian as the "Three Lang," created Langqiong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗七年內附，立浪穹千戶，隸大理上萬戶。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Möngke it submitted from within; the Langqiong chiliarch office was established, subordinate to the Upper Dali myriarch office.
translations.idiomatic: It submitted in 1257; a Langqiong chiliarchate was established under the upper Dali myriarchate.

sentences.zh: 至元十一年降為縣，隸鄧川州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Zhiyuan it was reduced to a county, subordinate to Dengchuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1274 it was demoted to a county under Dengchuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 蒙化州，下。

translations.literal: Menghua Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Menghua Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 本蒙舍城。

translations.literal: Originally Mengshe City.
translations.idiomatic: It was originally Mengshe City.

sentences.zh: 唐置陽瓜州。

translations.literal: Under Tang Yanggua Prefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang established Yanggua Prefecture there.

sentences.zh: 天寶間，鳳伽異為州刺史。

translations.literal: During Tianbao Feng Jiayi was prefectural governor.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tianbao era Feng Jiayi served as prefect.

sentences.zh: 段氏為開南縣。

translations.literal: Under the Duan clan it was Kainan County.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Duan dynasty it became Kainan County.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗七年，以蒙舍立千戶，屬大理上萬戶。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Yuan Möngke a chiliarch office was established at Mengshe, belonging to the Upper Dali myriarch office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1257 a chiliarchate was established at Mengshe under the upper Dali myriarchate.

sentences.zh: 至元十一年，立蒙化府。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Zhiyuan Menghua Prefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1274 Menghua Prefecture was established.

sentences.zh: 十四年，升為路。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year it was promoted to a circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1277 it was elevated to circuit status.

sentences.zh: 二十年，降為州，復隸大理路。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year it was reduced to a subprefecture and again subordinated to Dali Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1283 it was demoted to a subprefecture and restored to Dali Circuit.

sentences.zh: 趙州，下。

translations.literal: Zhao Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 昔為羅落蠻所居地。

translations.literal: Formerly land where the Luoluo barbarians dwelt.
translations.idiomatic: It was once home to the Luoluo tribes.

sentences.zh: 蒙氏立國，有十瞼，趙川瞼其一也。

translations.literal: When the Meng clan established their state there were ten lian; Zhaochuan lian was one of them.
translations.idiomatic: When the Meng founded their realm they organized ten lian districts; Zhaochuan lian was one.

sentences.zh: 夷語瞼若州。

translations.literal: In Yi speech lian means "prefecture."
translations.idiomatic: In tribal speech lian corresponded to a prefecture.

sentences.zh: 皮羅閣置趙郡，閣羅鳳改為州，段氏改天水郡。

translations.literal: Pi Luoge established Zhao Commandery; Geluofeng changed it to a prefecture; the Duan clan changed it to Tianshui Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Pi Luoge set up Zhao Commandery; Geluofeng made it a prefecture; the Duan clan renamed it Tianshui Commandery.

sentences.zh: 憲宗七年立趙瞼千戶，隸大理下萬戶。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Möngke the Zhaolian chiliarch office was established, subordinate to the Lower Dali myriarch office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1257 the Zhaolian chiliarchate was established under the lower Dali myriarchate.

sentences.zh: 至元十一年改為州，又于白崖瞼立建寧縣，隸本州，即古勃弄地。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Zhiyuan it was changed to a prefecture; at Baiya lian Jianning County was also established, subordinate to this prefecture — that is ancient Bolong territory.
translations.idiomatic: In 1274 it became a prefecture; Jianning County was also established at Baiya lian under its jurisdiction — ancient Bolong territory.

sentences.zh: 二十五年縣革入州，隸大理路。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year the county was abolished and merged into the prefecture, subordinate to Dali Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1288 the county was abolished and absorbed into the prefecture under Dali Circuit.

sentences.zh: 姚州，下。

translations.literal: Yao Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 唐于梇棟川置姚州都督府。

translations.literal: Under Tang the Yaozhou Area Command was established at Qiongdong Chuan.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang established the Yaozhou area command at Qiongdong Chuan.

sentences.zh: 天寶間，閣羅鳳叛，取姚州，附吐蕃。

translations.literal: During Tianbao Geluofeng rebelled, took Yaozhou, and submitted to Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tianbao era Geluofeng rebelled, seized Yaozhou, and allied with Tibet.

sentences.zh: 終段氏為姚州。

translations.literal: Through the Duan clan it remained Yaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Duan dynasty it remained Yaozhou.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗三年內附。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yuan Möngke it submitted from within.
translations.idiomatic: It submitted in 1253.

sentences.zh: 七年，立統矢千戶、大姚堡千戶。

translations.literal: In the seventh year the Tongshi chiliarch office and Dayao Fort chiliarch office were established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1257 the Tongshi and Dayao Fort chiliarchates were established.

sentences.zh: 至元十二年，罷統矢，立姚州，隸大理路。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan Tongshi was abolished and Yao Prefecture established, subordinate to Dali Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1275 Tongshi was abolished and Yao Prefecture established under Dali Circuit.

sentences.zh: 領一縣：

translations.literal: It governed one county:
translations.idiomatic: It administered one county:

sentences.zh: 大姚，下。

translations.literal: Dayao, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Dayao County, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 唐置西濮州，後更名髳州，南接姚州，統縣四，一曰青蛉，即此地。

translations.literal: Under Tang Xi Pu Prefecture was established, later renamed Mao Prefecture; south it adjoined Yaozhou, governing four counties — one called Qingling, which is this place.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang established Xi Pu Prefecture, later renamed Mao Prefecture, south of which lay Yaozhou with four counties — Qingling being this site.

sentences.zh: 夷名大姚堡，與梇棟川相接。

translations.literal: Among the Yi it was called Dayao Fort, adjoining Qiongdong Chuan.
translations.idiomatic: The tribes called it Dayao Fort, bordering Qiongdong Chuan.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗七年，立千戶，隸大理下萬戶。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Yuan Möngke a chiliarch office was established, subordinate to the Lower Dali myriarch office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1257 a chiliarchate was established under the lower Dali myriarchate.

sentences.zh: 至元十一年，罷千戶立大姚縣，隸姚州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Zhiyuan the chiliarch office was abolished and Dayao County was established, subordinate to Yao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1274 the chiliarchate was abolished and Dayao County established under Yao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 雲南州，下。

translations.literal: Yunnan Prefecture, lower rank.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan Prefecture, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 唐以漢雲南縣置郡。

translations.literal: Under Tang a commandery was established on the basis of Han Yunnan County.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang created a commandery based on Han Yunnan County.

sentences.zh: 蒙氏至段氏並為雲南州。

translations.literal: From the Meng clan through the Duan clan it was always Yunnan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: From the Meng through the Duan dynasties it remained Yunnan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗七年立千戶，隸大理下萬戶。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Yuan Möngke a chiliarch office was established, subordinate to the Lower Dali myriarch office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1257 a chiliarchate was established under the lower Dali myriarchate.

sentences.zh: 至元十一年，立雲南州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Zhiyuan Yunnan Prefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1274 Yunnan Prefecture was established.

sentences.zh: 蒙憐路軍民府。

translations.literal: Menglian Circuit Military-Civilian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Menglian Circuit Military-Civilian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 至元二十七年，從雲南行省請，以蒙憐甸為蒙憐路軍民總管府，蒙萊甸為蒙萊路軍民總管府。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year of Zhiyuan, following a petition from the Yunnan Branch Secretariat, Menglian dian was made the Menglian Circuit Military-Civilian General Office and Mengla dian was made the Mengla Circuit Military-Civilian General Office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1290, at the Yunnan Branch Secretariat's request, Menglian dian became the Menglian Circuit military-civilian general office and Mengla dian became the Mengla Circuit military-civilian general office.

sentences.zh: 其餘闕。

translations.literal: The rest is absent.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder of the entry is missing.

sentences.zh: 蒙萊路軍民府。

translations.literal: Mengla Circuit Military-Civilian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Mengla Circuit Military-Civilian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 闕。

translations.literal: Lacuna.
translations.idiomatic: The text is missing.

sentences.zh: 金齒等處宣撫司。

translations.literal: Pacification Commissioner's Office for Jinchi and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification Commissioner's Office for Jinchi and other districts.

sentences.zh: 其地在大理西南，蘭滄江界其東，與緬地接其西。

translations.literal: Its territory lay southwest of Dali; the Lancang River bounded it on the east and Burmese territory adjoined it on the west.
translations.idiomatic: The region lay southwest of Dali, bounded on the east by the Lancang River and on the west by Burmese territory.

sentences.zh: 土蠻凡八種：曰金齒，曰白夷，曰僰，曰峨昌，曰驃，曰繲，曰渠羅，曰比蘇。

translations.literal: The indigenous barbarians numbered eight kinds: called Jinchi, Bo Yi, Bo, Echang, Piao, Xie, Quluo, and Bisū.
translations.idiomatic: Eight tribal peoples lived there: the Gold-Teeth, Bo Yi, Bo, Echang, Pyu, Xie, Quluo, and Bisū.

sentences.zh: 按《唐史》，茫施蠻本關南種，在永昌之南，樓居，無城郭。

translations.literal: According to the History of Tang, the Mangshi barbarians were originally of the Guannan strain; they lay south of Yongchang, dwelt in elevated houses, and had no walls or moats.
translations.idiomatic: The History of Tang records that the Mangshi tribes were originally of the Guannan strain, living south of Yongchang in elevated houses without walled towns.

sentences.zh: 或漆齒，或金齒，故俗呼金齒蠻。

translations.literal: Some lacquered their teeth, some gilded their teeth — hence they were popularly called the Gold-Teeth barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: Some lacquered their teeth and others gilded them, hence the popular name "Gold-Teeth tribes."

sentences.zh: 自漢開西南夷後，未嘗與中國通。

translations.literal: Since Han opened the Southwestern Yi, they had never communicated with China.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Han opened the southwest tribes to contact, they had never had dealings with the Chinese court.

sentences.zh: 唐南詔蒙氏興，異牟尋破群蠻，盡虜其人以實其南東北，取其地，南至青石山緬界，悉屬大理。

translations.literal: Under Tang, Nanzhao of the Meng clan rose; Yimouxun broke the various barbarians, fully captured their people to fill his south, east, and north, seized their land — south to Qingshi Mountain at the Burmese border — all belonging to Dali.
translations.idiomatic: When Nanzhao rose under the Meng in the Tang, Yimouxun crushed the tribal peoples, deporting them to populate his southern, eastern, and northern domains and seizing their lands south to Qingshi Mountain on the Burmese frontier — all of which fell under Dali.

sentences.zh: 及段氏時，白夷諸蠻漸復故地，是後金齒諸蠻浸盛。

translations.literal: In the time of the Duan clan, the Bo Yi and various barbarians gradually recovered their former lands; thereafter the Jinchi and various barbarians grew ever stronger.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Duan clan the Bo Yi tribes gradually reclaimed their old territories, and afterward the Gold-Teeth and related peoples grew steadily stronger.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗四年，平定大理，繼征白夷等蠻。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yuan Möngke, Dali was pacified, and afterward the Bo Yi and other barbarians were campaigned against.
translations.idiomatic: In 1254 Dali was conquered, and campaigns followed against the Bo Yi and other tribes.

sentences.zh: 中統初，金齒、白夷諸酋各遣子弟朝貢。

translations.literal: At the start of Zhongtong, the chiefs of Jinchi and Bo Yi each sent sons and younger relatives to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Zhongtong reign the Jinchi and Bo Yi chiefs each sent sons and kinsmen to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 二年，立安撫司以統之。

translations.literal: In the second year a pacification office was established to govern them.
translations.idiomatic: In 1261 a pacification office was established to oversee them.

sentences.zh: 至元八年，分金齒、白夷為東西兩路安撫使。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Zhiyuan, Jinchi and Bo Yi were divided into eastern and western circuit pacification commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: In 1271 Jinchi and Bo Yi were split into eastern and western circuit pacification commissioners.

sentences.zh: 十二年，改西路為建甯路，東路為鎮康路。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year the western circuit was changed to Jianning Circuit and the eastern circuit to Zhenkang Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1275 the western division became Jianning Circuit and the eastern Zhenkang Circuit.

sentences.zh: 十五年，改安撫為宣撫，立六路總管府。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year pacification was changed to extended pacification, and six circuit general offices were established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1278 the pacification offices were upgraded to extended pacification commissions and six circuit general administrations were established.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，罷兩路宣撫司，併入大理金齒等處宣撫司。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year the two circuit extended pacification offices were abolished and merged into the Dali Jinchi and other places Extended Pacification Office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1286 the two circuit extended pacification offices were abolished and absorbed into the Dali Jinchi extended pacification office.

sentences.zh: 柔遠路，在大理之西，永昌之南。

translations.literal: Rouryuan Circuit, west of Dali and south of Yongchang.
translations.idiomatic: Rouryuan Circuit lay west of Dali and south of Yongchang.

sentences.zh: 其地曰潞江，曰普坪瞼，曰申瞼僰寨，曰烏摩坪。

translations.literal: Its lands were called Lujiang, Puping Jian, Shenjian Bo Stockade, and Wumo Ping.
translations.idiomatic: The region comprised Lujiang, Puping Jian, Shenjian Bo Stockade, and Wumo Ping.

sentences.zh: 僰蠻即《通典》所謂黑爨也。

translations.literal: The Bo barbarians are what the Tongdian calls the Black Cuan.
translations.idiomatic: The Bo tribes were the Black Cuan described in the Tongdian.

sentences.zh: 中統初，僰酋阿八思入朝。

translations.literal: At the start of Zhongtong the Bo chief Abaisi came to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Zhongtong reign the Bo chief Abaisi came to court.

sentences.zh: 至元十三年，與茫施、鎮康、鎮西、平緬、麓川俱立為路，隸宣撫司。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan, together with Mangshi, Zhenkang, Zhenxi, Pingmian, and Luchuan it was all established as circuits and subordinated to the Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 Rouryuan was made a circuit along with Mangshi, Zhenkang, Zhenxi, Pingmian, and Luchuan, all under the pacification commission.

sentences.zh: 茫施路，在柔遠路之南，瀘江之西。

translations.literal: Mangshi Circuit, south of Rouryuan Circuit and west of the Lu River.
translations.idiomatic: Mangshi Circuit lay south of Rouryuan and west of the Lu River.

sentences.zh: 其地曰怒謀，曰大枯睒，曰小枯睒。

translations.literal: Its lands were called Numou, Dakushan, and Xiaokushan.
translations.idiomatic: The region comprised Numou, Dakushan, and Xiaokushan.

sentences.zh: 即《唐史》所謂茫施蠻也。

translations.literal: It is what the History of Tang calls the Mangshi barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: These were the Mangshi tribes recorded in the History of Tang.

sentences.zh: 中統初內附。

translations.literal: At the start of Zhongtong they submitted from within.
translations.idiomatic: They submitted to the court in the early Zhongtong reign.

sentences.zh: 至元十三年，立為路，隸宣撫司。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan it was established as a circuit and subordinated to the Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 it was made a circuit under the pacification commission.

sentences.zh: 鎮康路，在柔遠路之南，蘭江之西。

translations.literal: Zhenkang Circuit, south of Rouryuan Circuit and west of the Lan River.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenkang Circuit lay south of Rouryuan and west of the Lan River.

sentences.zh: 其地曰石睒，亦黑僰所居。

translations.literal: Its land was called Shishan; Black Bo also dwelt there.
translations.idiomatic: The region included Shishan, also home to the Black Bo.

sentences.zh: 中統初內附。

translations.literal: At the start of Zhongtong they submitted from within.
translations.idiomatic: They submitted to the court in the early Zhongtong reign.

sentences.zh: 至元十三年，立為路，隸宣撫司。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan it was established as a circuit and subordinated to the Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 it was made a circuit under the pacification commission.

sentences.zh: 鎮西路，在柔遠路正西，東隔麓川。

translations.literal: Zhenxi Circuit, directly west of Rouryuan Circuit, with Luchuan to the east.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenxi Circuit lay directly west of Rouryuan, with Luchuan to the east.

sentences.zh: 其地曰于賴睒，曰渠瀾睒，白夷蠻居之。

translations.literal: Its lands were called Yulaishan and Qulanshan; Bo Yi barbarians dwelt there.
translations.idiomatic: The region comprised Yulaishan and Qulanshan, home to Bo Yi tribes.

sentences.zh: 中統初內附，至元十三年立為路，隸宣撫司。

translations.literal: At the start of Zhongtong they submitted from within; in the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan it was established as a circuit and subordinated to the Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: They submitted in the early Zhongtong reign; in 1276 it was made a circuit under the pacification commission.

sentences.zh: 平緬路，北近柔遠路。

translations.literal: Pingmian Circuit, north near Rouryuan Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Pingmian Circuit bordered Rouryuan to the north.

sentences.zh: 其地曰驃睒，曰羅必四莊，曰小沙摩弄，曰驃睒頭，白夷居之。

translations.literal: Its lands were called Piaoshan, Luobi Sizhuang, Xiaoshamanong, and Piaoshantou; Bo Yi dwelt there.
translations.idiomatic: The region comprised Piaoshan, Luobi Sizhuang, Xiaoshamanong, and Piaoshantou, home to the Bo Yi.

sentences.zh: 中統初內附，至元十三年立為路，隸宣撫司。

translations.literal: At the start of Zhongtong they submitted from within; in the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan it was established as a circuit and subordinated to the Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: They submitted in the early Zhongtong reign; in 1276 it was made a circuit under the pacification commission.

sentences.zh: 麓川路，在茫施路東。

translations.literal: Luchuan Circuit, east of Mangshi Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Luchuan Circuit lay east of Mangshi.

sentences.zh: 其地曰大布茫。

translations.literal: Its land was called Dabumang.
translations.idiomatic: The region included Dabumang.

sentences.zh: 曰睒頭附賽，曰睒中彈吉，曰睒 尾福禄培，皆白夷所居。

translations.literal: They were called Shantou Fusai, Shazhong Tanji, and Shanwei Fulopei — all Bo Yi dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: Settlements included Shantou Fusai, Shazhong Tanji, and Shanwei Fulopei, all home to the Bo Yi.

sentences.zh: 中統初內附，至元十三年立為路，隸宣撫司。

translations.literal: At the start of Zhongtong they submitted from within; in the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan it was established as a circuit and subordinated to the Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: They submitted in the early Zhongtong reign; in 1276 it was made a circuit under the pacification commission.

sentences.zh: 南睒，在鎮西路西北。

translations.literal: Nanshan, northwest of Zhenxi Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Nanshan lay northwest of Zhenxi Circuit.

sentences.zh: 其地有阿賽睒、午真睒，白夷峨昌所居。

translations.literal: Its lands included Aisaishan and Wuzhenshan, where Bo Yi and Echang dwelt.
translations.idiomatic: The region held Aisaishan and Wuzhenshan, home to Bo Yi and Echang peoples.

sentences.zh: 元初內附，至元十五年隸宣撫司。

translations.literal: At the start of the Yuan they submitted from within; in the fifteenth year of Zhiyuan they were subordinated to the Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: They submitted early in the Yuan; in 1278 they came under the pacification commission.

sentences.zh: 金齒六路一睒，歲賦金銀各有差。

translations.literal: Jinchi had six circuits and one shan; annual tribute of gold and silver varied for each.
translations.idiomatic: The Jinchi region comprised six circuits and one shan, each paying annual gold and silver tribute in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 烏撒烏蒙宣慰司，在本部巴的甸。

translations.literal: Wusa-Wumeng Pacification Commission, at the headquarters Badi Dian.
translations.idiomatic: The Wusa-Wumeng Pacification Commission was headquartered at Badi Dian.

sentences.zh: 烏撒者蠻名也。

translations.literal: Wusa is a barbarian name.
translations.idiomatic: Wusa was a tribal name.

sentences.zh: 其部在中慶東北七百五十里，舊名巴凡兀姑，今曰巴的甸，自昔烏雜蠻居之。

translations.literal: Its division lay seven hundred fifty li northeast of Zhongqing; formerly called Bafan Wugu, now called Badi Dian; since ancient times the Wusa barbarians dwelt there.
translations.idiomatic: The division lay 750 li northeast of Zhongqing, formerly Bafan Wugu and now Badi Dian, long home to the Wusa tribes.

sentences.zh: 今所轄部六，曰烏撒部、阿頭部、易溪部、易娘部、烏蒙部、閟畔部。

translations.literal: The six divisions now governed were called the Wusa, Atou, Yixi, Yiniang, Wumeng, and Bipan divisions.
translations.idiomatic: It governed six divisions: Wusa, Atou, Yixi, Yiniang, Wumeng, and Bipan.

sentences.zh: 其東西又有芒布、阿晟二部。

translations.literal: To its east and west were also the Mangbu and Asheng divisions.
translations.idiomatic: Mangbu and Asheng divisions lay to its east and west.

sentences.zh: 後烏蠻之裔折怒始強大，盡得其地，因取遠祖烏撒為部名。

translations.literal: Later Zhenu, descendant of the Wu barbarians, first grew powerful, fully obtained their lands, and thereby took the distant ancestor Wusa as the division name.
translations.idiomatic: Later Zhenu, a descendant of the Wu tribes, rose to power, seized the entire region, and took the name Wusa from a remote ancestor.

sentences.zh: 憲宗征大理，累招不降。

translations.literal: When Möngke campaigned against Dali, they were repeatedly summoned but would not submit.
translations.idiomatic: During Möngke's conquest of Dali they were summoned repeatedly but refused to submit.

sentences.zh: 至元十年始附。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Zhiyuan they first submitted.
translations.idiomatic: They first submitted in 1273.

sentences.zh: 十三年，立烏撒路。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year Wusa Circuit was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 Wusa Circuit was established.

sentences.zh: 十五年，為軍民總管府。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year it became a Military-Civilian General Administration.
translations.idiomatic: In 1278 it became a military-civilian general administration.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，改軍民宣撫司。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year it was changed to a Military-Civilian Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In 1284 it was converted to a military-civilian pacification commission.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，升烏撒烏蒙宣慰司。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year it was promoted to the Wusa-Wumeng Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In 1287 it was elevated to the Wusa-Wumeng Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 木連路軍民府。

translations.literal: Mulian Circuit Military-Civilian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Mulian Circuit Military-Civilian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 以下闕。

translations.literal: Below, the text is absent (lacuna).
translations.idiomatic: The remainder is missing.

translations.literal: Mengguang Circuit Military-Civilian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Mengguang Circuit Military-Civilian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 木邦路軍民府。

translations.literal: Mubang Circuit Military-Civilian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Mubang Circuit Military-Civilian Prefecture.

translations.literal: Mengding Circuit Military-Civilian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Mengding Circuit Military-Civilian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 謀粘路軍民府。

translations.literal: Mounian Circuit Military-Civilian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Mounian Circuit Military-Civilian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 南甸軍民府。

translations.literal: Nandian Military-Civilian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Nandian Military-Civilian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 六難路甸軍民府。

translations.literal: Liunan Ludian Military-Civilian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Liunan Ludian Military-Civilian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 陋麻和管民官。

translations.literal: Loumahe Civilian Administration.
translations.idiomatic: Loumahe Civilian Administration.

translations.literal: Yunlong Dian Military-Civilian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yunlong Dian Military-Civilian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 縹甸軍民府。

translations.literal: Piaodian Military-Civilian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Piaodian Military-Civilian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十四寨達魯花赤。

translations.literal: Twenty-Four Stockades Darughachi.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-Four Stockades Darughachi.

sentences.zh: 孟隆路軍民府。

translations.literal: Menglong Circuit Military-Civilian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Menglong Circuit Military-Civilian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 木朵路軍民總管府。

translations.literal: Moduo Circuit Military-Civilian General Administration.
translations.idiomatic: Moduo Circuit Military-Civilian General Administration.

sentences.zh: 至元三十年，以金齒木朵甸戶口增殖，立下路總管府，其為長者給兩珠虎符。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year of Zhiyuan, because the registered households of Jinchi Moduo dian had increased, a lower-route general administration was established, and the senior was granted a two-pearl tiger tally.
translations.idiomatic: In 1293, as the registered population of Jinchi Moduo dian had grown, a lower-route general administration was established and its chief was granted a two-pearl tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 金齒孟定各甸軍民官。

translations.literal: Jinchi and Mengding Various Dian Military-Civilian Officials.
translations.idiomatic: Jinchi and Mengding Various Dian Military-Civilian Officials.

sentences.zh: 孟愛等甸軍民府。

translations.literal: Meng'ai and Other Dian Military-Civilian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Meng'ai and Other Dian Military-Civilian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 至元二十一年，金齒新附孟愛甸酋長遣其子來朝，即其地立軍民總管府。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year of Zhiyuan the newly submitted Meng'ai dian chief of Jinchi sent his son to court, and on that spot a Military-Civilian General Administration was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1284 the chief of newly submitted Meng'ai dian in Jinchi sent his son to court, and a military-civilian general administration was established there.

sentences.zh: 蒙兀路。

translations.literal: Mengwu Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Mengwu Circuit.

sentences.zh: 通西軍民總管府。

translations.literal: Tongxi Military-Civilian General Administration.
translations.idiomatic: Tongxi Military-Civilian General Administration.

sentences.zh: 大德元年，蒙陽甸酋領緬吉納款，遣其弟阿不剌等赴闕進方物，且請歲貢銀千兩及置郡縣驛傳，遂立通西軍民府。

translations.literal: In the first year of Dade the Mengyang dian chieftain Miangina submitted, sent his younger brother Abula and others to the palace to present local products, and also requested an annual tribute of one thousand taels of silver and the establishment of commanderies, counties, and relay stations — whereupon the Tongxi Military-Civilian General Administration was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1297 the Mengyang dian chieftain Miangina submitted, sending his brother Abula and others to court with local products and requesting an annual silver tribute of 1,000 taels plus commanderies, counties, and relay stations; the Tongxi military-civilian general administration was then established.

sentences.zh: 木來軍民府。

translations.literal: Mulai Military-Civilian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Mulai Military-Civilian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 至元二十九年，雲南省言：「新附金齒適當忙兀禿兒迷失出征軍馬之沖，資其芻糧，擬立為木來路。」

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year of Zhiyuan the Yunnan Province said: "The newly submitted Jinchi region lies directly in the path of Mangwu Tu'ermishi's expeditionary horses and troops; to supply their fodder and grain, it is proposed to establish it as Mulai Circuit."
translations.idiomatic: In 1292 Yunnan Province reported, "Newly submitted Jinchi lies directly on the route of Mangwu Tu'ermishi's expeditionary forces; to supply their fodder and grain, it should be established as Mulai Circuit."

sentences.zh: 中書省奏置散府，以布伯為達魯花赤，用其土人馬列知府事。

translations.literal: The Central Secretariat memorialized to establish a scattered prefecture, appointing Bubo as darughachi and employing the native Malie to manage prefectural affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Central Secretariat memorialized to establish a scattered prefecture, appointing Bubo darughachi and putting the native official Malie in charge of the prefectural administration.
